title: Executive Assistant to Founder
description:
I’m a British entrepreneur based in Thailand running four ventures: an AI services agency (ScaleSage), a Caribbean restaurant in Pattaya (Belly Full), a Caribbean seasoning brand launching into UK retail with production in China (Belly Full Seasonings), and internal AI systems for algorithmic trading and business automation.



I operate through voice-to-text, Claude, and Claude Code — I architect systems and my team executes. My bottleneck isn’t strategy, it’s execution bandwidth. I need an Executive Assistant who becomes my second brain.



I’m a founder, not a big corporation. This means two things: I can move fast and make decisions without red tape, and I pay what’s fair without corporate budgets to throw around. The trade-off is real opportunity — the right person here grows with me as the businesses grow.



HOW THIS WORKS



I want to start someone part-time (20-25 hours/week) for the first month as a paid trial. This protects both of us — we find out if we click without either side being locked in. If the fit is right and the work justifies it, we move to full-time hours.



Nothing is promised. Everything is earned. IF we click, IF the work ethic is there, IF the fit is right — this role has real growth potential. Travel opportunities, performance bonuses, eventual in-person/relocated role, and even leading future business arms as we scale. I won’t sell you a dream. I’ll tell you the ceiling is high for the right person.



WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO



Daily operations:



- Manage my calendar and book meetings

- Triage inbox, draft
s in my voice

- Handle admin: account setups, form-filling, registrations

- Chase suppliers and contractors on my behalf



Financial admin:



- Track recurring bills and subscriptions

- Review supplier invoices, spot wasteful spending

- Coordinate with my accountant

- Basic bookkeeping oversight



Research and sourcing:



- Chinese manufacturers (factory trip in May 2026)

- UK retail buyers and market intelligence

- Competitors, legal, regulatory — whatever I need to know



ScaleSage (AI agency) operations:



- Monitor cold
 campaigns (Instantly)

- Manage GoHighLevel sub-accounts

- Handle client onboarding

- Keep the agency running



Content and documentation:



- Create visuals in Canva (social posts, one-pagers)

- Draft documents and SOPs

- Maintain project trackers

- Help with basic content creation for marketing



AI-powered work:



- Access to my Claude Max plan to supercharge your output



MUST HAVE



1. Excellent English — written AND spoken. Your English will be tested during the hiring process.

2. AI-native workflow — you use Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini DAILY. Not negotiable.

3. 2+ years EA or senior VA experience with Western clients

4. Basic financial literacy — invoices, budgets, expense tracking, ability to coordinate with an accountant

5. Canva or equivalent — can create clean professional visuals

6. Research and sourcing ability — you find, compare, recommend

7. Radical honesty — tell me when you’re stuck or made a mistake. Hiding is the fastest way out.

8. Growth mindset — you enjoy learning new tools and tech

9. Reliable internet, quiet workspace, valid passport

10.Proactive initiative—you identify bottlenecks and hurdles before they arise and find solutions.



NICE TO HAVE



- Basic coding understanding (HTML, APIs, no-code tools like Zapier/Airtable)

- AI enthusiast (custom GPTs, Claude Projects, automation tools)

- Content creation experience (CapCut, social media graphics)

- China sourcing experience (Alibaba, Global Sources)

- UK e-commerce or retail familiarity

- GoHighLevel, Shopify, or Etsy experience

- Entrepreneurial mindset — you’ve tried to build something yourself

- Willingness to travel (Thailand, China, expenses covered)

- Openness to relocation long-term if the fit is right



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message with:



1. A 90-second Loom or voice recording introducing yourself. Speak naturally. No script.

2. Answer these questions (one sentence each):



- What AI tool do you use most and what do you use it for?

- What’s the most technical thing you’ve figured out on your own?

- What’s your experience with financial admin or bookkeeping?

- If you had to automate one part of your own daily life right now, what would it be and how?

- Describe a problem you solved without being told how

- Would you be open to traveling to Thailand or China for work if needed?

- Would you be open to relocating eventually if the fit was right?



1. One sentence: what’s your dream for the next five years?





No generic templates. If you used AI to help write your application, just tell me which tool — I respect AI use, I don’t respect pretending.

title: Expert YouTube Longform Video Editor
description:
We are looking for an expert-level YouTube Video Editor who can create premium, retention-focused long-form content for top creators and brands. This role is best suited for editors who understand high-quality YouTube storytelling in the style of channels such as Vox, Johnny Harris, Cleo Abram, and other documentary/explainer-style creators. We are not looking for basic editors, short-form-only editors, or editors who simply add cuts and captions. We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment, technical skill, and the ability to turn raw footage and direction into a polished, engaging, and thoughtful YouTube video. The ideal editor understands pacing, story structure, audience retention, visual clarity, motion graphics, sound design, and how every editing choice affects the viewer’s experience.



Responsibilities



Edit high-quality long-form YouTube videos for creators, brands, and educational content.

Build strong hooks that make viewers want to keep watching.

Shape raw footage into a clear and engaging story.

Use B-roll, archival footage, graphics, music, sound design, and visual references intentionally.

Create clean motion graphics, maps, text animations, callouts, and visual explanations when needed.

Improve pacing, flow, clarity, and retention throughout the video.

Follow creative direction while also bringing your own strong editorial judgment.

Apply feedback quickly and professionally.

Work with creative leads, producers, and post-production teams to meet high creative standards.

Deliver polished edits on time in a fast-moving YouTube-first environment.



Qualifications



Strong experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

Expert-level skill in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Expert-level skill in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics.

Good understanding of Photoshop or other Adobe Creative Suite tools.

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts.

Ability to create documentary, explainer, talking-head, educational, or creator-style edits.

Strong use of B-roll, archival footage, visual references, graphics, sound design, and music.

Understanding of audience retention, viewer engagement, and YouTube performance.

Experience editing high-performing or high-quality content for creators, agencies, brands, or media companies.

Ability to work with feedback, revisions, and tight deadlines.

Strong attention to detail and clean technical execution.

Reliable computer/workstation setup and strong internet connection.



This Role Is Not For



Entry-level editors.

Editors with only short-form reel experience.

Editors with only wedding, corporate, event, or basic social media editing experience.

Editors who are not comfortable with long-form YouTube content.

Editors who only follow instructions but do not bring creative judgment.

Editors who cannot work with feedback or tight deadlines.

Editors who do not have strong Premiere Pro and After Effects skills.



Benefits



Work from anywhere! We’re a 100% remote team.

A quarterly wellness reimbursement

20 days of paid time off annually.

12 additional holidays per year.

Unlimited sick and bereavement leave.

Working for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact.

Unlimited reimbursement on book purchases for self-education.

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements.

Working directly with some of the largest brands on the planet.



Additionally, Dragonfruit is highly committed to offering all our team members opportunities for growth and mobility within the company. This could include moving up to Lead Short-Form or Long-Form Editor, Director of the Editing Department, Post-Production Supervisor, or even Creative Director or beyond! (Of course, all of these positions come with pay increases.)

?

If you're ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in the future of YouTube, submit your application now!

Location & Working Hours

Why Join MorganAsh?

title: B2B Sales & Wholesale Partnerships Manager — Surf Brand (Global Accounts)
description:

We are a European brand (HQ Paris) selling worldwide, with warehouses in Germany and China. We already sell direct to consumers through our own Shopify store and have started building retail partnerships in Europe and Asia (Sri Lanka & Indonesia).



Now we are expanding our global B2B network, and we want to do it right. Not fast and generic, but slow and intentional, with partners who actually fit the brand. You will be the bridge between SMILE and the right wholesale and retail partners across our target markets: Europe, the USA and Australia.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Manage and qualify inbound B2B inquiries with professionalism and genuine brand awareness

- Research, identify and reach out to quality wholesale partners: surf shops, surf schools, surf camps, water sports centres, resort operators and boardsport retailers

- Evaluate partners not just by size, but by reputation, community standing and cultural fit

- Build and nurture relationships with key accounts, following up properly instead of sending one
 and giving up

- Maintain a clean, accurate outreach tracker in Google Sheets: who was contacted, when, what was said, what happens next

- Report to the CEO weekly with a structured update on pipeline, leads and opportunities

- Act as a brand ambassador. You represent SMILE in every conversation



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Proven experience in B2B sales, lead generation, business development or account management. Not consumer support, not general VA work

- You can research a market and build a qualified prospect list yourself, from scratch

- Excellent written and spoken English. Warm, professional and brand-appropriate. Your
s need to read like they come from a European lifestyle brand, not from a template

- Self-directed and organised. You build your own pipeline and report clearly without hand-holding

- Comfortable working with Google Sheets and a simple CRM or tracker

- Reliable follow-up discipline. Most B2B deals are won on the third or fourth touch



NICE TO HAVE



- Surf, boardsport, outdoor, action sports or apparel industry experience

- Experience selling into European or US retail

- Familiarity with wholesale basics: MOQs, margins, RRP, line sheets, trade terms

- You surf, or you are genuinely interested in surf and ocean culture



THE SETUP



- Freelance / independent contractor

- Flexible working hours, no fixed schedule. You manage your own time

- Some overlap with CET (European) working hours is preferred for calls with the CEO

- 2-month test period, with a strong intention to extend long-term if it works well

- No conflict of interest with competing surf protection or headwear brands

- You report directly to the CEO



We start with 10 hours per week, and we are happy to extend the hours as leads come in and more time is required



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application. To be considered, send us:



- Your CV and LinkedIn profile if you have one

- A short summary of B2B accounts you have personally opened. Which industry, which markets, what results

- Write us a short sample outreach
 (5 to 8 sentences) that you would send to a surf SHOP in Australia and surf CAMP in Portugal to introduce SMILE Surf Wear.

title: Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT VLARI



VLARI is a specialized U.S.-based advisory firm serving established business owners. We work with a limited number of clients and prioritize quality, accuracy, confidentiality, and thoughtful service over high case volume.



We are seeking a reliable, highly organized Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator for a full-time, long-term position.



This is a versatile role for someone who enjoys managing detailed processes, communicating professionally with clients, organizing financial documents, and ensuring that every case continues moving forward.



This is not a sales, call-center, or independent advisory position. You will receive training in our internal processes. You will begin with client onboarding, administrative support, document organization, and case coordination. As you demonstrate proficiency, your responsibilities may expand into preliminary case preparation and implementation tracking.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Once a client completes payment, you will become the client’s primary operational contact.



You will own the administrative journey from payment through completed onboarding and preparation of a review-ready client file.



You will make sure clients understand what is required, submit the appropriate documents, answer all required intake questions, receive timely updates, and progress through each stage of the engagement.



POST-PAYMENT CLIENT ONBOARDING



Your responsibilities will include:



* Sending welcome communications immediately after payment

* Explaining the onboarding process and next steps

* Providing access to the secure client portal

* Confirming completion of engagement documents and required acknowledgments

* Scheduling onboarding, review, and presentation meetings

* Guiding clients through intake questionnaires

* Asking approved follow-up questions when information is incomplete

* Providing and explaining the required-document checklist

* Collecting tax returns, financial statements, payroll records, entity documents, insurance information, investment statements, and other requested records

* Reviewing documents for completeness, legibility, correct reporting periods, and missing pages

* Comparing submitted documents against the client’s checklist

* Following up professionally for missing information

* Documenting the client’s objectives, concerns, priorities, and unanswered questions

* Entering and verifying information in company systems

* Maintaining accurate notes, tasks, deadlines, and pipeline stages

* Preparing a consolidated internal case summary

* Identifying inconsistencies and questions that require escalation

* Confirming when the client’s file is complete and ready for professional review

* Sending appropriate progress updates throughout the engagement

* Coordinating communication among the client, company leadership, and assigned professionals



CASE AND IMPLEMENTATION COORDINATION



After training, your responsibilities may also include:



* Organizing financial and business information for internal analysis

* Extracting designated information from financial statements and tax documents

* Preparing preliminary internal summaries for review

* Operating internal assessment and case-preparation systems

* Coordinating reviews with accountants, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other specialists

* Recording professional feedback and requested changes

* Preparing meeting briefs and client presentation materials

* Creating and maintaining implementation checklists

* Assigning and tracking approved implementation steps

* Following up with clients and outside professionals

* Assisting with insurance and annuity application processing

* Tracking applications, signatures, transfers, funding, and outstanding requirements

* Communicating with insurance carriers and related organizations

* Maintaining accurate case statuses until completion

* Escalating matters requiring professional judgment or approval



ADMINISTRATIVE AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Because VLARI serves a limited number of quality clients, this position will support several areas of the business. Additional responsibilities may include:



* Managing calendars and appointment confirmations

* Monitoring and organizing company

* Answering and routing administrative client calls

* Drafting routine client communications

* Updating CRM records and pipeline stages

* Organizing company files and folders

* Maintaining standard operating procedures

* Auditing client files for missing information

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping and operational reporting

* Maintaining service and follow-up calendars

* Researching administrative information when assigned

* Testing intake forms, reports, and internal workflows

* Supporting special company projects during lower-volume periods



PROFESSIONAL BOUNDARIES



You will explain company processes, collect factual information, answer approved administrative questions, and coordinate work that has already been authorized.



You will not be expected or authorized to independently:



* Provide U.S. tax advice

* Provide legal advice

* Recommend investments, insurance policies, or annuities

* Approve client strategies

* Promise financial or tax results

* Represent yourself as a U.S.-licensed professional

* Release a final client design without approval



Any question involving professional judgment or a recommendation must be documented and escalated to the appropriate professional.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have an accounting, bookkeeping, business administration, insurance, or financial-services background

* Have experience supporting U.S. clients or companies

* Are comfortable reviewing financial documents

* Communicate clearly and professionally by
, telephone, and video

* Are highly organized and careful with details

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit:

2. A link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction.

IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE ADDRESS:

WRITTEN APPLICATION QUESTIONS

 follow-up, data entry, file organization, and other administrative tasks while learning more advanced responsibilities?



9. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, describe your current schedule and availability.



10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



11. Please provide two professional references.



SELECTION PROCESS



Qualified applicants may be invited to:

title: Customer Service Representative / Back office Assistant
description:
Customer Service Representative for US Plumbing and HVAC Company, ServiceTitan, Night Shift



ABOUT US

We are 1-800-Plumber + Air of Triad, a plumbing and heating and air company serving High Point, Greensboro and Winston-Salem in North Carolina, USA. We are a small, growing team. You will work directly with the owner, not through layers of management.



THE ROLE

You are the voice of our company. When someone in North Carolina has water on their floor at 11pm or no hot water before work, you are who they reach. Your job is simple to describe and hard to do well: answer every call live, make the customer feel taken care of, and get the appointment booked.



We measure one thing above all else: your booking rate. How many of the people who call us end up on the schedule. If you are good at that, you will do well here and we will pay you well for it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Answer every inbound call live and book into ServiceTitan. 

Call back web leads and texts fast, while they are still shopping. 

Confirm tomorrow's appointments. 

Revive estimates the customer did not accept. 

Ask happy customers for a Google review. Keep records clean. 

Recognise a true emergency and escalate it. 

Handle price shoppers without simply giving a number and losing the call.



WHAT WE NEED

2+ years answering phones for a US home services company. Hands on ServiceTitan, or strong Housecall Pro / Jobber / FieldEdge and willingness to learn fast. Excellent spoken English, warm and easy to understand. You ask for the appointment, you do not just take messages. You have worked a US night shift before. Fiber internet 25 Mbps or better, noise cancelling headset, quiet room, and a real backup for power and internet outages.



SCHEDULE, PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.

In Philippine time that is 7:30 PM to 5:00 AM the following day. This is a graveyard shift.

We say this plainly because we want someone who chooses it with open eyes and stays for years.



PAY

USD 1,000 to 1,400 per month depending on experience and ServiceTitan skill. Paid twice monthly in USD, on time. Booking rate bonus after 90 days. 13th month pay. Paid Philippine holidays. Paid time off after 6 months. Long term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Follow these exactly. Applications that skip a step will not be read.

Start your message with the word WRENCH. 

Tell us your field service software and years. 

Tell us your night shift history and how long. Record a 60 to 90 second voice clip in English answering this call: "Hi, my water heater is leaking all over my garage floor and I do not know what to do." Handle it like it is real. 

Tell us your internet speed, headset, and outage backup. 

Tell us your monthly rate in USD.



The voice clip matters more than your resume. We will listen to every one.

description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated, organized, and clear-speaking Virtual Interviewer & Driver Onboarding Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will manage our hiring funnel by responding to Indeed advertisements, scheduling applicants, and conducting live virtual interviews. Your main objective is to guide applicants through downloading our mobile app, starting their registration, and explaining how driving with us works.



This position requires high-volume communication, meticulous data tracking, and a professional on-camera presence.



Key Responsibilities

Ad Response & Scheduling: Monitor incoming applications from Indeed, manage the interview schedule, and ensure a steady pipeline of candidates.



Virtual Interviews & Onboarding:



Conduct live video interviews daily, welcoming and thanking applicants for their time.

Explain the role clearly (informing applicants they will operate as independent drivers).

Securely guide candidates through the live app download process on their mobile devices.

Walk them through initial registration steps (entering Name, Address,
, Date of Birth, etc.).

Provide a clear overview of how the platform operates once the initial registration steps are complete.



Metrics & Performance Tracking: Keep meticulous daily logs tracking the exact number of applicants spoken to versus the number of successful app downloads achieved.



Quality Assurance: Maintain professional standards at all times, as all video calls and communications are monitored and recorded for quality control.



Shift, Schedule, & Compensation

Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Central Standard Time (CST)

Days: Monday through Friday



Trial Period: There will be an initial 2-week trial period to evaluate performance, tracking accuracy, and conversion metrics.



Location: 100% Remote (Work from home)

Required Skills & Qualifications

Language Proficiency: Fluent spoken English with a neutral, clear accent for seamless communication with U.S. applicants.



Communication: Excellent phone and video communication etiquette; comfortable being on camera all day.

Experience: Direct experience making outbound calls or interacting professionally with U.S.-based businesses or individuals.

Technical & Workflow Aptitude:

Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable navigating CRM systems, tracking data, and following structured interview scripts.



Workspace Requirements: A dedicated, quiet workspace free of background noise, a reliable computer, a high-quality headset, and a rock-solid internet connection.



Preferred Experience (A Plus)

Cold calling, appointment setting, or lead generation.

Customer service, sales support, or Virtual Assistant experience.

Prior experience in healthcare outreach or workforce development sectors.



Software We Use

CRM systems

Aircall

Gmail

Claude AI

Application Instructions

 

IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you MUST provide the following items with your application:

Your current Resume.

A short Voice Recording Introduction (link or file).

A screenshot of a recent Internet Speed Test.

A brief summary of your experience calling U.S. businesses.



Explicit confirmation of your availability during 9 AM – 6 PM CST hours.



*Please Answer the Following Questions in Your Response*:

Describe your experience making outbound calls.

Have you worked with U.S. businesses or applicants before? Please elaborate.

What specific CRM systems have you used in the past?

Are you entirely comfortable speaking with and guiding applicants live on video?

title: Content & Communications Writer for Children's E-Commerce Brand
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We're a children's e-commerce brand looking for a Content & Communications Writer to help build out our website content, blog, and
/social copy. Right now the priority is finishing a set of doll companion pages — educational, story-driven web pages that teach kids and parents about different cultures.



About the Role

This is a writing-led execution role, ~20 hrs/week, fully remote. You'll take briefs and follow an approved page template to write warm, informative content for a parent-and-child audience. No design skills needed — you're writing the words, not building the layout.



What You'll Do



Write companion page content in Shopify: cultural learning sections, "what to say to your child" prompts, holiday guides, activity ideas — following our established page structure

Draft blog posts and
/social copy from creative briefs

Research any cultural, historical, or product detail you're not already sure of before writing about it

Flag anything culturally sensitive for review rather than guessing — final sign-off on cultural content always comes from us

Keep ClickUp tasks and timesheets current in real time



What We're Looking For



Strong, warm English writing for a parent/child audience — this is the core skill

Comfortable working from a brief and an existing template without needing to invent structure

Some SEO or blog-writing background is a plus

Proactive communication — you flag delays and open questions before they become problems

Reliable, on-time delivery and invoicing



To Apply:

Only candidates submitted to this form will be considered

title: Video Editor
description:
Position: Video Editor (YouTube, Faceless Content)

Type: Part-time, remote, project-based

Volume: Minimum 12 long-form videos per month

Pay: $30 per finished video



About Us



We produce faceless YouTube content focused on practical, credible education using real-life B-roll footage. No talking heads. No animation. No motion graphics. Just well-paced, professional video that earns trust.



What You'll Do



- Edit long-form YouTube videos (8-12 minutes) with tight pacing and frequent scene changes

- Work from provided scripts to start — training provided to eventually write scripts independently

- Create AI-generated voiceover narration from the finished script to begin with. You will later be responsible for creating scripts also, after some instruction.

- Source and sync real stock B-roll footage based on scene descriptions

- Add lo-fi or cinematic instrumental background music

- Deliver YouTube-ready files on deadline

- Upload finished videos to YouTube Studio as Private drafts, ready for scheduling

- Optimize each video: title, description, tags, chapters, and thumbnail brief



What We're Looking For



- Intermediate to advanced editor with YouTube experience

- Strong English speaking and writing skills are a must

- Comfortable with AI voiceover tools and stock footage sourcing

- Understands YouTube SEO and optimization basics

- Owns your own software subscriptions — we don't provide tools

- Delivers clean, finished work without multiple correction rounds



Production Standards



- Real B-roll only — no animation, no motion graphics, no talking heads

- Music fades slightly under narration, swells at transitions

- Strong first 45 seconds — hook must land



To Apply



Send 2-3 examples of faceless YouTube videos you've produced, your preferred tools, and typical turnaround time per video.



One more thing: somewhere in this application, a cat is hiding. If you read this far, start your very first line with "The cat found me." Applications that don't begin this way will not be reviewed.

title: AI Systems Builder / Automation Engineer / Full-Stack Dev
description:
I'm a British entrepreneur based in Thailand running multiple ventures: ScaleSage (an AI Systems & Automation Specialists agency), a Caribbean restaurant in Pattaya (Belly Full), a Caribbean seasoning brand launching into UK retail with production in China (Belly Full Seasonings), a kids' education app (Legacy Curriculum), and internal AI systems for algorithmic trading and business automation.



I operate through voice-to-text, Claude, and Claude Code — I architect systems and my team executes. My bottleneck isn't strategy, it's execution bandwidth. I already have an EA (Cy, Filipino, doing strong work). I now need a technical counterpart — someone who can use AI tools, APIs, and automations to build the systems my businesses run on.

I'm a founder, not a big corporation. This means two things: I can move fast and make decisions without red tape, and I pay what's fair without corporate budgets to throw around. The trade-off is real opportunity — the right person here grows with me as the businesses grow.



I'm not necessarily looking for an elite "senior AI engineer" who needs $3,000/month. I'm looking for a hungry, AI-native technical builder — mid-high level technically, senior in hunger. Someone who uses existing models, APIs, automations, and tools to ship working business systems fast.



HOW THIS WORKS

I want to start someone part-time (20-25 hours/week) for the first month as a paid trial. This protects both of us — we find out if we click without either side being locked in. If the fit is right and the work justifies it, we move to full-time hours over time.

Nothing is promised. Everything is earned. IF we click, IF the work ethic is there, IF the fit is right — this role has real growth potential.

Performance is everything. Bonuses are paid for execution, reliability, speed, and quality — when you ship a big build, solve a complex problem, or hit a real performance milestone. Pay rises are earned through consistency, loyalty, and reliability over time. Eventually leading a small dev / tech team as we scale.

We aim for high standards and quality constantly. We don't ship sub-standard work. I'd rather you ship less, cleanly, than rush something half-built. Shortcuts cost us more than slow shipping ever will. The right person here takes pride in their craft and signs their name on what they ship.

I won't sell you a dream. I'll tell you the ceiling is high for the right person.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

Trial month — full ScaleSage technical foundation:



Mac Mini #2 set up as production server (security, Tailscale VPN, Docker, monitoring, backups)

Self-hosted n8n with Claude API integration

7 production AI agents minimum — lead enrichment, cold
 personalisation, reply triage, follow-up sequencer, client reporting, voice agent (Vapi/Retell), plus a 7th you propose after analysing the operational flow with Cy

Three landing pages (scalesage.ai/local, /business, /enterprise) using Lovable, v0, or Bolt

Tracking infrastructure (GA4, Meta Pixel, Looker Studio dashboards)

Integrations
 GoHighLevel, Apollo, Instantly, Stripe

Documentation + Loom handover



The target is the full ScaleSage launch-ready stack in 30 days — Mac Mini server + 7 production agents + 3 landing pages + tracking + integrations + documentation. All of it. Live. Working. Ready for cold
 launch on June 2nd. I know it's aggressive — that's intentional. I want to see how you prioritise, ship, and document.



A good candidate ships the core spine

A strong candidate ships most of it

An exceptional candidate ships the whole thing and improves the brief



Post-trial — you become a TMC tea
mber at 20-25 hrs/week, working alongside Cy across the portfolio:



Belly Full Seasonings brand website + e-commerce

Legacy Curriculum educational app builds

AI image / video production (Runway, Higgsfield, Flux, Nano Banana Pro, HeyGen avatars)

AI voice cloning + persona building (ElevenLabs)

AI personalities, content factory, plant/leaf diagnosis tools, lead-gen engines, app prototypes — whatever the portfolio needs

Internal tools, dashboards, scaling work for ScaleSage clients



You're not on a phased roadmap. You're a TMC tea
mber shipping what the business needs. Variety is the deal.

MUST HAVE



n8n / Make / Zapier automation experience (n8n self-hosted strongly preferred)

Claude / OpenAI API experience — built real workflows, not just played with prompts

API / webhook integration — REST, OAuth, rate limits, error handling

GHL or similar CRM automation understanding

Basic JavaScript or Python for custom logic

Landing page builders — Lovable, v0, Bolt, Webflow, Framer, or similar

Docker basics or ability to self-host tools on a Mac/Linux server

Basic server / security discipline — firewall, VPN (Tailscale), backups, monitoring

Loom documentation — you record walkthroughs without being asked

Excellent written and spoken English — we work over WhatsApp and Loom. English will be tested live.

Self-managing — take a brief and ship, no babysitting

AI-native workflow — you use Claude / Cursor / Claude Code daily as power tools

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, valid passport



NICE TO HAVE



Openclaw / claude-flow / agent orchestration tools

Supabase / Firebase / Vercel / Cloudflare

Stripe payment integration

Apollo / Instantly / Clay (cold
 infrastructure)

AI voice agents — Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs

AI image / video tools — Runway, Higgsfield, Flux, Nano Banana Pro, Sora, Veo, HeyGen, Midjourney

App builders — FlutterFlow, Bubble, Replit, Cursor

RAG / vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector

Computer vision APIs (for things like plant/leaf diagnosis or product image analysis)

Active GitHub with public commits in the last 90 days

Entrepreneurial mindset — you've tried to build something yourself

Willingness to travel (Thailand, expenses covered)

Openness to relocation long-term if the fit is right



You don't need to know every tool already. But you must be the kind of person who can learn a new tool in a weekend, build with it by Monday, and document what you did so the rest of the team can use it.



HOW TO APPLY

Send a message with:

1. A 5-7 minute Loom walking me through how YOU would tackle the trial-month build.

Don't just say hi — show me your brain. Open Loom, share your screen if you want, sketch on a whiteboard, or just talk it through. Cover:



How you'd sequence the 30-day build (what you'd do first, second, third)

Which tools you'd reach for and why

The biggest risk you'd plan for

What you'd ship in Week 1 to prove 
ntum

Any questions or assumptions you'd want me to clarify



This Loom is your application. If you can't do this Loom, you can't do the job. No script needed — I want to see how you actually think.

2. Start your written message with the word "AGENT-READY" (so I know you read this carefully)

3. Link to your portfolio + GitHub username

4. One production system you've built — what it does, how you built it, why you built it that way. Screen-share Loom strongly preferred (5 mins, showing it working live, not slideware)

5. Skill self-assessment — for each, mark Strong / Decent / Weak / Never tried:



n8n workflows (self-hosted, Docker)

Claude / OpenAI API agents

GHL / CRM integrations

Landing pages with Lovable / v0 / Bolt / Framer

Stripe / payment APIs

AI voice agents (Vapi / Retell / ElevenLabs)

AI image / video workflows (Runway / Flux / HeyGen / Higgsfield)

Simple app prototypes (FlutterFlow / Bubble / Cursor)

Mac Mini / Linux self-hosting (Docker, Tailscale, security)

Documentation + Loom handover



Then tell me: which 3 are your strongest? Which 3 are your weakest? How fast could you learn the weak ones?

6. Answer these questions (one or two sentences each):



What AI tool do you use most and what do you use it for?

What's the most technical thing you've figured out on your own with no one to teach you?

What's the most complex production system you've built end-to-end?

If you had to automate one part of your own daily life right now, what would it be and how?

Describe a problem you solved by writing code or building a workflow without being told how

Would you be open to traveling to Thailand for an in-person workshop if needed? (expenses covered)

Would you be open to relocating eventually if the fit was right?



7. One paragraph: what's your dream for the next five years? Where do you want to be? What kind of role? What kind of life?

8. Your starting part-time retainer rate ($450-$600/month at 20-25 hrs/week baseline, or your number — explain why)

9. Earliest start date + how many hours/week you can commit

10. One thing you'd push back on or improve in this brief (shows me you think, not just execute)

11. One question you have for me about the role, the company, or me

Generic CVs without the above will be ignored. The Loom plan and self-assessment matter more than the CV. If you used AI to help write your application, just tell me which tool — I respect AI use, I don't respect pretending.

HIRING PROCESS



I review applications + the trial-month plan Loom — Cy and I shortlist together

30-minute video call with shortlist (English tested live, screen-share showing one production system)

Selected candidate starts 30-day paid trial — $450 fixed for 20-25 hrs/week

End of month, we both d
: continue and grow the role, or part ways clean

If continuing ? part-time retainer at $450-$600/month, then path to full-time over time



Payment: Wise transfers OR crypto (USDT/USDC on a network of your choice — TRC-20, ERC-20, Base, Solana). Your call. Monthly in arrears, on time, every time.



If this sounds like your kind of role — apply.



— J W-Blake

title: Warhammer 40K YouTube Video Editor – Long-Form Lore & Storytelling
description:
We’re looking for a talented YouTube Video Editor to bring Warhammer 40K lore to life through cinematic, story-driven long-form videos.



If you know how to build atmosphere, maintain strong pacing, and turn narration into an engaging visual experience, we’d love to see your work.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Edit long-form Warhammer 40K lore videos

• Create engaging, cinematic storytelling through visuals and pacing

• Sync footage and visuals with narration

• Source relevant artwork, gameplay, cinematics, and other visuals

• Add music and sound effects to enhance the atmosphere

• Maintain strong viewer retention throughout the video

• Follow the channel’s established editing style and direction



REQUIREMENTS



• Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

title: Football Reel Video Editor (Faceless, 50s Vertical Clips)
description:
We run a faceless football training page on Instagram and TikTok and need a dedicated editor turning our scripts and voiceovers into 3 finished reels a day.



The format: 45-60 second voiceover over clips of players like Yamal, Messi, Mbappe and Bellingham, teaching one idea per video. Reference standard (study before applying): 
 — opens on the player doing exactly what the hook says, cuts every 2-3 seconds, slow-mo on the key touch, word-synced captions with the big words in a second colour, comment keyword on screen at the end.



We supply, every day: the script (hook and players named), the voiceover MP3, and the comment keyword. You supply the footage and the edit.



Scope:

1. Source clips of the named players doing the specific thing the voiceover describes — a hook about dribbling gets a dribbling clip, not a celebration.

2. Sync cuts to the voiceover. Every new phrase gets a new clip. Nothing sits on screen longer than 3 seconds.

3. Word-synced captions, centred lower-third, bold sans-serif, keywords ("NEVER", "1 SECRET") highlighted in a second colour.

4. Voiceover always above the music. No intros, logos or watermarks.

5. Deliver MP4 + project file to Google Drive with the comment keyword held on screen for the last 3 seconds.



Volume: 3 videos a day, 6 days a week. Scripts and audio arrive daily; that day's 3 are due within 24 hours. Around 90 minutes each once you know the format.



Requirements: CapCut or Premiere Pro; good current football knowledge so you can find the right clip fast; portfolio with 3-5 short-form vertical examples (links, captioned work preferred); reliable internet; sustained output of 3 a day after the first week.



Paid test task: we send one script + voiceover; deliver the finished reel within 48 hours. We judge clip selection as much as editing. Paid regardless of outcome.



Pay: $5 per video, or $450/month at 3 a day. Rises based on editing quality after your first 20.



How to apply — video required:

Record a 60-90 second phone video (no editing needed) and paste the link (Drive, Loom or unlisted YouTube) in your application, covering:

1. Who you are and where you're based.

2. What the reference reel does in its first 4 seconds and how the captions are styled.

3. Three current players you follow and where you'd source clips of them.

4. Talk through one vertical video from your portfolio — software used, time taken.

5. Confirm you can do 3 a day at $5 per video, rising with quality.



Application filter: Start your written application with the word FORMULA, then tell us in one sentence which player the reference reel is about. Applications missing the video link, the portfolio links, or either filter will not be read.

description:
Please Read Before Applying



We’re looking for a highly creative, self-motivated AI Content Creator with experience creating content for online coaches, digital educators, course creators, consultants, or personal brands.



This is not a role where you’ll simply receive a list of posts to create. We want someone who can think, research, create, and proactively bring ideas to the table.



You should understand how social media content can help online coaches:



* Build authority and trust

* Grow an engaged audience

* Generate leads

* Drive webinar and free-training registrations

* Promote digital products and coaching programs

* Convert followers into paying clients



What We’re Looking For



You naturally study social media, follow trends, research competitors and successful creators, and recognize how Reels, carousels, hooks, and trends can be adapted for a specific brand.



You should also be comfortable researching an unfamiliar industry, learning its audience and pain points, and developing consistently relevant content.



Our primary niche is the salon suite industry and salon suite business coaching. You’ll be expected to understand the industry, learn what our audience needs, and develop fresh content ideas around those insights.

* Carousels

* Story content

* Promotional content

* Webinar content

* Lead-generation content

* Authority-building content

* Trending content adapted to our niche

* Content designed to sell coaching programs and digital offers



You’ll also regularly study successful online coaches, digital creators, and personal brands to identify trends, formats, and strategies we can creatively adapt to our brand.



AI Experience



You should be highly comfortable using AI tools to make the creative process faster and more effective.



However, we are not looking for someone who simply asks ChatGPT to “write 10 captions” and copies the results. AI should enhance your creativity—not replace it.



Proactive Thinking Is Essential



We don’t want to tell you what to post every day. We want someone who comes to us saying:



* “I found this trend and think we should try it.”

* “I researched these accounts and noticed this format is performing well.”

* “Here are five ideas I developed for next week.”

* “This post performed well, so I think we should create three variations.”



If you need detailed instructions for every piece of content, this probably isn’t the right position for you.



Ideal Candidate



Experience working with an online coach, course creator, digital entrepreneur, consultant, educator, or personal brand is strongly preferred.



We value creativity, initiative, curiosity, resourcefulness, and the ability to generate strong ideas just as much as technical skills. We want someone who is genuinely excited about social media, proactive in their approach, and committed to helping grow a brand.

title: Experienced Inbound Sales & Booking Specialist for U.S. Cleaning Company
description:
About Rinse & Rise Atlanta



Rinse & Rise Atlanta is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company serving customers throughout the Atlanta, Georgia area.



We receive leads from Google, Yelp, referrals, outbound prospecting, real estate professionals, and other marketing channels. We are looking for an experienced sales professional who can take ownership of these leads and convert them into confirmed cleaning appointments.



This is not simply a customer-service or administrative VA position. Your primary responsibility will be turning interested prospects into paying customers.



Primary Goal



Your success will be measured by your ability to:



• Respond to new leads quickly

• Understand each customer’s cleaning needs

• Communicate the value of our services

• Address questions and pricing concerns

• Follow up consistently

• Directly ask for the booking

• Convert qualified leads into confirmed cleaning appointments



Responsibilities



• Answer inbound calls from prospective cleaning customers

• Respond to leads received through phone, text,
, Google, Yelp, and other platforms

• Contact new leads as quickly as possible

• Ask detailed questions about the property, cleaning needs, timeline, priorities, and previous cleaning experiences

• Recommend the appropriate cleaning service

• Provide estimates using our approved pricing guidelines

• Explain our services, experienced cleaning team, and satisfaction guarantees

• Handle common objections involving price, timing, trust, reviews, or customers already having another cleaner

• Determine whether price is the customer’s true objection before offering any adjustment

• Negotiate within approved pricing limits when appropriate

• Ask directly for the booking and guide the customer through confirming an appointment

• Follow up with customers who request time to think, compare quotes, or speak with someone else

• Re-engage older leads who previously expressed interest but did not book

• Make outbound sales and prospecting calls when inbound call volume is lower

• Develop relationships with real estate agents, property managers, and potential referral partners

• Record every interaction, quote, objection, follow-up date, and outcome accurately

• Immediately escalate unusual, high-value, or commercial opportunities to the owner

• Track calls, quotes, follow-ups, confirmed bookings, and conversion rates



Our Sales Approach



We do not use dishonest sales tactics or fake discounts.



Our approach is to understand the customer’s needs, communicate our value, identify the real objection, and help the customer make a decision.



Important selling points include:



• Customers do not pay until the cleaning has been completed

• If a customer is not satisfied, we will return and address the cleaning concerns at no additional charge

• Our professional cleaners have extensive cleaning experience

• We provide residential, recurring, move-in/move-out, Airbnb, post-construction, and commercial cleaning services

• Customers receive responsive communication and dependable service



You will be trained on our pricing, services, policies, guarantees, and approved negotiation limits.



What We’re Looking For



• At least 3 years of phone sales, inbound sales, appointment-setting, or lead-conversion experience

• A proven ability to convert inquiries into appointments or sales

• Previous cleaning-company or home-service sales experience is strongly preferred

• Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers

• Excellent spoken and written English

• A confident, friendly, persuasive, and professional phone presence

• Strong listening and objection-handling skills

• Comfortable discussing pricing and directly asking customers to book

• Persistent with follow-ups without becoming aggressive or unprofessional

• Able to learn new services, pricing structures, and policies quickly

• Organized and comfortable using Google Sheets,
, SMS, and online lead platforms

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and high-quality headset

• Available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours



What We Provide



• Training on our services, pricing, policies, and guarantees

• Approved pricing ranges and negotiation guidelines

• Sales scripts and objection-handling materials

• Role-play training before handling live calls

• Business phone and messaging systems

• Inbound leads and outbound prospect lists

• A structured lead-tracking and follow-up process

• Direct access to the business owner

• Opportunities for additional hours and performance-based compensation



Schedule



Approximately 20 hours per week to start, primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



The schedule and number of hours may increase as the company’s lead volume grows.



Compensation



Starting at $6 USD per hour, depending on experience.



Performance bonuses may be provided for confirmed bookings and strong conversion results. Outstanding performance may lead to higher compensation, additional hours, and a long-term position with the company.



How to Apply

How many years of sales experience do you have?

Have you handled inbound leads and converted them into confirmed appointments or sales?

Have you worked for a cleaning company, home-service business, or other U.S.-based company?

Describe your follow-up process when an interested lead does not book immediately.

Please provide a link to your résumé.

Please include a one- to two-minute voice recording introducing yourself.



At the end of your recording, respond to this sample inbound call:



“Hi, I’m looking for someone to deep-clean my three-bedroom home next week. I’m calling a few cleaning companies to compare prices. How much would you charge?”



Please handle the call as though you are speaking with a real potential customer. Do not simply read a prepared introduction.

title: Video Editor / 2D Animator — Long-Form YouTube Anthology (Weekly)
description:
RATE / BUDGET (required field):

$2000 USD finished 4 video batch



ABOUT THE PROJECT



We make long-form anthology videos about history's darkest, strangest corners — think Trust Me Bro, Chat History, Sideprojects. Every 22-minute video contains 12 self-contained stories, each one about 90 seconds, bound by a single premise. The scripts are written, researched, and source-verified. Voiceover is recorded. Your job is everything visual.





2D animation, character-driven, deliberately simple. Thick black outlines, flat fills, expressive faces doing emotional work. Cut-out animation with rigged characters — not frame-by-frame, not photoreal, not AI-generated.



Real footage and archival stills carry the history — public-domain photographs, archival film, engravings, museum scans, maps. Roughly half the runtime lives here. The animation integrates with these photos (not pasted on top). Both layers feel like one show.



THE FORMAT REQUIREMENTS



•  21–23 minute runtime

•  Hard cuts between items 

•  Visual change every 3–6 seconds (never static)

•  Comic timing on the deflation beat (dry one-liner after escalation)

•  Escalation you can see visually (framing, cuts, colour, sound)

•  Sound design: ambience, SFX, music under the voice, no dead air



Each item follows this structure:

•  Name the thing (bare noun phrase)

• Establish the ordinary state

•  Introduce the deviation

•  Escalate 2–3 rungs

• Deliver the reveal

•  Dry closing beat (the joke)

•  Hard cut to next item



DELIVERABLES PER VIDEO



•  Final master: 1080p minimum (4K preferred), 16:9, H.264

•  Full sound mix: SFX, ambience, royalty-free music, VO levelled to -14 LUFS

•  3 vertical Shorts cuts (45–60s) pulled from strongest items

•  Source project file + character/asset library

• Two revision rounds included per video



WHAT YOU NEED



MUST HAVE:

• After Effects (rigging, cut-out animation, expressions)

• Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

• Portfolio: minimum 60+ seconds of long-form animated work (not just shorts/TikToks)

• Ability to source, treat, and integrate archival material correctly

• Working English to read scripts and understand tone

• Reliable weekly turnaround: script + VO delivered Monday ? final cut Thursday



NICE TO HAVE:

• Illustrator or Procreate for original assets

• Experience on faceless/documentary YouTube channels

• Understanding of pacing and retention mechanics









HOW TO APPLY



Send the following in your application message:



1. Link to ONE 60+ second animated piece with timestamp (e.g., "0:30–1:45")

   — Tell us what you did and why you're proud of it



2. Answer this question (2–3 sentences):

   "I have 12 items, each 90 seconds, hard cuts between them. Each item escalates then ends with a dry joke. I'm mixing archival photos with 2D animation so they look integrated, not pasted. What's the biggest technical challenge in pulling this off?"



3. Your rate per finished minute + your usual turnaround time for a 22-minute animated piece



4. Include the word "gong farmer" somewhere in your message

   (This tells us you actually read the job post.)



DO NOT APPLY IF:



•  Your portfolio is only shorts, TikToks, or Reels

•  You don't have After Effects

•  You're looking for hourly rates (this is per-video only)

•  You can't commit to a paid test project first

• You need turnarounds longer than 5 days



WHY THIS STRUCTURE MATTERS



The hard cuts, visual frequency, and deflation beats are the format. Generic editors will add transitions, slow down the pacing, or skip the comic timing. If you don't think in terms of retention, escalation, and deliberate composition, this isn't the fit.



TIMELINE



• Applications reviewed continuously

• Shortlisted candidates: invited to paid test within 2–3 days

• Test turnaround: 48 hours

• Video 1 starts: week you pass the test

title: Subscription Retention Consultant — DTC Supplements
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $800 – $1,500 USD/month depending on experience, plus a bonus tied to the churn you actually remove.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your portfolio — that is where we want them. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We sell supplements on a subscription. We are good at acquiring customers. We are not good at keeping them, and we know it: a large share of our subscribers write in to cancel before their second charge, and we are losing money we already paid to acquire.



That is this job. You own retention. Not the tickets — the numbers behind them. You d
 what we say when someone wants to leave, what we offer, when we offer it, and what we change upstream so they stop wanting to leave in the first place.



We are hiring for judgment, not for tasks. You have done this at a subscription brand before and you know what works because you watched it work.



Your work



1. Find out why they leave, with evidence. Read the cancellation reasons, the support inbox, the refund requests, the chargebacks. Group them. Tell us the three real reasons people churn, ranked by how much money each one costs us. Not opinions — counts.



2. Build the cancellation flow. What we ask, in what order, what we offer against each reason. Pause, skip, change frequency, downsize the order, one-time discount, product swap. You d
 the ladder and where the discount sits in it, because a discount given too early is margin we never get back.



3. Fix the money we lose silently. Failed payments and dunning. Card updates. Retry logic. Most subscription brands lose more subscribers to a declined card than to an actual decision to quit, and nobody notices because nobody complains.



4. Work the first 60 days. The subscriber who cancels before charge two never got the product to work. Onboarding
s, dosage expectations, what to feel and when, proactive check-ins. You write the plan and brief whoever executes it.



5. Win them back. Cancelled subscribers are the cheapest customers we will ever have. Build the sequence that brings a share of them back.



6. Report what you changed and what it did. Churn by cohort, retention curve by month, LTV, save rate on cancellation requests, recovered failed payments. Monthly, in numbers, with what you will do next.



What we need from you



You have run retention for a subscription DTC brand. Not "I did support at a brand that had subscriptions" — you owned the churn number and you were judged on it.



You know the tools properly: Recharge, Skio, Bold, Loop or similar, and the
 side (Klaviyo or equivalent). You have configured them, not just used them.



You can read a cohort. If we hand you six months of subscriber data, you can tell us where the drop happens and what it is worth.



You have opinions about save offers, and you can defend them. When to pause instead of discount. When a refund is cheaper than a chargeback. When to let someone go.



You write clearly. The
s and flows you design are read by customers, so the words matter.



You have seen this before at another brand. We are not the first place where you learn this.



Nice to have



Supplements, health or wellness specifically. Experience setting up a support function from scratch — helpdesk, macros, refund policy, SOPs. Managing or training support agents. Chargeback dispute experience.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer



A stable, long-term, full-time position.

Real ownership of the number. You d
 the offers and the flows. No committee.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager.

Paid trial first: we give you our real cancellation reasons and subscriber data for one brand. You come back with the three biggest leaks, what you would build first, and what you expect it to be worth. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.

title: Video Editor – AI Video Generation Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Video Editor specialized in AI Video Generation to join our creative team. This role is ideal for someone who already has experience with video editing and has started exploring AI tools for creating visuals, scenes, and complete video sequences.



You’ll work on turning scripts and creative concepts into engaging videos by combining traditional video editing skills with AI-powered video generation.



What You’ll Do:



- Edit videos and assemble footage into polished, engaging final outputs

- Create AI-generated visuals and video clips based on scripts and creative briefs

- Write, test, and refine prompts to achieve the desired visual results

- Use AI tools to generate different shots, scenes, characters, environments, and other visual elements

- Select and refine AI-generated outputs to maintain consistency and quality throughout a video

- Combine AI-generated content with traditional footage, graphics, voiceovers, music, and other elements

- Experiment with different AI video generation techniques and workflows

- Collaborate with the creative team to develop visual concepts and bring ideas to life



What We’re Looking For:



- Experience as a video editor

- Hands-on experience with AI video generation

- Some experience writing prompts for AI image or video generation

- Good understanding of video editing, pacing, composition, and visual storytelling

- Strong creative judgment and attention to detail

- Willingness to experiment and learn new AI tools and workflows

- Ability to follow scripts, creative briefs, and brand guidelines

* Able to work independently and meet deadlines



Tools & Workflow:



Experience with AI video tools such as Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora, or similar platforms is a plus.



Experience with editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut is also preferred.



We also have our own AI video generation app, which you’ll be able to use as part of your workflow. You won’t be expected to know the app beforehand. We’ll provide access and guidance, so what matters most is that you already understand the basics of video editing, prompting, and AI-generated content.



Who This Role Is For:



This is a great fit for a video editor who is interested in AI and already has some experience experimenting with AI-generated videos.



You don’t need to be an AI expert or an advanced prompt engineer. We’re looking for someone who understands video, has some hands-on AI experience, and is excited to develop their skills as AI becomes a bigger part of video production.



To apply, please send:



- Your video editing portfolio

- Examples of any AI-generated videos you’ve created

- A brief description of the AI tools you’ve used and your experience with prompting



We’re especially interested in seeing how you combine AI-generated content with strong editing and storytelling.

title: Part-Time Etsy App VA – Testing, Research and Content
description:

Knowledge of Etsy Listing Management essential.

Website:

App Testing

Identify bugs and explain clearly how they occurred

Check whether instructions and interfaces are easy to understand

Record screenshots or short screen recordings when useful

Documentation and Content

Turn technical updates into simple “What’s New” announcements

Research common problems experienced by Etsy sellers

Creating simple Canva graphics

Turning app features or Etsy tips into short posts

Helping prepare basic demonstration videos or screen recordings

Maintaining realistic listings and data in designated test shops

Who I’m Looking For

The most important qualities are:

Genuine hands-on experience with Etsy listings

Excellent attention to detail

Good written and spoken English

Ability to describe problems clearly

Reliability and willingness to learn

Confidence using web applications and learning new software

Willingness to give honest feedback rather than simply saying everything looks good

What practical experience do you have managing Etsy listings?

How many hours per week are you available?

What computer, operating system and main browser do you use?

Please include the words “Cayana VA” at the beginning of your application so I know you have read the complete description.

title: Meta Ads Manager + Creative Strategist | Ecommerce | Part-Time
description:
We are a growing North American ecommerce children's brand looking for a long-term Meta Ads Manager + Creative Strategist.



This is not just a media buying role. We need someone who can own the full process:



Performance data > diagnosis > strategy > creative concepts > ad creation > testing > optimization.



You should be able to look at our account and proactively tell us what's happening, why, what we should do next, and what creative needs to be made.



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Manage and optimize Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads

* Recommend when to increase, decrease or reallocate budgets

* Identify winning and underperforming ads and when to scale, pause or continue testing

* Manage prospecting and retargeting strategy

* Analyze ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, frequency and ecommerce funnel performance

* Develop structured creative testing strategies across hooks, messaging, formats, audiences and offers

* Analyze video performance and identify hook, retention, click and conversion problems

* Proactively identify creative gaps and what needs to be made next

* Create specific creative concepts, hooks, messaging and briefs

* Personally edit and create Meta video ads using our existing UGC, product videos, founder footage, photography and other assets

* Create recuts, new hooks, text overlays, captions, CTAs and creative variations

* Create simple static/graphic ads when needed

* Identify when new UGC or footage is required and brief our team accordingly

* Monitor creative fatigue and prepare new iterations before performance declines

* Review the funnel from click > add to cart > checkout > purchase

* Plan advertising around launches, promotions, seasonality and different geographic markets

* Provide weekly reporting explaining what happened, what we learned and exactly what should happen next



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



* Strong hands-on Meta Ads experience

* Ecommerce/DTC experience

* Strong creative strategy skills

* Short-form video ad editing experience

* Ability to turn raw footage into finished Meta ads

* Strong understanding of profitable ROAS and CPA, not just engagement or CTR

* Experience with structured A/B and creative testing

* Shopify experience

* Strong communication and analytical skills

* Proactive and able to work independently



Experience with Klaviyo, GA4, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva or Adobe tools is a plus.



We are a bootstrapped business, so profitability and efficient use of ad spend matter. We don't want someone who simply launches campaigns, sends reports, or tells us to "make more creatives."



We want someone who can diagnose the problem and give us specific actions. For example: keep the winning hook, shorten the middle, move the product reveal earlier, test two new CTAs, and explain why.



This is a part-time remote position with the potential for a long-term relationship.



TO APPLY



Please complete our application form:







Applications without a completed form will not be reviewed. The application includes real Meta Ads scenarios because we care more about how you think and solve problems than a generic cover letter.

title: Direct Response Video Editor (VSL Specialist)

As the brand scales, the people who came in early get the first shot at bigger roles, more responsibility, and leadership positions down the line.



When I grow, you grow. That's the deal.



Your responsibilities



- Primary focus: long-form VSLs (2+ minutes) — structuring hook → problem → agitation → solution → proof → offer, with pacing that holds attention across multiple minutes, not just 15-second hooks

- Solid written and spoken English

- Proven experience editing direct response VSLs that convert — not just short-form social cuts

- Intent-driven editing: every hook, cut, and caption has a purpose, sustained across a long runtime

- Familiarity with AI video tools (Higgsfield, Freepik, ElevenLabs, HeyGen)

- Editing speed

- You actually care if your ad performed or not



The details:



Rate: $3.50/hour

Hours: Per-project / flexible to start, with room to grow into steady weekly hours

Payment: Weekly via Wise



How to apply:



- A short intro about yourself

- Links to 3 of your best edits — at least one should be a VSL of 2+ minutes

- The software you use and your years of experience

- Your favorite ecom brand's VSL or long-form ad, and why it works

- Your weekly availability



Bonus points for a quick Loom video introducing yourself — not required, but it stands out.

title: Sports "Top 5" Video Editor (Faceless TikTok, 65s Vertical)
description:
We run a faceless sports page on TikTok and need a dedicated editor turning our scripts and voiceovers into 3 finished videos a day.



The format: "Top 5" countdown series — one rank per video, five videos per series, around 65 seconds of fast, stat-heavy voiceover over archive clips. Mostly football, with series covering NBA, NHL, MLB, Olympics and esports. Reference standard (study before applying): 
 — opens on the athlete not a title card, a cut on every new fact, rank number on screen at the start, word-synced white captions with black outline and stats popped in yellow, hype beat underneath, voiceover on top.



We supply, every day: the script (athlete, rank number, every stat mentioned), the voiceover MP3, the series name and the thumbnail template. You supply the footage, the edit and the thumbnail.



Scope:

1. Source archive or broadcast clips of the athlete in the exact moment the voiceover describes.

2. Cut on every new fact, roughly every 2.5 seconds. Nothing sits longer than 3 seconds.

3. Rank number on screen for the first 3 seconds. Every stat in the voiceover gets its own number on screen.

4. Word-synced captions, bold sans-serif, white with black outline, numbers and stats highlighted in yellow.

5. Thumbnail in our template (athlete face, TOP 5, rank badge). Caption style, colours and thumbnail layout stay identical across all five videos in a series — it should look like a set.

6. Deliver MP4 + project file + thumbnail to Google Drive. No intros, logos or watermarks.



Volume: 3 videos a day, 6 days a week. Scripts and audio arrive daily; that day's 3 are due within 24 hours.



Requirements: CapCut or Premiere Pro; ability to track down clips across football, basketball, hockey, baseball and the Olympics quickly; portfolio with 3-5 short-form vertical examples (links, sports or caption-heavy work preferred); reliable internet; sustained output of 3 a day after the first week.



Paid test task: we send one script + voiceover from a live series; deliver the finished video and thumbnail within 48 hours. We judge clip selection and stat placement as much as editing. Paid regardless of outcome.



Pay: $4 per video, or $360/month at 3 a day. Rises based on editing quality after your first 20.



How to apply — video required:

Record a 60-90 second phone video (no editing needed) and paste the link (Drive, Loom or unlisted YouTube) in your application, covering:

1. Who you are and where you're based.

2. How the reference video handles captions, cut pacing and on-screen stats.

3. Three sports besides football you could source clips for and where you'd find them.

4. Talk through one vertical video from your portfolio — software used, time taken, where the clips came from.

5. Confirm you can do 3 a day at $4 per video, rising with quality.



Application filter: Start your written application with the word COUNTDOWN, then tell us in one sentence what rank the reference video's athlete is given. Applications missing the video link, the portfolio links, or either filter will not be read.

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description:
*Creative Strategist ONLY for this role - not video editors or copywriters*





We are looking for a Creative Strategist to help scale the performance creative engine of a fast-growing DTC beauty brand primarily serving the US market.

This role is responsible for driving creative strategy end-to-end — from deep customer and market research, identifying new growth opportunities, developing creative hypotheses, creating high-quality briefs, analyzing performance insights, and building a scalable creative testing system.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically, understand consumer psychology, and consistently generate winning creative directions — not just write scripts.



Key Responsibilities

- Conduct deep customer, competitor, and market research to uncover new creative opportunities, winning angles, and growth insights.



- Develop creative strategies, hypotheses, concepts, hooks, and iterations based on customer psychology, market trends, and performance data.



- Create high-quality creative briefs to support a high-volume creative testing pipeline and increase creative velocity across video, UGC, and static ads.



- Analyze creative performance, identify winning patterns, and translate learnings into scalable creative frameworks and iteration strategies.



- Build and improve creative strategy processes, SOPs, and systems to create a repeatable testing engine.



- Collaborate closely with media buyers, designers, editors, and creators to execute and optimize performance creatives.



Requirements

- 2+ years of experience as a Creative Strategist / Performance Creative Strategist for DTC ecommerce brands.



- Strong experience with Meta Ads creative strategy and direct-response marketing.



- Proven experience developing creatives that drive measurable business results, not just engagement.



- Strong understanding of customer psychology, creative testing frameworks, and performance metrics.



- Experience researching markets, competitors, and customer insights to generate new creative directions.



- Ability to analyze why creatives win or lose and turn insights into actionable iterations.



- Experience working with beauty or skincare DTC brands is highly preferred.



- Experience building creative systems, workflows, or SOPs is a strong plus. 



- Experience managing creative strategy for brands with personally attributed ad spend no less than $200K+/month on paid social is highly preferred.



Why Join Us

- Long-term opportunity: with the potential to transition into a long-term full-time contractor role based on mutual fit and performance.



- High ownership & impact: Work directly with the founder and core team to shape the creative strategy and growth direction of a fast-growing DTC brand.





Type: long-term contract, full-time (40 hours per week)



Location: fully remote



How to apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, include the following:



1. Please share one creative brief you personally created. Ideally it is the ads that you personally conceptualized that scaled in your past roles, and tell us the angle behind and why you believe it worked.



2. Please share one real example of a creative you personally took from research and briefing through live results, learnings, and the next iteration.



3. In a typical week, how many production-ready creative briefs can you independently deliver, and how many asset variations does each brief usually produce? 



4. Your availability and your rate.



Applications without a specific angle in point 1 and 2 will not be reviewed.
