title: Marketing Technology & Web Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are a growing US-based healthcare organization looking for a hands-on Marketing Technology & Web Specialist to join our team full-time.



This person will be the primary technical resource for our marketing team. You will report directly to the CMO and be responsible for implementing and maintaining the technology behind our websites, landing pages, forms, tracking, attribution, and marketing integrations.



This is a hands-on role. We need someone who can take a request and actually implement it, whether that means modifying a Webflow form, building a landing page, fixing a tracking pixel, connecting a new marketing platform, configuring a subdomain, or troubleshooting why attribution data is missing.



You will also work directly with our vendors and other specialists when systems connect. For example, you may work with our call-tracking provider’s engineers to complete an integration, meet with our paid media team to troubleshoot conversion tracking, or work with our CRM & Automation Specialist to make sure lead data is passing correctly into our internal systems.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Websites, Forms & Landing Pages



* Maintain and update our Webflow website

* Build and modify pages, forms, fields, dropdowns, and other website elements

* Build, duplicate, and modify landing pages in Unbounce

* Implement technical and layout changes for conversion-rate tests

* Ensure pages and forms work properly across desktop and mobile

* Maintain existing designs and styling provided by our creative team

* Monitor and improve page performance and load speed

* Troubleshoot website and form issues



Marketing Tracking & Attribution



* Configure, test, and maintain Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, GA4, and other marketing tracking

* Manage our Google Tag Manager environment

* Audit and troubleshoot tags, triggers, variables, data layers, and tracking scripts

* Identify duplicate, conflicting, or broken tracking

* Verify that forms, phone calls, and other conversions are attributed to the correct sources and campaigns

* Troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising platforms and actual leads

* Make sure new pages, forms, and campaigns launch with the appropriate tracking in place



Call Tracking & Marketing Integrations



* Maintain the technical side of our WhatConverts call-tracking and attribution setup

* Manage Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI) and related tracking

* Connect and configure new marketing tools and integrations

* Work directly with software vendors and their technical teams when needed

* Implement required changes on our side of integrations

* Test integrations to verify that data is flowing correctly in both directions

* Troubleshoot UTMs, GCLIDs, lead IDs, webhooks, forms, and other attribution data



Experience with WhatConverts specifically is not required if you have experience with similar platforms such as CallRail and can learn new systems quickly.



Working With Our Other Specialists



You will work closely with our paid media team, creative agency, software vendors, and CRM & Automation Specialist.



We have a separate CRM & Automation Specialist responsible for ClickUp, Make, Zapier, lead routing, internal workflows, and backend automations. You will not be responsible for taking over that role.



Where the systems connect, you will work together. For example, if a Webflow form captures a UTM parameter but it does not appear correctly in our CRM, you may troubleshoot the website and tracking side while the CRM & Automation Specialist checks the backend automation and field mapping.



Similarly, our paid media partners manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns. You will not manage the campaigns themselves, but you will work with them to make sure the technical tracking supporting those campaigns is implemented and working correctly.



Our creative partners handle primary branding and graphic design. You should be able to implement and modify existing designs, but you do not need to be a graphic designer.



Must-Have Skills



* Webflow: Strong hands-on experience with Webflow, including forms, CMS, responsive layouts, styling, and modifying existing websites

* Google Tag Manager: Strong experience with tags, triggers, variables, custom events, data layers, Preview Mode, and debugging

* Conversion Tracking: Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and GA4 tracking

* Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to investigate technical problems, identify the root cause, implement a solution, and verify that it works

* Marketing Integrations: Comfortable working with forms, webhooks, attribution data, tracking scripts, and connections between marketing platforms

* English Communication: Strong written and spoken English. You must be comfortable speaking directly with the CMO, vendors, developers, and other technical specialists



Strongly Preferred



* Unbounce

* JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

* Chrome DevTools or similar browser debugging tools

* Cloudflare and DNS management

* WhatConverts, CallRail, or other DNI/call-tracking platforms

* Experience with UTMs, GCLIDs, and marketing attribution

* API and webhook integrations

* Experience troubleshooting website-to-CRM data flows



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically curious, and takes ownership.



If the CMO asks you to modify a form, you should be able to make the change. If a tracking pixel is not working, you should be able to investigate it. If a new platform needs to be integrated, you should be able to implement the technical work on our side and work directly with the platform’s engineers when necessary.



You are not replacing our paid media team, CRM & Automation Specialist, or creative agency. You are the technical person on the marketing team who makes sure the technology they depend on works correctly.



How to Apply



Please include a brief 5–8 sentence answer to the following scenario in your application:



Imagine you are auditing our Google Ads tracking and suspect that our lead conversion tag is double-counting conversions, causing Google Ads to report more leads than we are actually receiving. Describe the exact step-by-step process you would use to determine whether duplicate conversions are actually firing on the website, what you would examine to identify the root cause, and how you would verify that the issue has been resolved.



Applications that do not answer the screening scenario will not be considered.

Turning one clip into many

Consistency and fast turnaround

title: Grants Coordinator
description:
Location: Remote – HQ in Irvine, CA (Pacific Time Zone preferred)

Position Type: Part Time - Independent Contractor

Hours: 20 hours / 40 hours per week

Compensation: $8/hour



About Us



The Black Girls Mental Health Foundation (BGMHF) is a nonprofit dedicated to eliminating mental health disparities through culturally responsive, trauma-informed care. Our work bridges the gap between perinatal mental health care and racial equity by connecting BIPOC birthing individuals, particularly Black mothers, to high-quality mental health services, trusted providers, and community-rooted support networks.



Together with our sister organization, the Black Girls Mental Health Collective, we deliver direct clinical services, train birth and mental health professionals, and advocate for systemic transformation. Our flagship initiative, the BIRTH Network, has supported over 127 families and provided more than 660 hours of culturally affirming therapy to date. With over 30 years of collective experience, our leadership team brings both research expertise and lived experience to the forefront of maternal mental health advocacy.



Position Overview



The Virtual Assistant (VA) Grant Project Manager keeps Black Girls Mental Health Foundation (BGMHF) on track across the full grant lifecycle; from proposal development through budget tracking, report submission, and program implementation. This role is responsible for monitoring every grant requirement and deadline in ClickUp, sending timely nudges to the staff and program leads responsible for each deliverable, and maintaining a clear, organized view of what's due, what's at risk, and what's complete across all active grants. This is a remote, detail-oriented role suited to someone who is proactive, highly organized, and comfortable holding people accountable to deadlines in a warm, professional way.



Primary Responsibilities

-  Track grant proposal deadlines and requirements in ClickUp, monitoring status from draft through submission.

-  Monitor grant budget deliverables and timelines, flagging upcoming due dates for financial documentation and spend tracking.

-  Track grant report submission deadlines (interim, final, and funder-specific reporting requirements) and confirm reports are filed on time.

-  Monitor program implementation milestones tied to each grant, ensuring activities stay aligned with funder timelines and requirements.

-  Maintain a master tracker in ClickUp of all active grants, requirements, owners, and due dates across proposals, budgets, reports, and program deliverables.

-  Send timely nudges and follow-up reminders to team members and program leads on upcoming or overdue grant deliverables.

-  Flag at-risk deadlines or missing documentation to leadership before they become compliance issues.

-  Set up new grant projects, tasks, and workflows in ClickUp based on award letters, funder guidelines, and direction from leadership.

-  Prepare regular grant status updates and progress summaries for leadership review.

-  Coordinate with the Operations, Finance, and Programs teams to clarify deliverable ownership, timelines, and next steps.

-  Maintain organized digital records of grant requirements, submission confirmations, and correspondence.

-  Other duties as assigned.

 

Ideal Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated experience with ClickUp (or a comparable project management platform), including task tracking, due dates, and status updates

Experience tracking grant requirements, deliverables, or compliance deadlines

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple grants, funders, and deadlines at once

Excellent written communication skills, with a professional and friendly tone for deliverable follow-ups

Self-starter who can monitor progress and follow up consistently with minimal oversight

Comfortable respectfully holding team members and program leads accountable to deadlines

Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

Experience supporting a nonprofit's grants, programs, or operations

Familiarity with common funder requirements (proposal narratives, budget templates, interim/final reporting)

Experience working with cross-functional teams (Operations, Finance, Programs)

Comfort with basic budget tracking or reading a grant budget line-item

Prior virtual assistant or remote administrative support experience

Work Environment & Contractor Terms

This is a fully remote position. The Accounting Assistant must have a reliable internet connection, a private workspace suitable for handling confidential financial information, and the ability to meet recurring bi-weekly payroll deadlines.



CONFIDENTIALITY

This role requires access to sensitive financial and personnel information. The Program Manager must maintain strict confidentiality regarding payroll, vendor, and organizational financial matters at all times.



How to Apply

Please
 your resume, brief portfolio (or examples of prior work), and a one-paragraph cover note to 
 with the subject line: Grants Coordinator Application - [Your Name]. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis through September 2026.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Laravel + React) - AI-Powered Development

We are looking for a senior, high-output Full Stack Developer who leverages AI coding tools to build at exceptional speed. You will work on the Archimedes project using Laravel and React, and you are expected to produce large volumes of production-quality code daily using AI-assisted development (vibe coding).



This is NOT a traditional development role. We need someone who has fully embraced AI-powered coding workflows — using tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar — to write hundreds to thousands of lines of clean, working code per day. If you are not already using AI tools daily in your development workflow, this role is not for you.

- Develop full-stack web applications using Laravel (backend) and React (frontend)

- Strong software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, system architecture

- You use AI for: scaffolding, boilerplate, test generation, refactoring, documentation

- Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace

- Must currently use AI coding tools in daily work (we will verify this)

- Competitive salary: $1,000 - $1,500/month

- Full-time remote position

- Long-term engagement with growth opportunities

- International team working on cutting-edge AI-powered workflows

- Access to premium AI tools (Cursor Pro, Claude Pro, etc.)



SELECTION PROCESS:

HOW TO APPLY:

- Which AI tools do you use daily?

We're a D2C e-commerce brand in the women's health space. We sell a product that genuinely helps people, and every piece of content we produce reflects that. No misleading claims. No bait-and-switch.



We're into a 5-year vision. We're scaling aggressively in the English-speaking market, and we need editors who grow with us, not editors who disappear when a bigger project comes along, and not a company that goes quiet after 3 months because the brand didn't work out.



We're in this for the long game. We want you to be too.



- THE ROLE:



Position: Direct Response VSL Video Editor (Health/Pain Relief Specialist)

Commitment: Full-time, long-term (this is not a freelance gig)

Compensation: $1,000-$1,250 monthly + performance bonuses

Location: 100% remote

Hours: 40h/week

Market: English-speaking



- WHAT LONG-TERM ACTUALLY MEANS HERE:



- Year-over-year salary increases of 10–20% for strong performers

- Performance bonuses tied directly to VSL and ad conversion rates

- Creative ownership, you won't be executing someone else's vision blindly. You'll understand the strategy, the avatar, the psychology behind every piece of content

- A real team, you'll work closely with the founder and marketing lead, not get lost in a ticket queue



- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Non-negotiable:



- 2+ years editing Direct Response VSLs ads (health/women's wellness a strong plus)

- Proven retention, you understand why a cut happens at second 4, not just how to make it

- Proficiency in CapCut

title: Sales & Office Assistant
description:
We’re looking for a driven, organized, and confident professional to become a key part of our team and the right-hand person to our General Manager.



This is a hands-on role for someone who has strong phone and communication skills, a sales background, excellent organizational abilities, and the ability to take ownership. The primary goal of this position is simple: help take the day-to-day workload off the GM’s plate so they can focus on growing the business.



You will play an important role in keeping the office organized, following up with leads and customers, managing tasks through our CRM, tracking important business data, and making sure opportunities don’t fall through the cracks.



What You’ll Do

Follow up with leads by phone,
, and other communication channels.

Make outbound calls and confidently communicate with potential and existing customers.

Use our CRM system to track leads, follow-ups, appointments, customer activity, and results.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer and lead information.

Track sales activity, lead activity, follow-up results, and other key business data.

Prepare and maintain basic reports and summaries for the GM.

Monitor data and identify trends, missed opportunities, and areas that need attention.

Help manage the day-to-day operations of the office.

Keep the GM organized and assist with administrative and operational tasks.

Take ownership of assigned projects and see them through to completion.

Monitor open tasks and follow up with team members when needed.

Help ensure leads and opportunities are properly followed up with.

Schedule appointments and coordinate communication with customers and team members.

Identify things that need to be done and take action without always waiting to be asked.

Help improve office processes, organization, tracking, and efficiency.

Serve as a reliable point person who helps keep the business moving.

What We’re Looking For

The right person will be proactive, dependable, confident, organized, and comfortable taking ownership.



You should have:



Strong phone and communication skills.

Clear, professional spoken English and the ability to communicate effectively with customers and team members.

Previous sales, customer service, or inside sales experience.

Confidence speaking with customers and prospects over the phone.

Experience working with a CRM or willingness to learn quickly.

Strong data entry, tracking, and organizational skills.

The ability to accurately track information and maintain clean, reliable data.

Strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.

The ability to prioritize multiple tasks and stay on top of deadlines.

A positive, professional attitude.

The ability to work independently and solve problems.

A sense of urgency and a willingness to get things done.

The Person Who Will Succeed in This Role

You’re the type of person who sees something that needs to be done and takes care of it.



You don’t need to be told three times to follow up with a customer or update the CRM. You keep your commitments, stay organized, communicate clearly, track the details, and understand that missed calls, missed follow-ups, inaccurate data, and unfinished tasks can cost a business money.



Most importantly, you understand that your job is to make the GM’s job easier.



As you learn the business, we want you to become someone the GM can trust to handle more and more of the day-to-day responsibilities, allowing them to spend more time focused on sales, strategy, and growing the company.



Why This Role Matters

This is more than an administrative position. You will have a direct impact on the growth, organization, sales follow-up, and efficiency of the business.



If you are someone who enjoys being busy, likes working with people, is comfortable on the phone, pays attention to the numbers, and wants an opportunity to take on more responsibility, this could be a great fit.



We’re looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make a difference, and grow with the company.

title: Illustrator / Artist – Folk Art, Block Print & Hand-Drawn Style | Ongoing Work
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based quilting and fabric company looking for a talented illustrator/artist to help us develop an original collection of artwork for merchandise and other products.



This is not a typical Canva or graphic-design position. We are looking for someone who is genuinely talented at illustration and has a strong artistic point of view.



Our preferred aesthetic is inspired by vintage American and Scandinavian folk art, block printing, linocut, hand-stamped artwork, vintage textiles and surface-pattern design.



We love artwork that feels handmade rather than digitally perfect—stylized florals and botanicals, birds, vines, decorative motifs, expressive hand lettering, simplified shapes, imperfect lines, subtle texture and interesting use of color.



Think traditional folk art and block-printed artwork interpreted in a fresh, feminine and modern way.



We will provide inspiration images that demonstrate the overall aesthetic we love. These images are for creative direction only. We do not want existing artwork copied, traced or recreated. Our goal is to develop an original and recognizable visual identity for our own brand.



Our First Collections



Our initial artwork will center around two primary themes:



QUILTING, SEWING & MAKING



We will create artwork around phrases celebrating quilting, sewing, creativity and handmade things. Examples might include:



* “Every Quilt Has a Story”

* “Gather the Pieces, Make Something Beautiful”

* “There Is Joy in the Making”

* “Made by Hand, Made with Heart”



FAITH & VINTAGE HYMNS



We also plan to develop a collection based on traditional Christian hymns and public-domain hymn lyrics. Examples might include:



* “It Is Well with My Soul”

* “Amazing Grace, How Sweet the Sound”

* “Come Thou Fount of Every Blessing”

* “Blessed Assurance”



We will provide all phrases and approved hymn lyrics. You will not be responsible for researching copyright.



What You’ll Create



Initially, designs will primarily be created for apparel, but successful artwork may also be adapted for:



* T-shirts and sweatshirts

* Tote and project bags

* Stickers

* Quilt labels

* Mugs and other merchandise

* Art prints

* Packaging and marketing materials

* Other products as our collections grow



We would love to find an illustrator who can work with us long-term and help establish a cohesive artistic identity across multiple collections.



Surface-pattern or textile-design experience is a plus and could lead to additional opportunities in the future.



The Style We Love



We are especially drawn to:



* Folk-art illustration

* American and Scandinavian folk-art influences

* Block-print and linocut-inspired artwork

* Hand-stamped texture

* Imperfect, hand-created edges and lines

* Vintage textile and surface-pattern influences

* Stylized florals, botanicals, leaves, birds and nature

* Expressive hand lettering and typography

* Decorative and sometimes symmetrical compositions

* Warm, interesting and slightly muted color palettes

* Artwork that feels collected, handmade and timeless



We are NOT looking for:



Generic POD/T-shirt graphics, rustic farmhouse signs, Canva-style graphics, corporate vector artwork, stock illustrations, copied artwork or AI-generated designs.



You do not need to physically carve blocks or create traditional linocuts. Digital illustration is completely acceptable. We are describing the visual character and handmade quality we want the finished artwork to have.



The Person We’re Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



* Are an illustrator/artist first, rather than solely a graphic designer

* Can draw original botanical, floral and decorative elements

* Have a strong understanding of composition

* Have excellent typography or hand-lettering instincts

* Can interpret a phrase creatively instead of simply placing decorations around text

* Understand vintage, folk-art and handmade aesthetics

* Can maintain a cohesive style across a collection

* Can prepare professional artwork for commercial printing

* Communicate well and are comfortable receiving creative feedback

* Are interested in ongoing creative work



Experience with Procreate, Adobe Illustrator and/or Photoshop is helpful.



Artwork Requirements



Final deliverables will generally include:



* High-resolution 300 DPI artwork

* Transparent-background PNG suitable for commercial printing

* Print-ready files suitable for DTF/apparel production

* Editable/source files when applicable (AI, PSD, Procreate, SVG, etc.)

* Additional color versions when requested



All commissioned artwork must be original artwork created by you.



Approved commissioned artwork will require commercial merchandise usage rights for our company. Specific ownership/usage terms and payment will be agreed upon before commissioned work begins.



Paid Trial



We plan to select a small number of promising applicants for a paid trial project.



Selected artists will receive the same phrase and general creative brief. We intentionally will not tell you exactly what to draw.



We want to see how you interpret the concept—your composition, illustration style, typography and artistic instincts.



We do not ask applicants to create free sample artwork.



The artist who best fits our vision will be offered additional paid projects, with the potential for an ongoing relationship as we develop new collections.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words FOLK ART so we know you have read the entire job description.



Then please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your illustration experience.

2. 3–5 examples of your own original artwork that are closest to the aesthetic described above. Please do not send a large generic graphic-design portfolio.

3. Tell us which programs or techniques you use to create your illustrations.

4. Tell us whether you use AI-generated imagery at any point in your illustration process.

5. Tell us about any experience you have with folk art, block-print/linocut styles, hand lettering, surface-pattern design, textiles or apparel artwork.

6. Your desired hourly rate and/or typical price for a completed illustration of this type.

7. Approximately how much time you would expect to spend creating a detailed finished illustration combining hand lettering and botanical/folk-art elements.

8. Tell us why this particular project and aesthetic interest you.



Please do not create new artwork or a free sample as part of your application. Portfolio examples are all we need at this stage.



We are excited to find an artist whose work we love and hopefully build a long-term creative partnership.

title: Video Editor - Remote
description:
Please follow the application instructions below



Role Overview



We are looking for a highly creative Video Editor who can transform raw footage into compelling, story-driven content that captures attention and keeps audiences engaged. This role goes beyond adding transitions and effects—we're looking for someone who understands pacing, emotion, narrative flow, and visual storytelling.



The ideal candidate has experience creating engaging content for social media, YouTube, advertisements, and branded campaigns, with a strong portfolio that demonstrates storytelling ability rather than purely motion graphics or visual effects.



Key Responsibilities

Video Editing & Storytelling



Edit high-quality videos for social media, YouTube, websites, and digital advertising.

Craft compelling stories through pacing, sequencing, music, sound design, and visual composition.

Transform raw footage into engaging content that connects emotionally with viewers.

Maintain strong narrative structure while aligning with brand messaging and campaign goals.

Select the best shots, B-roll, music, and transitions to maximize viewer retention.



Creative Direction



Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop concepts and video ideas.

Suggest creative improvements that elevate the quality of each project.

Maintain consistency in visual style and brand identity across all content.

Understand audience behavior and optimize edits for engagement.



Social Media Content



Create short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.

Repurpose long-form videos into multiple engaging short clips.

Add captions, motion graphics, and subtitles where appropriate.

Optimize videos for different platforms and aspect ratios.



Post-Production



Perform color correction and basic color grading.

Mix and enhance audio for professional-quality output.

Organize project files and maintain an efficient editing workflow.

Deliver projects on schedule while managing multiple deadlines.



Required Skills & Experience

Technical Requirements



Proven professional experience as a Video Editor.

Strong portfolio showcasing storytelling-focused edits, not just visual effects.

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent software.

Experience with Adobe After Effects for motion graphics is an advantage.

Understanding of video formats, codecs, exporting, and platform optimization.



Creative Skills



Excellent sense of pacing, rhythm, emotion, and narrative structure.

Strong understanding of cinematic storytelling and audience engagement.

Ability to choose music, sound effects, and visuals that enhance emotional impact.

Knowledge of composition, framing, and visual flow.



Professional Skills



Strong attention to detail.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Ability to accept creative feedback and iterate quickly.

Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely.



Nice to Have



Experience creating viral social media content.

Experience editing podcasts, interviews, documentaries, or branded storytelling videos.

Basic animation or motion graphics experience.

Experience using AI-assisted editing tools.

Familiarity with content performance metrics and retention strategies.



What We Offer



Competitive salary package.

Long-term remote opportunity.

Professional growth and development.

Collaborative and supportive team environment.

Opportunity to work on diverse creative projects.

Creative freedom to bring ideas to life.



Application Reminders



To help optimize your application and improve its visibility during our screening process, please make sure to follow the instructions below. A complete and well-structured application may increase your chances of being considered for the role.

title: Real Estate Deal Analyst — Multi-Unit Acquisitions & Development Land
description:
We are a Canadian real-estate firm: we analyse what is on the market, find the deals that actually work, and bring them to a group of investors who buy them. On the development side, investors buy land and retain us to build on it.



  We have built something unusual. Our deal engine pulls the licensed feed and run full development pro formas, financing paths, cost models, returns — and ranks them. It runs unattended while we sleep.



Here is the honest problem, and it is the reason this job exists: that engine is not able to produce a complete deal package. Not because the analysis is wrong. Because the analysis stops at the edge of what public data can tell you. To finish a deal you need the rent roll, the T12, the operating statement, the capex history. Those live in a listing agent's inbox, and somebody has to ask for them, chase them, read them properly, and record them in a separate system. Analyze, package them, and send to our investors. 



That gap is the job.



  What you'll own



  1. The seller side. Contact listing agents on the deals our engine ranks. Request rent rolls, T12s, operating statements, condition and capex history. Chase what doesn't arrive. Read what does and d
 whether it is complete, thin, or evasive.



  2. The underwrite. Put real numbers, supply the per-deal inputs it refuses to invent, and interrogate what comes back. The engine tells you what is still missing — your job is to close that gap or conclude the deal is dead and say why.



  3. The package. Produce the document our investors d
 on: the thesis, the numbers, the risks, the recommendation, the price. 



  4. The buyer side. Answer our investors' questions on the packages you produce — what is in the numbers, what the risks are, what we know and what we don't. Keep that side organised too: who has seen what, who is interested in which lane, who asked what, who is still waiting on you.



  5. Your own record. You bring or build your own way of tracking all of it — deals live, deals dead and why, documents requested and outstanding, investors and their questions. We are not going to hand you a CRM and we do not want to. Bring yours.



  Both lanes from day one: existing multi-unit buildings, and development land.



  What is not yours



  Negotiating price or terms, advising an investor on what to pay, and presenting offers are licensed acts. The owner holds the licence and does those. You gather, organise, analyse, and answer questions about the deal; he advises and trades. We would rather draw that line clearly now than have it blur later.



  Hours 



 
 is asynchronous and so is most of this work. You do not need to work Atlantic Canada hours. There is no graveyard shift. You do need some overlapping hours as you would be expected to call/text people. What matters is that agents and investors get timely, professional replies and that nothing sits for days. 



  What you get



A deal engine that has already done the heavy analytical work, so you are not building models from scratch in a spreadsheet. Claude Code and AI tooling, with the expectation that you automate your own workflow — and we pay for

  what you need. Direct access to the owner, who holds the local domain knowledge and will teach it.



  Who fits



1. You are relentlessly organised, and you build the systems that keep you that way. This is the most important thing on this page. You will be holding three sets of moving parts at once: the deals themselves, the seller side (which agent, which documents asked for, which still outstanding, who has gone quiet), and the buyer side (which investor saw which package, what they asked, what they are waiting on). If any of that lives only in your head or your inbox, this falls apart. We want to see the tracker, CRM or pipeline you have actually built and run.



 2. Real estate transaction experience on the broker side is a major bonus. If you have worked inside a brokerage — transaction management, deal administration, listing or buyer-side support — say so early. You will already know what documents exist, who holds them, and how long they take to prise loose.



3. The mathematics are not the hard part. Cap rates, NOI and a pro forma are arithmetic, and our engine does most of it.What is hard, and what we are actually testing, is whether you can look at a set of numbers and tell that they have been dressed up.



You do not need to know our local market. Our system encodes the local planning rules, financing programs and cost models. The owner holds the rest and will teach it.



You reach for automation by instinct. Not a developer — someone who, handed Claude, builds themselves a system rather than asking for one.



Who doesn't



This is not a virtual assistant, executive assistant, or admin role, and applications framed that way will not be read. If your instinct is to perfect the system before producing output, this will frustrate you — we have a great deal of system and little completed deals, and the balance needs to move the other way. If you pass information along without concluding anything, we have hired that before and will not do it again.



 To apply



  Put HALYARD as the first word of your application. Then three things. Specifics win — generic answers are obvious from a distance.



  1. Your system — the most important answer



  Show us how you have actually organised deals, transactions or a pipeline. Sanitised screenshots or files beat any description. We want to see how you tracked:



  - the deals themselves and their status

  - the counterparty side — who you were chasing, for what, and what was still outstanding

  - the client side — who you had told what, and what they were waiting on



  Then tell us what broke about the first version of it, and what you changed.



  2. The rent roll



  An 8-unit building. Asking $1,450,000. The listing agent sends you this.



  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? Unit ? Type ?         Status         ? In-place rent ? "Market rent" ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 1    ? 2BR  ? Occupied               ? $1,150        ? $2,400        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 2    ? 2BR  ? Occupied               ? $1,205        ? $2,400        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 3    ? 2BR  ? Occupied               ? $1,180        ? $2,400        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 4    ? 2BR  ? Vacant (renovated)     ? —             ? $2,400        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 5    ? 1BR  ? Occupied               ? $950          ? $1,900        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 6    ? 1BR  ? Occupied               ? $975          ? $1,900        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 7    ? 1BR  ? Occupied (owner's son) ? $600          ? $1,900        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

  ? 8    ? 1BR  ? Occupied               ? $2,050        ? $1,900        ?

  ????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



  Seller's annual operating statement:



  Gross potential income (at market)   $205,200

  Vacancy                                     0

  Property taxes                          6,900

  Insurance                               4,200

  Heat & hot water        0  ("tenants pay their own heat")

  Water / sewer                           3,100

  Repairs & maintenance                   2,400

  Management              0  ("owner-managed")

  Reserves / capex                            0

                                      ---------

  Total expenses                        $16,600

  Stated NOI                           $188,600



  Answer four things:



  (a) What is wrong here? List what you spot, most serious first.



  (b) Write the actual
 you would send the listing agent. Not a description of it — the message itself, as you would send it.



  (c) Pursue or kill? If pursue, what would you tell us it is worth and how did you get there. If kill, say what would have to be true to change your mind.



  (d) One of our investors reads your package and asks: "the in-place rents are half of market — why is that not a red flag rather than an opportunity?" Answer them in one short paragraph, in the words you would actually use

  with them.



  3. Development land



  We also buy land for investors to develop. In two or three sentences: what changes about how you underwrite a vacant lot compared with the building in question 2?

title: Financial Controller / Bookkeeping — Xero, Multi-Currency, Shopify + Amazon (US & UK)
description:
Apply through this form: 



We are a football brand selling worldwide. We sell direct to customers through our own Shopify store, and on Amazon in both the United States and the United Kingdom.



We have grown fast and our books have not kept up. We are looking for one person to own the numbers properly — the bookkeeping, and the filing calendar that goes with it.



What you would be doing



Bookkeeping for three channels: our global Shopify store, Amazon US, and Amazon UK

Working across two companies — a US company and a UK company — keeping them completely separate, including sales of stock between them

Recording payouts correctly. Our store sells in euros and our processor pays us in US dollars, so every payout has a currency conversion inside it

Reconciling Shopify, Amazon, PayPal and our bank

Getting freight, duty and landed cost into COGS so we can see real margin

Owning our tax and filing deadlines — knowing what is due, when, in both countries, and making sure it never gets missed. You would prepare and file the UK VAT returns yourself and work with our accountants on the rest

Weekly reconciliation and a clean set of books at the end of every month

You must have



Strong Xero experience, including the UK version

Real multi-currency experience, including gains and losses on exchange

Experience with A2X, Link My Books or a similar tool for Shopify and Amazon payouts

Experience keeping the books for two or more companies separately

Experience with Amazon Seller Central settlement reports

A track record of owning filing deadlines, not just doing the bookkeeping

Good written English

Nice to have



Both US and UK books

UK VAT under Making Tax Digital

Inventory and landed cost experience

Ecommerce clients doing over 10,000 orders a month

The pay: $1,500 – $2,500 USD per month depending on experience. We know that is above the usual range here. It is deliberate — this is a senior job, not data entry, and we want the person who can do all of it.



How to apply



Apply through this form: 



It takes about 20 minutes and asks you to work through three real situations from our books, plus a short Loom introducing yourself. Applications that arrive as a message without the form are not read — the form is how we make sure everyone is judged on the same thing.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial task: reconcile one real month of our sales and fees.



We reply to every application.

title: NOW HIRING: Junior Sales Rep — Remote Staffing (OTE: $1500/month)
description:
NOW HIRING: Junior Sales Rep — Remote Staffing

Remote | Full-Time

OTE: $1500/month



Yuva Virtual places trained virtual assistants inside US businesses. Our deepest specialization is medical — clinics and private practices across the United States. That’s where most of your calls will be.



You own our pipeline. Every lead in our CRM is yours to work — fresh inbound, live conversations, deals that stalled, no-shows that need rebooking, and older leads that went quiet. These are people who already raised their hand. Your job is to make sure not one of them slips.



Get them onto our closer’s calendar.



You will not be running sales calls — not at first. You book them, our closer runs them. Reps who consistently hit their numbers and prove they can run a conversation move up into their own calls at senior pay.



THE WORK

• Work every stage of our GoHighLevel pipeline — call, text, and
 new inbound leads, active opportunities, stalled deals, no-shows, and leads that went quiet

• Follow up on a fixed cadence. Nothing sits untouched. If a lead has been sitting, that’s on you.

• Book qualified discovery calls using our checklist — real calls, not filler

• Keep the CRM spotless: every lead has a stage, a note, and a dated next action

• Brief the closer before every call, then sit in and take notes



One number defines your week: qualified discovery calls held.



COMPENSATION

• $5.5–$7/hour based on experience, 40 hrs/week

• $10 for every booked call that is held and passes qualification (no-shows and unqualified don’t count)



WHO THIS IS FOR

• You have real phone sales experience — you’ve carried a number and hit it. B2B, B2C, inbound, outbound, we don’t care where you learned it.

• You communicate well. Your spoken English is clear enough for a 62-year-old clinic owner in Ohio to follow on the first pass, over a phone line — and you can think on your feet when a conversation goes sideways.

• You’re organized. Nothing falls out of your CRM.

• You want to become a closer and you’re willing to earn it first

• You can be measured on one public number every week without falling apart



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

• Anyone who needs reminding to follow up

• Anyone who lets a lead go quiet and calls it dead

• Anyone who wants to run sales calls on day one — that’s not this seat



BIG ADVANTAGES (NOT REQUIRED)

• You’ve worked at a VA, staffing, outsourcing, or recruitment company in any role — including as a VA

• Healthcare or medical background — clinics are our specialty and this is the single biggest edge to have

• You’ve sold to US small business owners

• GoHighLevel experience



REQUIREMENTS

• 10:00am–8:00pm US Eastern, Mon–Fri, with a 2-hour midday break (8 working hours/day). You need to be genuinely available across that entire window, wherever you are. Do not apply if these hours don’t work for you long-term.

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, working headset



HOW TO APPLY

: 

(Yuva Virtual is the parent brand; YuvaMed is our medical division — same team, same inbox.)



Subject: Junior Sales Rep — [Your Country]

Send two things. Missing either one and we don’t review the application.



 1. Your CV

 2. A voice recording — Vocaroo (
) or similar. 180 seconds max. One take, no script, no editing.



Tell us your name, where you’re based, and walk us through your sales experience — what you’ve sold, to whom, and the number you were measured on. Tell us whether you’ve used GoHighLevel, and what you did in it.

title: Customer Engagement & Growth Manager
description:
About Pilates Addiction

Pilates Addiction believes movement has the power to transform — and when it’s done in a community that uplifts and challenges you, it becomes a way of life.

Our studios deliver results-driven Pilates grounded in biomechanics, led by expert Educators and powered by patented reformers you won’t find anywhere else.

Pilates Addiction Roswell (Georgia, USA) opens in 2026. We are hiring a remote Member Engagement & Community Coordinator based off shore.



The Role

This is a remote, analytical, people-first role. You will engage our leads and members through warm, personalized chats in Loyal Snap and segment them into our four personas — The Modern Achiever, The Fitness Connoisseur, The Curious Convert, and The Strong Rebuilder — so our local studio staff can make highly personal phone calls that convert leads into memberships. You will also be our online research engine for grassroots lead generation within a 1–3–5–8 mile radius of the studio, and you will deliver a daily data update to the owner.

You will work from the Philippines, supporting our Roswell, Georgia team through Loyal Snap, Mindbody, and
.



What You’ll Do

1. Member Engagement & Persona-Driven Lead Conversion

• Engage prospects and members daily in Loyal Snap through short, personalized, and engaging conversations by text and
.

• Segment every lead into one of our four personas — The Modern Achiever, The Fitness Connoisseur, The Curious Convert, and The Strong Rebuilder — and maintain a living persona map (profile, pain, message, and conversation hooks) that local studio staff use when making personal phone calls to convert leads into memberships.

• Keep Mindbody and Loyal Snap data clean and current so every contact and conversation is captured.

• Deliver a daily stats update to the owner: lead counts, conversion rates, response times, follow-up status, and persona-level insights (be creative).

2. Grassroots Lead Generation & Event Support

• Research new venues, partners, and qualified leads online within a 1–3–5–8-mile radius of the studio.

• Build tiered prospect lists with contact details, persona fit, and a recommended outreach approach.

• Prepare pre-event documents for studio staff — threshold and stretch lead goals, target personas, outreach plans, and logistics checklists.

• Lead post-event reviews: results vs. goals, what worked, lessons learned for next time.

• Support pre-opening, Start of Sales (June 13), Soft Opening (August 20–23, 2026), and Grand Opening (early October 2026) activities.

• Draft engaging
, propose special event media (Digital Stack), refine persona messaging, and suggest new campaign angles.



Work Setup & Requirements

•	Location: Philippines, fully remote.

•	Schedule: Full-time, 40 hrs./week. Flexible / split-shift with some US Eastern overlap (full time potential)

•	English: Excellent spoken and written English.

•	Internet: Reliable home internet (25+ Mbps recommended) with a backup option.

•	Equipment: Personal computer, quality headset, webcam, quiet workspace.

•	Software: Mindbody (POS), Loyal Snap (CRM), Digital Stack, Google Workspace or MS office, especially Excel and word

•	AI: Highlight experienced using AI tools to professionalize and improve work output (Claude, other) 



Nice to Have

•	Personal fitness experience — Pilates reformer experience strongly preferred.

•	Customer service, inside sales, marketing background

•	Boutique fitness, wellness, hospitality, or events background.

•	Hands-on Mindbody, Loyal Snap and Digital Stack experience.

•	Excel for data analysis (pivot tables, formulas, charts, dashboards).

•	A personal interest in Pilates, or other movement disciplines.



Compensation & Benefits

•	Competitive rate $4-$6 /hr.- Pay period to be negotiated.

•	Paid Philippine holidays and PTO (to be negotiated)

•	Ongoing training and growth opportunity with a mission-driven brand.



Why You’ll Love It Here

•	To be part of one of the fastest growing franchises in the USA.

•	Real growth and Full Time Potential as more studios and modalities come online.

•	Mission-driven team that cares about clients, teammates, and community.

•	Work from home, fully remote.



How to Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:

•	A 1–2-minute voice or video intro in English.

•	Your available start date and preferred weekly schedule.

Job Description

Job Title



K–12 Virtual Tutor (Priority: SAT & ACT Preparation)



Employment Type

About Spark Xplorer



Spark Xplorer is a fast-growing online education company committed to providing personalized, high-quality tutoring for K–12 students, primarily within the United States. We combine experienced educators, technology, and AI-powered learning tools to help scholars build confidence, close learning gaps, and achieve academic excellence.



As our scholar community continues to grow, we are expanding our global tutor network by recruiting passionate educators who can deliver engaging, student-centered virtual lessons.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Olvy sells through several European marketplaces, purchases from a fixed base of suppliers in China and works with external fulfilment partners. As the number of countries, channels and partners grows, so does the complexity of the supply chain.



The Supply Chain Manager holds end responsibility for the design and the performance of this chain. The role sets the inventory strategy, safeguards availability and inventory turnover, holds suppliers and fulfilment partners to measurable performance standards, and makes sure the supply chain remains scalable as we expand into new countries and sales channels.



Where the Supply Chain Coordinator is responsible for day to day execution, the Supply Chain Manager sets the framework, the priorities and the improvement agenda. The role carries independent authority, works against clearly defined KPIs, and takes over substantive ownership of the supply chain from the Operations Manager. This creates a single, clear owner for inventory, partner performance and the further development of the chain.



Responsibilities:

1. Inventory and planning

- Setting and maintaining safety stock and coverage targets per product category and per channel, based on demand

variability and actual lead times.

- Setting reorder points and replenishment logic, including MOQ and container constraints.

- Building and monthly updating of the long term forecast with a horizon of at least twelve months, including seasonal

peaks and deal periods.

- Determining the purchase quantity per order, subject to approval by the Operations Manager and, above the agreed

threshold, by finance.

- Monitoring inventory turnover and inventory health, and intervening actively in cases of overstock and slow movers.

- Directing the Supply Chain Coordinator on the weekly replenishment to the fulfilment channels.



2. Network and logistics

- Owning the performance of all fulfilment partners: defining SLAs, measuring them, reporting back monthly and escalating where needed.

- Selecting carriers and negotiating freight rates, covering sea and road freight and, where required, air and rail.

- Monitoring container utilisation and shipment consolidation, against a defined target for freight cost per unit sold.

- Preparing and executing the transition of the fulfilment network towards 2027, with the Operations Manager as decision maker.

- Designing the logistics chain when expanding into a new country or channel: storage, return flows, customs, the import process and VAT registration in cooperation with finance.



3. Supplier performance

- Structurally measuring suppliers on actual lead time, production capacity, delivery reliability and quality deviations.

- Holding periodic performance reviews with the key suppliers, at least quarterly, with recorded commitments and follow up.

- Negotiating prices, payment terms and incoterms with existing suppliers, subject to approval by the Operations Manager.

- Coordinating pre shipment quality inspections and following up on findings.



4. Performance and reporting

- Owning the supply chain KPIs in the internal dashboard: their definition, the reliability of the underlying data and their further improvement.

- Monthly reporting to the management team on availability, forecast accuracy, chain costs and risks, including a concrete proposal wherever there is a deviation.

- Owning escalations towards suppliers and fulfilment partners.

- Documenting and maintaining the working processes in the chain, so that execution does not depend on individuals.







Must have

1. Five to ten years of supply chain experience, including at least two years with end responsibility for inventory norms or a fulfilment network.

2. Demonstrable experience with imports from Asia into Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning, customs and the import process.

3. Demonstrable experience managing external fulfilment partners on the basis of SLAs.

4. Inventory planning at parameter level, not purely executional. Able to explain why a norm is set where it is.

5. Strong analytical ability with data, able to work through large datasets and to question the output of a tool.

6. Experience in e-commerce or marketplace fulfilment.

7. Fluent English, both written and in negotiation.



Decisive in practice

1. Works independently and takes initiative without having the work laid out in advance.

2. Has previously had at least one direct report.

3. Operates effectively in an environment without heavily embedded systems and documented processes.

4. Pushes back on management and supports a differing view with figures.



Nice to have, not required

1. Lean Six Sigma or a comparable process improvement background.

2. Experience with EU product compliance and import regulations.

3. Experience building a supply chain rather than only managing an existing one.

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services (Full Time, EST)
description:
If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE.



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers,

plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of

our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and

more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and

profitable growth.



We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What makes this role different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand,

including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The

systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid

changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few

quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an

HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how

to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the

systems mature, keep reading.



What you'll own



Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC

specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts

with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to

know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume,

acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is

not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns

drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword

research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them:

which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the

account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of

continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages

that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.

Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan

for the next month.



What success looks like



In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify

the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term,

success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients

confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What we're looking for



Must-haves:

- Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

- Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

- A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the

dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

- The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

- The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

- Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses:

- Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to

booked jobs

- Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

- An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

- Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

- Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use

them.

The environment

- Remote, international team

- Contractor position, paid biweekly

- Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience

- Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing

monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per

month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as

long as the client stays.



Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor



You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST

schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply.



Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days,

which means the work has to be good.



Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

title: Creative Operations Manager - DTC brand
description:
Summary

We are looking for a Creative Operations Manager to build and manage the operational foundation of a fast-growing DTC beauty brand primarily serving the US market.



This role will connect the full performance growth workflow across Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, UGC creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, and retention specialist — ensuring that creative assets, advertorials, landing pages, offers, and retention initiatives move smoothly from strategy and brief through production, launch, performance review, and iteration.



We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in building scalable systems inside a fast-moving DTC or performance marketing environment.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage the end-to-end workflow across performance creative, UGC production, advertorials, listicles, landing pages, PDPs, offer tests, and retention initiatives.

- Translate creative, CRO, and retention roadmaps into clear sprint plans with owners, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and deliverables.

- Coordinate between Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, and retention partners.

- Ensure briefs and production requirements are complete before work begins, including formats, references, deliverables, deadlines, tracking requirements, and approval ownership.

- Manage creative and funnel timelines, production capacity, feedback, revisions, QA, approvals, asset organization, and launch readiness.

- Ensure that media-buying and conversion results are documented and fed back into creative, funnel, and retention planning for the next testing cycle.

- Build and continuously improve SOPs, ClickUp/Notion boards, trackers, dashboards, naming conventions, reporting systems, and team workflows.

- Identify bottlenecks, missed handoffs, unclear ownership, and repeated rework, then proactively improve the underlying process.

- Maintain clear accountability across the team and provide concise weekly updates covering what shipped, what is in progress, what is blocked, and what requires a decision.

- Help the team increase output and speed without sacrificing strategic quality or production standards.



Requirements



- 2+ years of experience in Creative Operations, Growth Operations, Creative Project Management, or Production Management.

- Direct experience working with DTC ecommerce brands, performance marketing teams, or direct-response creative agencies.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams involving Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, or retention teams.

- Strong understanding of the performance creative lifecycle, from research and briefs through production, launch, performance analysis, iteration, and learning documentation.

- Familiarity with direct-response funnels, including advertorials, listicles, pre-landers, landing pages, PDPs, offer testing, upsells, and conversion-focused copy.

- Demonstrated experience building SOPs, production systems, capacity trackers, approval workflows, and operational processes from scratch.

- Strong project management skills across multiple SKUs, campaigns, and concurrent workstreams.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive, with strong ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable working directly with founders and senior functional leads while maintaining clear responsibility across the wider team.

- Proficiency with ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar project-management and documentation tools.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Availability for substantial working-hour overlap with the Asia-based team.



Why Join Us



- Long-term opportunity with the potential to transition into a full-time contractor role.

- High ownership and direct impact on how the creative and growth organization is built.

- Work directly with the founder and senior specialists across various teams

- Opportunity to build the operating system behind a fast-growing DTC brand



How to apply



Please apply with:



- Your CV/LinkedIn and current availability



- Examples of DTC/ecommerce brands or teams you have supported



- Your expected monthly salary



- Share one real example where you personally managed a creative or growth workflow across strategy, production, launch and performance review. What was the bottleneck, what system or process did you introduce, and what improved as a result?



- What tools have you used to manage creative production and performance learnings (e.g. ClickUp, Notion, Airtable), and what was your exact responsibility within the team?
