title: CRO Shopify
description:
At Lantern Sol, we’re a dynamic, multicultural team of developers, designers, project managers, and SEO experts dedicated to building exceptional e-commerce websites on Shopify. We’ve helped companies generate over $100 million in e-commerce sales, developed 500+ custom websites and apps, and have been featured speakers on Shopify and Amazon.

Shape the future of commerce – Your work will directly impact businesses worldwide.

Flexible work environment – Work from anywhere, set your own schedule.

Join a thriving global team – Collaborate with top talent across multiple time zones.

Professional growth – Stay ahead with continuous learning opportunities and challenging projects.

Lantern Sol is looking for a part-time CRO Specialist to support our Shopify and eCommerce clients. This person will provide the deeper CRO expertise behind each account.



They will analyze customer and website data, develop testing hypotheses, guide experiment planning, evaluate results, and help communicate the business impact of the work to clients.

Each account will still have a Lantern Sol project manager responsible for the overall relationship, timelines, and coordination. Our internal design and development teams will handle execution. The CRO Specialist will own the strategy, analysis, and interpretation that guide the work.

What You’ll Do



Complete initial CRO audits using data from GA4, Shopify, testing platforms, heatmaps, session recordings, and other available sources.

Compare data across platforms to identify conversion issues, customer behavior patterns, and areas of opportunity.

Participate in recurring ideation sessions with project managers, designers, and developers.

Turn findings and ideas into clear, testable hypotheses.

Build and prioritize testing plans based on potential impact, available traffic, confidence, and level of effort.

Recommend an appropriate testing cadence for each client rather than applying the same process to every account.

Plan tests across different areas of the customer journey, such as the homepage, navigation, product pages, cart, and checkout.

Help structure simultaneous tests appropriately so results remain accurate and clients are not exposed to conflicting experiments.

Define the audience, success metrics, and measurement approach for each test.

Review experiment results and determine whether a hypothesis was confirmed, denied, or requires another iteration.

Translate both positive and negative test results into useful insights and clear next steps.

Estimate the potential business impact of test results using conversion rate, traffic, average order value, and projected revenue.

Update client reporting with results, screenshots, findings, and recommendations.

Join client calls when needed to explain testing strategy or present results.

Help Lantern Sol improve and document a consistent CRO process that can scale across accounts.

Use AI tools to support analysis, ideation, and reporting while applying independent judgment to the final recommendations.

You’re a Great Fit If You…

Have hands-on experience as a CRO strategist or specialist for Shopify, D2C, or eCommerce brands supporting multiple CRO clients.

Experience with Intelligems or similar Shopify experimentation platforms, creating and evaluating A/B or split tests.

Understand testing methodology, audience segmentation, sample size, statistical significance, and common factors that can make results unreliable.

Can work across GA4, Shopify Analytics, and CRO testing platforms to build a more complete view of performance.

Know how to turn data into focused hypotheses and practical testing plans.

Can prioritize several testing opportunities without running overlapping experiments that compromise the results.

Experience creating or presenting client-facing CRO reports: You know how to frame an unsuccessful experiment as a useful learning rather than simply reporting it as a loss.

Can explain data and testing results clearly to clients and team members who may not have a CRO background.

Are comfortable collaborating with project managers, designers, and developers without needing to manage the entire account.

Are organized, responsive, and able to support multiple accounts in a remote agency environment.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Figma and design-to-development workflows.

Experience helping an agency build or standardize its CRO delivery process.

title: Digital Creative Services Manager
description:
Location: Hybrid or Remote (depending on location)

Join 4ocean and advance your career while making a significant impact on the environment.



About Us:

4ocean is on a mission to end the ocean plastic crisis and we are looking for passionate, talented people to help us achieve this goal.  We are more than just a brand/company/employer. We are a global movement committed to making a tangible difference in the health of our planet by removing plastic waste from the ocean and coastlines. We also advocate for sustainable change. 

If you are driven by purpose, motivated to contribute to a cause that truly matters, and eager to make a lasting impact on the environment, we want you on our team.



Position Overview:

The Digital Creative Services Manager is a hands-on creative leader responsible for defining and executing the visual identity of our product line content across eCommerce and Wholesale channels blending creative design with marketing strategy. 

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, Product, this role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling, digital marketing, and product presentation. You’ll manage a Graphic Designer and serve as the creative authority on all product content — from the imagery that drives online conversion to the sell sheets and packaging that move product through wholesale partners.

This is a role best suited for someone who thinks strategically, executes precisely, and cares deeply about the mission behind the work.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Leadership & Strategy

•      Own the creative vision for all product content across eCommerce and Wholesale, ensuring brand consistency and mission alignment at every touchpoint.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon,
, DTC site, and any emerging placements. Brand standards don’t drift on this person’s watch.

•    Leads production of both static and video assets, from concept through delivery.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon,
, DTC site, and any emerging placements.

•    Act as the operational infrastructure behind the creative. Build and maintain a creative asset library and production workflow, including naming conventions, version control, delivery specs by platform.

•     Partner with the Managing Director, Product to translate business goals into compelling visual narratives.

•     Establish and maintain brand guidelines for product content, photography direction, and digital design standards.

•     Stay ahead of digital design trends, platform algorithm changes, and wholesale presentation best practices.

eCommerce Content

•     Oversee the creation of all product listing assets including primary images, lifestyle photography, infographics, and A+ / enhanced content.

•     Optimize visual content for conversion across owned DTC channels and third-party platforms (e.g., Amazon, retail partner portals).

•     Collaborate with the eCommerce and marketing teams to develop campaign creative, landing pages, and promotional assets.

•     Analyze content performance data and iterate on creative strategy accordingly.

•    Manage multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.



Wholesale Content

•     Develop and maintain a suite of wholesale-facing materials including line sheets, sell sheets, trade show assets, and retail display concepts.

•     Ensure product photography and specifications meet the requirements of key wholesale partners and retail buyers.

•     Support seasonal product launches with tailored wholesale creative packages.

Team Management

•     Directly manage and mentor the Graphic Designer, providing clear briefs, constructive feedback, and professional development support.

•     Build and manage a freelance network (photographers, videographers, editors, etc) as needed for campaign productions.

•     Prioritize and manage the creative workload across projects, balancing quality with speed-to-market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•     Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to ensure creative assets are aligned with product roadmaps and go-to-market timelines.

•     Partner with the eCommerce team on UX/UI creative decisions that support the online shopping experience.

•     Brief and manage external agencies or production vendors when applicable.

•     Partner directly with paid media to close the feedback loop.

•    Direct internal creators and any external agency or freelance talent. Clear briefing, sharp feedback, no ambiguity about what good looks like.

•    Manages multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.

•    Interface with paid media, organic social,
, and wholesale channels as needed. Cross-functional by default, not by exception.



It’s also important that all 4ocean crew members naturally live and embrace our core values:

● Ocean first

● Get Shit Done!

● Accelerate time

● We’re in this together

● Nudge don’t judge

● Stay stoked

● Think bigger!



Qualifications:

Required

•     Minimum 5 years of experience in digital creative, brand design, or content production, with at least 2 years in a management or lead role.

•     Demonstrated experience creating product content for eCommerce platforms (DTC and/or marketplace).

•     Strong portfolio showcasing product photography direction, digital design, and brand-consistent visual storytelling.

•     Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and familiarity with Figma or similar tools.

•     Experience briefing and directing photographers, videographers, or other creative vendors.

•     Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

•     Knows the difference between a scroll-stopping hook frame and a pretty image that converts nobody.

•     Brand standards don’t drift on your watch.

•    You’re not a passenger on the analytics side. You read performance data (ie. CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop, ROAS by creative) and act on it.

•    Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects) and Figma. Working fluency in generative AI tools (Midjourney, Firefly, or equivalent) is not optional. PXM software is a plus.

•    You understand the authenticity of mission-first content architecture.

Preferred

•      Background in consumer goods, sustainability, outdoor, or lifestyle brands.

•      Experience with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms.

•      Familiarity with retail buyer presentation formats and wholesale portal requirements.

•      Passion for ocean conservation or environmental causes.

title: AI Video Editor Master | Skincare/Beauty DTC | Full AI UGC, B-Roll, Podcast & 3D Ads | 7-8 Figure Brand Experience
description:
WHO WE ARE



We're a performance-driven skincare brand scaling aggressively on Meta. We don't make pretty videos. We make videos that turn cold traffic into customers.



Creative is our #1 growth lever, and AI video generation is now the core of how we produce it. We're looking for someone who has mastered these tools, not someone who's "played with them."



THE ROLE



You'll be the person who takes a script and a brief and delivers a finished, scroll-stopping ad, generating the visuals, the voice and the edit yourself, mostly with AI.



You'll be producing:



- Complete AI UGC ads — AI-generated presenters/testimonials that look and sound real, from prompt to final export (lip-sync, voice, framing, natural delivery)

- AI b-roll libraries — product shots, lifestyle scenes, skin close-ups, before/after style sequences, generated on demand and cut into ads

- AI podcast-style ads — two-host conversational formats, "clip from an interview" style, fully generated

- Pixar / 3D animated style ads — character-driven explainers, story-based ads, mechanism visualisations

- Faceless formats — b-roll-heavy VSLs, text-driven scroll-stoppers, motion-graphic hybrids

- Hook variation batches — multiple AI-generated openings on the same body for A/B testing

- Real UGC edits — cutting creator footage into tight, retention-driven sequences when we have it



This is direct-response advertising. Success is measured in hook rate, hold rate and CPA. Not likes.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

- Producing 10-20+ ad variations per week across multiple concepts

- Generating AI video (Kling, Seedance, Veo, Sora, Runway, Higgsfield or similar) and AI stills for image-to-video workflows

- Building consistent AI characters/presenters that can be reused across a campaign

- AI voiceover and lip-sync (ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar)

- Writing prompts that actually get the shot: camera moves, lighting, product accuracy, skin realism

- Fixing AI artefacts, inconsistencies and product distortions before they ship

- Captions, text overlays and motion elements for retention

- Iterating fast on performance data: winners get expanded, losers get cut



YOU'RE A FIT IF:

- You've produced end-to-end AI ads (not just edited footage someone else made) for DTC brands running serious paid social spend

- You have a portfolio of AI-generated ads with real performance numbers behind them

- You can generate a believable AI UGC testimonial that doesn't look like AI

- You've built AI podcast-style or dialogue videos with consistent characters across shots

- You've produced Pixar/3D-style animated content with AI tools

- You know the strengths and limits of each generator and pick the right one per shot

- You understand direct-response: hooks, open loops, pattern interrupts, pacing for retention

- You know why the first 3 seconds matter more than everything else combined

- You've edited for Meta, TikTok and/or YouTube Shorts

- You can work fast at volume without sacrificing quality



BONUS POINTS:

- Experience in skincare, beauty or health/wellness DTC

- Experience keeping a physical product (bottle, packaging, label) accurate across AI-generated shots

- You've produced AI ads that scaled past $100k+ spend

- French-language ads or French-market experience



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF:

- Your AI experience is a few test clips, not shipped ads

- Your portfolio is mostly brand content, music videos or YouTube vlogs

title: Short form video editor
description:
I'm looking for a talented short-form video editor to help me build my personal brand on Instagram.



The editing itself isn't extremely complicated. What matters most is that you **understand short-form content**: hooks, pacing, storytelling, retention and what makes someone keep watching.



### What you'll be working on



There are two main types of videos:



**1. Story-driven short-form videos**



You'll receive a storyline/script and access to existing footage from my life, businesses, travel, etc.



Your job is to turn that into an engaging short-form video by:



* Finding and selecting the right footage

* Using photos or other visuals when footage isn't available

* Creating a strong visual story around the script

* Keeping the pacing engaging

* Adding captions, music, sound effects and simple motion graphics where useful



You don't need to create crazy edits. The goal is to make the **story interesting to watch.**



**2. Talking-head videos**



These will be simpler:



* Cut out pauses and unnecessary parts

* Make the delivery feel faster and more natural

* Add captions

* Add relevant B-roll/footage where it improves the video

* Occasionally add simple graphics or visual references



### What I'm looking for



The biggest thing is that you **understand the short-form game.**



I don't want someone who just follows editing instructions. I want someone who can watch a video and think:



*"This part is too slow."*

*"We need a visual change here."*

*"The first 2 seconds aren't strong enough."*

*"This version would probably retain viewers better."*



We'll test videos, see what performs, and iterate based on the results.



You should be comfortable learning what works for my content over time and getting better together.



### Requirements



* Experience editing Reels / TikToks / Shorts

* Strong sense of pacing and storytelling

* Good English

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating

* Reliable and responsive

* Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or similar is fine



This will initially be focused on my personal brand, but there may also be additional editing work for some of my businesses.



### To apply



Please send:



1. 3 examples of short-form videos you've edited that best show your storytelling/editing ability

2. A short explanation of **why you think those videos work**

3. Which editing software you use

4. Your hourly rate

5. How many hours per week you're available



Please start your application with the word **STORY** so I know you've read the full post.



I'm looking for someone I can work with long-term, not just for a few videos.

title: Ecommerce Funnel Builder | Funnelish and Shopify
description:
Please read the complete post before applying. This role is for an experienced ecommerce Funnel Builder who can handle both page execution and technical setup. It is not an entry-level design position.



Capital Heaven operates health, beauty, wellness and personal-care ecommerce brands across several international markets. We need someone who can take an approved source funnel, rebuild or localize it accurately, connect the correct products and offers, test the full customer journey and deliver it ready for launch.



You should be comfortable working independently from a written task while communicating clearly when information is missing or a technical issue could delay the launch.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build, duplicate and localize ecommerce funnels in Funnelish.

- Create and update advertorials, sales pages, checkout pages, upsells and other required funnel steps.

- Review the complete task before starting and confirm the correct product, source funnel, store, market, language, currency, offer and deadline.

- Preserve the approved structure, angle and customer journey unless different instructions are provided.

- Update all market-specific copy, currencies, units, names, images, buttons, disclaimers and footer details.

- Create and configure Shopify products, variants, quantities, images, pricing, compare-at pricing, SKUs and URL paths.

- Connect every button and bundle option to the correct Shopify product and variant.

- Set up and check AfterSell flows when required.

- Configure domains, redirects, pixels, tracking and required events according to the company SOP.

- Work with WeTracked or similar ecommerce tracking tools.

- Test the full funnel on desktop and mobile, including page flow, buttons, bundles, shipping, checkout, payment options and tracking.

- Correct failed checks and retest the affected journey before submitting the funnel.

- Provide clear completion updates in ClickUp and Slack with live links, screenshots, test results and any remaining blockers.

- Coordinate with the product research, creative, media buying and Meta asset teams during handoffs.

- Stop and escalate when instructions conflict or when a product, offer, checkout path, domain or tracking setup cannot be verified.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



- Strong professional experience building ecommerce or dropshipping funnels.

- Hands-on experience using Funnelish for advertorials, sales pages, checkouts and upsells.

- Practical Shopify experience, including products, variants, pricing, SKUs, bundle connections and checkout paths.

- Experience duplicating or localizing proven funnels for different stores, countries, languages and currencies.

- Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile funnel testing.

- Ability to troubleshoot broken buttons, incorrect variants, checkout problems, domain issues, redirects and tracking errors.

- Experience with Meta Pixel, events and ecommerce tracking tools.

- Strong attention to product codes, prices, offers, currencies, markets and technical details.

- Ability to follow SOPs and detailed written instructions without skipping QA steps.

- Clear written English and reliable communication through Slack and ClickUp.

- Ability to manage several assigned funnels and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.

- Full-time and long-term availability.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Experience with AfterSell, WeTracked, Meta Pixel, Google Sheets and Google Drive.

- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplement or personal-care products.

- Familiarity with direct-response advertorials, bundles, upsells and conversion-focused page structures.

- Experience supporting several ecommerce stores and international markets.

- Previous experience training or reviewing other funnel builders.



QUALITY AND COMPLIANCE



Accuracy is more important than rushing a funnel live.



You must request clarification when the approved source, product, store, market, language, currency, price, offer, shipping, checkout, tracking or deadline is missing or conflicting.



You must also flag unsupported medical claims, guaranteed results, misleading before-and-after content, unapproved testimonials or endorsements, excessive discounts, wrong-market references and incorrect technical routing.



Never edit a live winning source funnel directly. Do not place a real order during testing.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This opening is for a Funnel Builder. A highly experienced employee who consistently demonstrates strong technical ability, ownership, quality control and leadership may later be trained for a Funnel Manager position.



WHAT WE OFFER



- A stable, long-term remote position.

- Full-time work across several ecommerce brands and markets.

- Clear SOPs, checklists and task-based workflows.

- Exposure to funnel production, localization, checkout setup, tracking and launch coordination.

- Compensation based on demonstrated experience and skill level.

- A possible future growth path for someone who performs consistently and can support the wider funnel team.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word FUNNEL to confirm that you read the complete post.



Answer all questions below. Give specific examples instead of general statements.



1. How many years of professional funnel-building experience do you have, and how much of that work was for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Describe your hands-on Funnelish experience. Which funnel pages and technical setups have you completed yourself?

3. Describe your Shopify experience with products, variants, quantities, SKUs, pricing, checkout links and bundles.

4. Share two or three live, recorded or redacted examples of funnels you personally built. Explain exactly which parts you completed.

5. How do you duplicate and localize an approved funnel for a different store, country, language or currency?

6. What checks do you perform before declaring a funnel ready for launch?

7. Describe a difficult checkout, product-variant, domain, redirect or tracking problem you diagnosed and fixed.

8. What experience do you have with AfterSell, WeTracked, Meta Pixel, events or other tracking systems?

9. How many complete funnels can you normally deliver per week while maintaining reliable desktop and mobile QA?

10. Have you trained or reviewed other funnel builders? If yes, briefly explain your experience.

11. Are you available full-time and long-term, and what is your earliest possible start date?

12. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



Applications without relevant Funnelish experience, Shopify knowledge and funnel examples will not be prioritized.

Organizing Our Files & Content

• Keep our files and folders neat, so anyone on the team can find what they need in seconds.

• When videos or photos come in from a creator, save, label, and keep track of them the right way — so 

nothing gets lost, and no one has to dig through a mess to find a clip later.

• Keep a simple, up-to-date list of every deal: who it's with, what stage it's at, when it's due, and whether 

it's paid.

• Make sure product gets shipped and creators get their tracking info.



Helping the Manager

• Tell the manager right away if a creator is doing great work — they might be worth a bigger deal.

• Tell the manager right away if something's going wrong. Don't wait and hope it fixes itself.

• Help build our creator community across our programs — seeding, ambassadors, and more.

• Help with other small tasks as they come up. This role grows as you do.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 Days

• You know the kind of creators and personas that fit our brand.

• You've sourced your first few creators.

• You understand our budget and know how to lock in a deal — rate, contract, all of it.

• You know how our database works and how we keep it clean and organized.

• You understand the different creator programs we run, the tools we use to source, and how our whole 

system fits together.



First 60 Days

• You're finding and vetting creators without needing much guidance.

• Our files and content are organized well enough that someone else could jump in and understand 

everything.

• You're catching problems early and flagging them before they get bigger.

• You're starting to spot creators who could grow into bigger roles — ambassadors, repeat collaborators — 

and flagging them to the manager.



First 120 Days

• You're running the sourcing and organizing side of this role on your own.

• The manager trusts your picks and your organization without double-checking.

• You're already suggesting ways to make the process better.

• You're helping the manager grow our creator community across all our programs — seeding, 

ambassadors, Trybe, and beyond.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Hands-on experience with UGC sourcing or creator management, ideally in a DTC or e-commerce 

context.

• Comfortable finding and vetting talent across sourcing platforms.

• Experience supporting paid ads teams and understanding how UGC feeds into performance creative.

• Strong eye for creator quality — you can tell who fits the brand and who'll actually perform, before you 

ever send an outreach message.

• Excellent written English for outreach, negotiations, and creator briefs.

• Organized across multiple timelines, multiple creators, and multiple campaigns simultaneously.

• Comfortable with spreadsheets/trackers and general workspace tools.



MUST HAVES

• Straight to the point communicator. No long, confusing instructions needed either direction.

• Proactive. You don't wait to be told.

• Integrity. We're remote and run on trust.

• Reliable, deadline-driven, and comfortable managing your own time without needing constant check-ins.

• This must be your only job. Full commitment, full presence.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

Someone organized enough that a manager can hand off a messy pile of creator info and trust it comes back 

usable — clear, honest, and dependable.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume (CV) and a short intro video to 
 telling us about yourself and your motivation — we want to 

see your energy and how you communicate, not just read about it.

If you're shortlisted, we'll send you the test assignment as the next step.



Start your application with the words “Honey Hive” so we know you actually read this whole posting.

We read everything. 



Real applications only — copy-paste responses will be ignored.

title: Video Editor + Graphic Designer (AI-Fluent) — Remote, Full-Time
description:
Hi, we're Real Mad Honey. We sell rare honey from the Himalayas and Turkey that actually does something you can feel. Our Meta ads run across the US, UK and EU, and we're scaling hard in 2026. That means we need more creative, faster, without the quality dropping.

That's where you come in.



Who you'll work with:

You'll be reporting directly to our Creative Strategist. They own the creative direction, the briefs, the angles, the hooks, and the testing roadmap. Your job is to take their briefs and turn them into finished ads and assets. You'll have a clear brief for every piece of work, regular feedback loops, and a direct line to ask questions when something isn't clear. If you've worked in a setup where the strategist and the editor push each other to make the work sharper, you'll feel at home.



What you'll actually be doing day to day:

Most of your week is editing ad videos. Think UGC creators filming selfie-style, vox pop / street interview footage , and VSL-style longer explainer videos. The Creative Strategist will hand you raw footage, scripts and briefs. You turn it into scroll-stopping ads with clean subtitles, good pacing, sound design that doesn't overwhelm, and hooks that earn the first three seconds.

On top of that, you'll design statics. Ad statics first, then occasional website visuals and landing page sections. Figma is our tool. If you already think in components and design tokens, even better.

You'll also build organic assets for our social channels. Reels edits, carousel posts, story templates. The organic stuff doesn't have to sell, it has to feel like the brand.



The AI part is not optional:

Honestly, this is the thing that separates the editors we want from the ones we don't. We use AI throughout the workflow. Claude for scripting, copy, ideation, briefing. AI tools for transcription, subtitle generation, rough cuts, upscaling, voice cleanup, background removal, thumbnail variants, image generation for moodboards and concepts. If you can cut a 30-second UGC ad in 45 minutes instead of 3 hours because you know which AI tools to stack, you'll do great here. If AI tools scare you or you're still doing everything manually in 2026, this role will frustrate you.



The systems we use:

Trello for task management and deliverable tracking. Claude AI for briefs, scripts, brainstorms, copy. Figma for design. For editing, we work in the Adobe suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator), so strong Adobe skills are important. If you also use CapCut Pro or DaVinci for certain cuts, that's fine as long as the output is clean and deliverables come back in the right format. Google Drive for asset handoff.



What we need from you as a person:

Communication is honestly half the job. If a deadline is going to slip, we want to know on day one, not day four. If a brief from the strategist is unclear, ask. If you think the script is weak, say so. We'd rather push back on a brief than receive a polished ad that misses.

You'll be writing Trello updates, commenting on review links, jumping on the occasional Loom with the Creative Strategist, and responding to Slack-style messages during overlap hours. You don't need perfect English but you need to be clear, direct, and reliable. "Done by Friday" has to mean done by Friday.



Who this role is for:

Someone who's been editing performance ads for DTC brands for at least 2 to 3 years. You've seen UGC. You've seen vox pop. You've cut VSLs. You understand that an ad is not a film, it's a sales pitch with 3 seconds to land. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere and ideally comfortable in After Effects for motion graphics and text animations. You've used Figma seriously, not just opened it once. You've integrated AI into your pipeline because you care about speed without losing taste.



Who this role is not for:

Editors who take three days to turn around a simple ad cut. People who wait to be told exactly what to do. Designers who make beautiful work that doesn't convert. Anyone who needs hand-holding on Trello tickets or forgets to respond for two days.



The work schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week. We're based in Europe so ideally you can overlap 3 to 4 hours with CET working hours. The rest is async.



How to apply:

Send us three things.

- First, your portfolio. We want to see ad videos you've edited (UGC, vox pop, VSL if you have them) and static ads you've designed. If it's behind a password, include it.



- Second, a short Loom (2 to 4 minutes) where you walk us through one ad you're proud of. Tell us why you made the choices you made. We care more about your thinking than your reel.



-Third, tell us which AI tools you actually use in your workflow and what you use them for. One paragraph is fine. If you just say "ChatGPT" we'll know.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
A company in the South Asian luxury fashion industry is looking for a creative and story-driven short-form video editor to join the team. This is a remote, part-time role working closely with a NYC-based founder and designer. If you have a strong creative instinct, a cinematic eye, and a deep understanding of what makes short-form content stop a scroll, we want to hear from you.



This is not a generic influencer editing role. We are looking for someone who understands pacing, emotion, sound, and framing, and who can transform simple, low-fi footage into something that feels elevated and intentional. The aesthetic we are going for is cinematic, feminine, whimsical, emotional, and occasionally intense. Think the contrast between calm visuals and sharp pacing, between ordinary footage and unexpected creative decisions, between chaos and sudden stillness.



Creative instinct matters more than technical complexity here.





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit 3 to 4 short-form videos per week optimized for TikTok and similar platforms

- Create cinematic, Gen Z-style edits that prioritize storytelling over polish

- Apply creative typography, framing, zooms, transitions, and pacing to elevate footage

- Build strong sound design using music, silence, effects, and precise audio cuts

- Source additional footage when needed to complete the story

- Make independent creative decisions that enhance the narrative rather than follow a template

- Work directly with scripts, voiceovers, and music provided to you

- Handle all aspects of the edit including text, colour, framing, and pacing





QUALIFICATIONS



- Proven experience editing short-form video content, particularly for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts

- A portfolio that demonstrates strong storytelling, pacing, and aesthetic sensibility

- Ability to work with simple, unpolished iPhone footage and elevate it through editing choices

- Strong understanding of sound design and how audio shapes emotion and rhythm

- Familiarity with the Gen Z / TikTok visual language without defaulting to generic trends

- Ability to take creative ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do

- Experience in fashion, lifestyle, or luxury content is a strong plus

- Comfortable working remotely and independently on a consistent weekly schedule

- Reliable communication and ability to meet turnaround expectations





WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Scripts and voiceover

- Music selections

- Most of the primary footage



You will handle everything from there, including editing, sound design, text, framing, colour grading, pacing, and sourcing any additional footage needed.





SCHEDULE



- Remote position

- 12 to 16 hours per week

- CST schedule

- Long-term opportunity

- Starting soon





HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



- Updated Resume

- Introduction Audio (Vacaroo is fine)

- Updated Portfolio



Note: This role requires a specific aesthetic sensibility. Please make sure your portfolio reflects cinematic, story-driven, or emotionally expressive work. Generic or template-based edits will not be considered.

title: Product Developer (Industrial Design / Engineering) — Design real products, sold worldwide
description:
Full-time. Work from home 80%. 9-5 Philippine time. 5 EUR per hour.

Travel to Manila and to our China office, fully paid by us.

 

 

===============================================

 

READ THIS PART FIRST

 

===============================================

 

We are not looking for someone to fill a seat.

 

We are a Dutch company that went from zero to millions in revenue in a few years. We design and sell our own products under six brands: cookware, bathroom, sleep and home. Around 1.5 million units sold. Everything is designed in-house, made in our own China network, and shipped from our own warehouses.

 

Most of our Filipino team members have been with us since the beginning. That is not an a
. We hire slowly, we hire carefully, and once you are in, we invest heavily in you.

 

We now need one more Product Developer to work directly with me on new products.

 

If you are looking for a quiet job where nobody asks much of you, this is the wrong post.

 

If you want to build a career, own real products, travel for work, and get paid more as you grow, keep reading.

 

 

===============================================

 

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

 

===============================================

 

You join a product development team of four. You will work on products from the first sketch to the moment a customer opens the box.

 

Turn ideas, market gaps and customer complaints into real product concepts.

 

Model parts and assemblies in 3D CAD (Fusion 360 or SolidWorks).

 

Create technical drawings and specs our factories can build from.

 

Work with our engineers in Suzhou and Yancheng on samples, tolerances and quality.

 

Review samples, find what is wrong, and iterate until it is right.

 

Think about materials, cost, packaging, and how the product will survive shipping.

 

Kill your own bad ideas fast and move on to the next one.

 

You will not be doing one small task forever. Our products go from concept to market in weeks, not seasons. You will see your work in the real world quickly.

 

 

===============================================

 

WORKING FROM HOME, AND COMING TO US

 

===============================================

 

80 percent of the time you work from home. Your own setup, your own space, 9-5 Philippine time so you overlap with the team.

 

The other 20 percent is where it gets interesting.

 

We meet the Manila team in person on a regular basis.

 

I will fly you to our China office when a project needs you there: sample reviews, factory visits, working next to our engineers.

 

Within your first six months we will sit down together in person, in Manila or in China.

 

We arrange and pay for everything. Visa, flights, accommodation, food. It costs you nothing.

 

You do not need to have travelled before. You do not need to figure out the paperwork. That is our job.

 

What you do need is the willingness to get on a plane. If flying abroad for work is not something you want, please do not apply. If it is something you have always wanted and never had the chance to do, this may be the best opportunity on this website.

 

 

===============================================

 

WHAT WE DO FOR YOU

 

===============================================

 

Let me be direct about what we are offering, because it is not just a salary.

 

A STABLE JOB.

Our Filipino team members have been with us for years. We are not a project-based agency that lets people go when a client leaves. We sell our own products, and we are growing.

 

AN ACTIVE GROWTH TRACK.

Not a vague promise. We sit down with you, set goals for the company and personal goals for you, and give you more responsibility as you prove you can carry it. More responsibility means more money. The people who came in early and grew with us are now the ones running things.

 

ROOM TO MAKE MISTAKES.

You will make expensive mistakes. A tool that was cut wrong, a sample order that was a waste, a product that flops. That is part of developing products, and it is part of learning. We do not punish honest mistakes. We look at what went wrong, fix the process, and move on. What we do not accept is hiding a mistake, or not learning from it.

 

DIRECT ACCESS.

You work with me, not through five layers of management. When you have a good idea, you can get it made.

 

 

===============================================

 

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

 

===============================================

 

We do not hire just anyone. Our standards before you get in are high, and they should be, because of how much we put into you afterwards.

 

REQUIRED:

 

Strong 3D CAD skills in Fusion 360 or SolidWorks. You can model parts and assemblies and produce drawings a factory can work from. Show us.

 

A background in industrial design, product design or mechanical engineering, or you taught yourself to the same level. We care about what you can do, not which school you went to.

 

Real interest in physical products. You are the kind of person who picks up an object and thinks about why it was made that way.

 

Good written and spoken English. You will be talking with Dutch and Chinese colleagues daily.

 

Reliable internet and a computer that can run CAD properly.

 

Willingness to travel abroad, with our full support.

 

NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED:

 

Experience with injection moulding, casting, stamping or sheet metal.

 

Rendering skills such as KeyShot, Blender or Fusion render.

 

Experience talking directly with Chinese suppliers.

 

Anything you have designed and actually had made, even a personal project.

 

WHAT MATTERS MORE THAN YOUR CV:

 

You take ownership. When something is unclear, you ask. When something is broken, you say so. You do not wait to be told what to do next. You want to be good at this, not just employed.

 

Years of experience is not a filter for us. If you are early in your career but genuinely talented and hungry, apply. If you have ten years behind you, apply. We will judge you on your work and your attitude.

 

 

===============================================

 

THE OFFER

 

===============================================

 

5 EUR per hour. Roughly 330 PHP per hour, around 58,000 PHP per month at current rates.

 

8 hours a day, 9-5 Philippine time, Monday to Friday.

 

Full-time and long-term. We are hiring for years, not for a project.

 

All travel, visa and accommodation costs covered by us.

 

Pay grows as your responsibility grows. This is the starting point, not the ceiling.

 

 

===============================================

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

===============================================

 

Do not send a generic application. We read every one, and generic applications go straight to the bottom.

 

Send us the following.

 

1. YOUR PORTFOLIO.

A link or a PDF. We want to see 3D CAD work: parts, assemblies, drawings. Personal projects are fine. Show us the process, not just pretty renders.

 

2. ANSWERS TO THESE FOUR QUESTIONS.

Keep them short and specific.

 

Which CAD software do you use, how long have you used it, and what is the most complex thing you have modelled?

 

Go to 
, look at our brands, and pick one product. What would you change about it, and why?

 

Why do you want this job specifically, and where do you want to be in three years?

 

Are you willing to fly to Manila and to China for work, with all costs covered by us? Yes or no.

 

3. PUT THE WORD SAMPLE IN YOUR SUBJECT LINE

so we know you read the whole post.

 

If your application stands out, we will schedule a call. If the call goes well, we will give you a small paid test project, so we both know what we are getting into.

 

We are taking our time to find the right person. If that is you, this could be the job you stay in for the next ten years.

 

 

===============================================

 

Kranis B.V.

Poeldijk, Netherlands

Manila, Philippines

Suzhou and Yancheng, China

title: Copywriter (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000+ monthly (with performance bonuses)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry, and they don’t pay us for views or pretty content. They pay us for leads, booked calls and closed business.



This role is a big part of that engine. Your job is to come up with strong angles for each client, and then write everything that carries those angles: video ad scripts, image ads, landing page copy, VSL scripts, Meta ad copy, and follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages. Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets, and you’ll know within days whether it worked. If that excites you, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You’ll join our ads department and work alongside team members with different specialist skill sets across media buying, funnels and creative, plus our strategists and the founder. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast. Main channel is Meta. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate, which means trust-based selling.



What you’ll do

• Come up with strong angles for each client based on their positioning, audience and offer

• Write high converting video ad scripts, image ad copy, VSL scripts, landing page copy and Meta ad copy

• Write follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages that keep leads moving towards booked calls

• Review results weekly with the ads lead, spot the winning angles, and write the next round based on data

• Write for real Singapore FA and RE audiences based on what they actually think and want. No generic “financial freedom” filler

• Build our angle library as you go, so every winning angle compounds for the whole team



How you’ll be measured

Hit rate. Out of every batch of scripts you write, a minimum share needs to become winners: strong lead costs, campaigns that can scale. Our current bar is at least 2 winners out of every 8 video scripts. You’ll see your numbers every week. Good writers want to be measured. It’s how you prove you’re good.



You’ll do well here if you

• Care about the difference between copy that reads well and copy that converts, and chase the second

• Rewrite your own hooks before anyone asks

• Study why an ad worked, not just that it worked

• Take feedback well. Your copy gets reviewed, tested and sometimes rewritten. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

• Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We’re not saying no life outside work. We’re saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Prefer writing from templates instead of thinking through the audience and angle each time



No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You’ve written copy for service professionals

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you’ve done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets. Fast feedback, real stakes, visible results

• Direct access to the founder and strategists. You learn how campaigns are actually planned, not just briefed

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Real room to grow into a senior copy and strategy role as we scale



How to apply



 
 with the subject line: 

Your Next Copywriter - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

• Cover letter: years of copywriting experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: your 3 best pieces of ad copy or scripts, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining the choices you made

• One short exercise: pick any ad you’ve seen that you think is weak, and rewrite the hook. A few lines is enough. We’re looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Every client we work with started as a conversation someone had to start. This role starts those conversations.

You'll be the front end of our business development: reaching out to potential clients, keeping conversations warm, and making sure no opportunity slips through the cracks. It's a hands-on, execution-focused role — and it's how careers in sales and business development actually begin. Not with a fancy title, but with learning how to open doors, day after day, and getting paid more when more of them open.

If you're organised, consistent, and not afraid to message a stranger, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our BD lead and the founder — which means you'll see, up close, how deals actually move from first message to signed client. Outreach runs mainly through LinkedIn, Instagram and
. Prospects are financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. You'll follow proven outreach processes and scripts to start, with real room to improve them as you learn what works.



What You’ll Do

• Reach out to potential clients daily across LinkedIn, Instagram,
 and other platforms

• Start conversations and build genuine initial connections — not spray-and-pray spam

• Follow up consistently so leads stay warm and conversations keep moving forward

How you'll be measured

Conversations started, replies earned, and meetings booked for the BD lead. Your commissions are tied to results, so the better you get at this, the more you earn — and you'll see your numbers every week. If you like the idea of your pay reflecting your output instead of just your hours, you'll enjoy this.



You'll do well here if you

• Show up consistently. Outreach rewards the person who does it every day, not the person who does it brilliantly once a week

• Write like a human. Your messages should read like a real person reaching out, not a template blast

• Don't take silence personally. Most people won't reply — the ones who do are why the job exists

• Sweat the small stuff: names spelled right, follow-ups on time, tracker always current

• Want to grow into a real sales or business development career, and see this as the ground floor of it



This is not for you if you

• Have freelance work or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

Bonus points

• You've done outreach, sales or lead generation before, even informally

• Fresh grads are welcome to apply. We care more about consistency and hunger than years of experience.



What you get

 with the subject line:

Then you'll sit in front of the client and defend it. We're not hiring a content scheduler. title: Virtual Assistant for Renovation Operations

Your role will be to bring structure and follow-through to this workload. You will help turn calls, voice messages,
s, photos, videos, and brief instructions into clearly organised tasks—and then ensure those tasks continue moving until they are completed.



This is not a traditional inbox-and-calendar Executive Assistant role. It is a hands-on coordination and operations position for someone who can work quickly, use practical judgement, follow up confidently, and take ownership without needing constant supervision.



The position will begin part-time, with the potential to develop into a full-time role for the right person.

- Turning
s, calls, voice messages, photos, and site updates into clear action items

title: Short Form Video Editor + Producer
description:
I run Brett Conti, a YouTube channel with more than 1 million subscribers. While the channel primarily focuses on long-form content, I’m looking for a creative producer and editor to help grow our short-form video presence.



In this role, you will:



- Review raw iPhone footage and existing long-form content

- Identify compelling stories, hooks, and moments for short-form videos

- Develop scripts and clear video outlines

- Collaborate with me to refine each concept

- Determine where voiceover or additional footage is needed

- Edit polished, engaging videos optimized for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok



The ideal candidate has strong storytelling instincts, understands how to capture attention quickly, and can manage the creative process from initial concept through final edit. You MUST edit in Adobe Premiere as I will ask for project file.



This is a part-time position with the potential to grow into a full-time role.

title: Email & SMS Marketing Implementor
description:
We’re looking for a detail-oriented, curious, and reliable
 & SMS Marketing Implementor who wants to build strong technical skills in e-commerce marketing.



As an
 Implementor, your primary responsibility will be to build, test, QA, and launch
 campaigns, flows, SMS campaigns, and pop-ups in Klaviyo. You’ll work closely with our
 Strategists and Client Account Managers to turn strategy and creative direction into accurate, polished, high-performing marketing assets.



This is a hands-on execution role. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of the details, catches mistakes before they reach the customer, follows processes carefully, and is genuinely interested in learning how great
 marketing is built.

This position is ideal for someone with 1–2 years of experience in
 marketing, digital marketing, or a related field who wants to sharpen their technical execution skills, learn industry best practices, and gain greater exposure to
 strategy by working alongside experienced marketers.



What You’ll Do



, SMS & Campaign Execution

Build and launch
 campaigns, automated flows, SMS campaigns, and pop-ups in Klaviyo.

Translate copy, creative direction, and campaign briefs into fully functional Klaviyo assets.

Set up campaign and flow components accurately, including links, buttons, images, segmentation, scheduling, and other required settings.

Ensure
s are properly formatted and responsive across desktop and mobile devices.

Maintain consistency with each client's brand guidelines, voice, and visual identity.

Implement revisions accurately and efficiently based on strategist or client feedback.



Quality Assurance & Testing

Perform thorough QA on campaigns, flows, forms, and SMS before launch.

Check links, images, personalization, formatting, segmentation, scheduling, and other campaign settings.

Identify and resolve errors before they reach subscribers.

Test
s across devices and screen sizes when required.

Support A/B testing and other optimization initiatives.

Follow established QA checklists and processes consistently.

Attention to detail is critical to this role. We expect you to take ownership of the quality of your work and proactively flag anything that looks incorrect, unclear, or potentially problematic.



Reporting & Data Support

Assist with sales audit outlines, monthly performance reports, and internal reporting.

Pull and organize accurate campaign and flow performance data from Klaviyo.

Ensure reporting data is complete, accurate, and presented according to internal processes.

Support the team with data collection and performance analysis as needed.



Technical Support & Troubleshooting

Troubleshoot basic issues within Klaviyo and Shopify.

Identify potential technical or setup issues and determine when they need to be escalated.

Help maintain clean and accurate campaign, flow, form, and account setups.

Learn and apply Klaviyo best practices as your technical knowledge develops.



Collaboration

Work closely with

Collaborate with Client Account Managers to ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

Contribute to copy briefs, QA processes, reporting, and other internal workflows.

Communicate clearly when you encounter an issue, need clarification, or identify a potential problem.

Take feedback well and use it to improve future work.



Growth & Development

Participate in internal training, team projects, and professional development opportunities.

Continuously improve your Klaviyo,

Learn from experienced strategists and marketers across a variety of e-commerce brands.

Take on additional responsibilities as your skills and experience grow.

Required

1–2 years of experience in

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
Job Title: Amazon PPC Manager

Industry: Ecommerce / Private Label / Hair Care



Working Days: Monday to Friday

Shift Timings: EST Time Zone



ROLE

We are looking for a skilled and driven Amazon PPC Manager with proven experience in the e-commerce industry, specifically working with the private label model. The PPC Manager is responsible for overseeing the brand's Amazon PPC performance. You will co-create PPC strategies with the brand owner by understanding overall business goals and aligning advertising efforts accordingly.



From launch to scale phases, you will be expected to build, optimize, and manage advertising campaigns, support new product launches, and consistently contribute insights to the broader brand management and product development teams.



RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategy:

• Document and publish the PPC strategy for internal use.

• Define PPC goals that align with both company-wide objectives and individual product targets.

• Convert brand goals into actionable PPC strategies.

• Identify external factors needed for PPC success (e.g., improved product images, review velocity).

• Update strategies regularly—yearly, quarterly, monthly, weekly—to meet evolving goals.

• Implement processes, workflows, and tools needed to execute strategies.

• Attend leadership meetings to realign on priorities and report on PPC performance.



2. Management:

• Develop an organized and effective campaign structure.

• Set and manage bids across ad types.

• Validate keyword research generated by the Product Development team.

• Test placements and monitor performance.

• Oversee Sponsored Products, Brands, Display campaigns, and explore new ad types like Video Ads.

• Feed PPC performance data back into the company to support decision-making.

• Maintain and update internal PPC SOPs.

• Execute PPC campaigns for new product launches.



3. Launch:

• Collaborate with Product Development to prepare for launches.

• Work with the SKU Optimization team to re-launch and fine-tune product positioning.



RESULTS EXPECTED

• PPC targets are aligned with company goals.

• Accurate measurement of PPC metrics.

• Ongoing optimization of campaign variables (bids, budgets, TOS bid adjusters).

• Launches rank new products within budget.

• Keyword graduation and negative matching are handled efficiently.

• Campaign structure and naming conventions are consistently followed.

• Ad spend is strategically allocated, minimizing waste.



REQUIREMENTS

• Proven experience in the e-commerce industry, ideally in a private label Amazon business model.

• Must have experience working in different Amazon marketplaces like US/CA/MX/UK/EU/AU/NZ/Middle East/South East Asia (any of these).

• Deep understanding of Amazon’s advertising ecosystem.

• Hands-on experience managing sponsored products, brands, and display ads.

• Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business goals into PPC action plans.

• Familiarity with launch strategies and performance tracking tools.

• Experience creating and maintaining SOPs.

• Detail-oriented and highly organized.

title: Sales Development Representative | Cold Calling & B2B Sales
description:
Growbi is a marketing agency helping med spas and dental practices in the United States attract more patients and grow their businesses.



We’re looking for a sales-driven professional who can start conversations with business owners, uncover their needs, handle objections, and turn cold prospects into qualified sales meetings.



You will initially focus on outbound prospecting and booking qualified meetings for our closer. As you demonstrate results and develop a strong understanding of our services, there is an opportunity to progress into a full sales role, including discovery calls, presentations, and closing deals.



This role requires real sales ability. You should understand how to build trust, communicate value, and move a prospect toward a buying decision.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Make cold calls to business owners and decision-makers in the U.S.

• Start and develop sales conversations through
 and LinkedIn.

• Ask effective questions to understand prospects’ challenges, goals, and interest in our services.

• Explain how Growbi’s services relate to each prospect’s business needs.

• Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving forward.

• Book qualified meetings with decision-makers who understand the purpose of the call.

• Follow up consistently to nurture opportunities and improve meeting attendance.

• Maintain accurate CRM records and give our closer clear notes about each prospect.

• Work with our sales team to improve outreach scripts, messaging, and conversion rates.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Proven experience in cold calling and outbound B2B sales.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to U.S. business owners.

• Strong discovery, persuasion, objection-handling, and follow-up skills.

• Ability to hold a natural business conversation and adapt beyond a script.

• A results-driven mindset and comfort working toward clear sales targets.

• Strong organization and consistent CRM habits.

• Availability to work during U.S. business hours.

• A reliable internet connection and a quiet environment for calls.



Experience selling digital marketing services, working with med spas or dental practices, or closing B2B deals is a strong advantage.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



We care about qualified meetings that take place and create real sales opportunities. Performance will be evaluated through meeting quality, attendance, pipeline contribution, and consistent outreach activity.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We want someone who is motivated to grow into a full-cycle sales professional. Progression into closing will depend on performance, sales ability, and understanding of our services.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A brief summary of your cold calling and B2B sales experience, including what you sold and who you sold to.

2. Your previous results: calls made, meetings booked, meeting attendance, and closed sales where applicable.

3. A short voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating how you would open a cold call with a med spa owner.

4. Your availability during U.S. business hours and expected compensation.

title: Senior Creator Sourcing Specialist
description:
PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY ON THIS LINK: 



Job Title:Senior Creator Sourcing Specialist 

Location: Fully Remote

Commitment: Full time (operating in UK/EU hours)

Reports to: Head of Creator Team

Salary Range: Salary is dependent on experience

Company: Adcrate Ltd



About Adcrate:



Adcrate is a fast-growing, AI-driven performance marketing agency helping eCommerce and digital product brands scale through creative that converts and paid media that performs. We combine data, testing, and bold ideas to drive real growth for our clients. We’re a fully remote team of strategists, video editors, and performance experts spread across the globe - agile, ambitious, and always experimenting. We move fast, stay curious, and genuinely care about doing great work.



The Role:

As a Senior Creator Sourcing Specialist, you'll take ownership of creator sourcing across a portfolio of eCommerce brands - from understanding what each brand needs and finding the right creators, through to outreach, selection and getting creators agreed and ready to move into production.



This isn't just about sourcing names. We're looking for someone who understands what makes a great creator for a brand, can confidently work alongside our Creative Strategists to recommend the right talent, and can independently own the sourcing process across multiple brands at once.



Once a creator has been selected and their agreement is in place, you'll typically complete a clear handover into Creator Communications, who will manage the creator relationship throughout briefing, filming, footage and delivery. There may also be occasions where you'll continue to own the creator journey through to completion, depending on the brand, project or needs of the team.



What you'll be doing:

- Owning creator sourcing across your portfolio of eCommerce brands

- Understanding individual brand requirements, audiences and creative direction before beginning sourcing

- Proactively sourcing creators who fit each brand's audience, content style and campaign requirements

- Reviewing and assessing potential creators to make sure we're putting forward strong, relevant options rather than simply hitting volume

- Presenting creator recommendations to Creative Strategists and working closely with them to make final selections

- Managing initial creator outreach and communication throughout the sourcing and selection process

- Confirming creator interest, availability, rates and relevant requirements before progressing

- Managing the creator process through to selection and agreement

- Completing a clear handover into Creator Communications once the creator agreement is in place

- Maintaining and continuously building our Creator Pool so the wider team has access to a strong network of relevant, reliable creators

- Identifying creators we've had a great experience with and opportunities to work with them again

- Keeping sourcing requests, creator information and internal tracking accurate and up to date

- Managing multiple brands and sourcing requests at once while keeping on top of priorities and deadlines

- Spotting difficult to source briefs, delays or potential blockers early and proactively finding solutions

- Working closely with Creative Strategists and the wider Creator team to continually improve the quality and efficiency of sourcing

- Where required, owning the wider creator journey beyond sourcing, including briefing, coordination and delivery



What we're looking for:

- You have 1+ years of experience in creator sourcing, influencer marketing, UGC, creator partnerships or a similar role

- You have experience owning creator campaigns/processes from sourcing through to delivery, rather than only one part of the journey

- You have a strong eye for creator quality and understand how to match the right creator, audience and content style to a brand

- You're confident sourcing and reaching out to creators across different platforms and markets

- You're comfortable managing multiple brands, creators and deadlines at once without things slipping through the cracks

- You communicate clearly and confidently with creators and internal teams

- You're proactive - if something is delayed, unclear or isn't working, you're comfortable taking ownership and finding a solution

- You understand UGC and performance-led creative, or you're excited to deepen your knowledge in this space

- You're organised, detail-orientated and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment

- You're someone who naturally takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what happens next



What Success Looks Like:

- Creator requests are consistently delivered on time with no gaps or delays

- Minimal need for follow-ups or chasing

- Clear, accurate communication with creators across all briefs

- Strong creator matches aligned to briefs and brand needs

- Proactive handling of requests (nothing stalls or gets dropped)

- Consistent, reliable delivery across multiple briefs without oversight

- Head of Creator Team is no longer pulled into day to day coordination or fixing issues



Team Interaction:

💬 Slack: is where everything happens. Whether it's client wins, creative feedback, questions, memes, gifs, or sharing what you're up to at the weekend, it's the heart of our remote team.



📞 Weekly Calls & Creative Training: We hold weekly team check-ins, creative reviews and training sessions to keep everyone connected and continuously learning. It's a chance to bounce ideas around, challenge thinking and sharpen your creative skills. Calls are typically held between 2pm-6pm GMT on Mondays and Wednesdays.



✈️ Retreats & Team Socials: We're a remote-first business, but we love getting together in person too. Every year we bring the team together to celebrate wins, reflect on progress and have some fun. So far, we've taken the team to Thailand, with Summer and Winter Socials, team meet-ups and retreats continuing to be a big part of our culture.



📈 Growth & Development: We're big believers that growth doesn't stop once you're hired. Whether it's learning from the team around you, joining creative training sessions, taking on new challenges or developing your leadership skills, we'll support you in growing both personally and professionally.



🎉 Culture: Building a strong remote culture is incredibly important to us. From Quarterly Games Days and team lunches to wellness sessions, challenges and virtual events, we're always looking for new ways to bring the team together and make Adcrate a fun place to work.

title: Video Editor (Remote, Full-time)
description:

title: Creative Strategist – DTC & Meta Paid Social
description:
About the Role



This is a strategy-first role. You will own the creative thinking for two to three DTC accounts — the desires we go after, the avatars we speak to, the angles we test, the concepts that carry them, and the briefs that get them made.



You do not edit video, design statics, or buy media. You will occasionally build reference frames so an editor can see what you mean, but execution is not your job. D
 what gets made, and why, is.



Most of the work sits in health, wellness, and supplements, with room to expand into other e-commerce categories. It is a crowded, compliance-tight space where the gap between a winning ad and a dead one is almost always the angle, not the production quality.



Work Structure & Requirements

Schedule: Central European Time

Compensation: 8 USD per hour **negotiable



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative Strategy



Start from the desire the product actually serves, not the feature list

Identify the core avatar and sub-avatars underneath it, defined by what they have already tried and why it failed them

Turn those into testable angles, then into concepts, then into briefs — three different things, and you brief all three

Maintain a pipeline across angles, formats, hooks, and offers, with a stated reason for every test

Balance net-new concepts against iterations of proven winners



2. Brief Writing



Produce 5–15 briefs per client per week depending on scope, across short-form video, UGC, statics, and native-style formats

Every brief ships ready to execute: hook and opening concept, core message, script or talking points, visual direction, CTA, required assets, and editing notes

Write scripts yourself — an editor should never have to come back and ask what you meant



3. Research



Mine Amazon reviews (positive and negative) for the words customers actually use

Use Google searches to find what the market is confused about

Analyze Meta Ad Library and other ad libraries — what competitors are running, how long it has been live, and the technique underneath it rather than the line itself

Review competitor sites, offers, pricing, and landing pages

Pull voice of customer from Reddit, YouTube comments, ad comments, support tickets, and forums — their own sentence reads as recognition; a paraphrased problem reads as marketing

Identify what the market has already been told and already tried, so you stop repeating a claim it stopped believing



4. Performance Review & Recommendations



Come to performance reviews having already asked for the data you need — chasing the right numbers is part of the role

Diagnose why something won or lost specifically: was it the angle or the execution?

Recommend what to kill, what to iterate, and what to leave running — with the reasoning behind each call

Feed learnings directly into the next round of briefs



5. AI Integration



Use AI as part of your workflow for research, synthesis, ideation support, reference frames, and speeding up mechanical parts of the job

Hooks, angles, and scripts come from you — not AI



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years personally owning creative strategy for DTC paid social — in-house or agency; owning it, not contributing to it

Performance Mindset: You judge creative on hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA/ROAS against a target — not on whether it looks good

Conceptual Clarity: You can explain the difference between a desire, an avatar, an angle, a concept, and a hook without hedging

Copywriting: Excellent written English and real copywriting ability — the hook is the job; you write UGC scripts yourself and brief editors and creators directly

Awareness Levels: You write for different levels of awareness and know why a hook that lands on someone already shopping falls flat on someone who hasn't named the problem yet

Iteration: You iterate deliberately — you know what to change in a winner and what to leave alone

Compliance: Comfortable inside a compliance-tight category; health and supplement claims live within real limits and you write inside them by instinct

Organization: Organized enough to carry two to three brands at once without dropping a deadline

Bonus: Agency experience, worked directly alongside Meta media buyers, experience with advertorials, VSLs, and long-form direct response



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, introduction video and portfolio
