title: WordPress Content & SEO Specialist – Remote
description:
# WordPress Content & SEO Specialist – Remote



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **WordPress Content & SEO Specialist** from the Philippines to help us improve and update an established travel website about Málaga, Costa del Sol and Andalusia in Spain.



This is not a new website. The website already contains approximately **400 English pages**, and our goal is to systematically refresh, improve and optimise the existing content.



In a later phase, the same website structure will also be expanded and optimised in **German, Spanish and Japanese**, resulting in a large long-term project with more than 1,500 pages.



## Main Responsibilities



Your main task will be to update and improve existing WordPress pages using **ChatGPT and Rank Math SEO**.



Typical tasks include:



* Refresh and improve existing website content

* Rewrite outdated or weak sections using ChatGPT

* Improve readability and content structure

* Add or improve headings such as H2 and H3

* Improve introductions and conclusions

* Add useful FAQ sections where appropriate

* Improve internal linking between related pages

* Check existing links and identify broken or outdated links

* Add relevant external links to authoritative sources when useful

* Improve image ALT text

* Improve meta titles and meta descriptions

* Optimise pages using Rank Math SEO

* Select and use appropriate focus keywords

* Improve keyword placement without keyword stuffing

* Improve Rank Math SEO scores

* Improve structured content for Google and AI search engines

* Review existing content for outdated information

* Correct formatting problems inside WordPress

* Follow our existing page templates and website structure



You will mainly work on **existing pages**, not create completely new websites.



## Tools You Will Use



You should already be comfortable working with:



* WordPress

* Rank Math SEO

* ChatGPT

* Google Search

* Google Search Console

* Basic keyword research tools



Experience with the following is an advantage:



* Bricks Builder

* Advanced Custom Fields / ACF

* Local SEO

* Schema markup

* Google Analytics

* AI-assisted content optimisation

* multilingual WordPress websites



## Important: How We Use ChatGPT



We actively use ChatGPT to improve and update content.



However, we do NOT want somebody who simply copies and pastes AI-generated text.



You must be able to:



* give ChatGPT good instructions

* evaluate AI-generated content

* correct inaccurate information

* remove unnecessary or repetitive text

* verify important facts

* keep the content natural and useful for real travellers

* maintain a consistent writing style throughout the website



The objective is **better content**, not simply more content.



## About the Website



The website is an established travel guide focusing on:



* Málaga

* Costa del Sol

* Axarquía

* Andalusia

* attractions

* beaches

* restaurants

* events

* villages

* activities

* local travel information



Approximately **400 English pages** currently need to be reviewed and improved.



After the English version has been completed, we plan to work on:



* German

* Spanish

* Japanese



This means there is substantial potential for **long-term cooperation**.



## What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* very good written English

* solid WordPress experience

* practical Rank Math SEO experience

* good understanding of on-page SEO

* experience using ChatGPT professionally

* strong attention to detail

* ability to follow detailed instructions

* ability to work independently

* ability to work systematically through a large number of pages

* good research skills

* reliable communication



You do NOT need to be a programmer.



This position is primarily about **content optimisation, WordPress and SEO**.



## Very Important



We are looking for someone who works carefully and consistently.



We prefer quality over speed.



We do not want:



* automatically generated low-quality AI content

* keyword stuffing

* generic SEO text

* mass-produced articles without fact checking

* unnecessary rewriting of good existing content

* black-hat SEO

* automated backlink building



Many of the existing pages already contain valuable original information. Your job is to **improve what already exists**, not replace everything.



## Working Arrangement



* Remote position

* Philippines-based applicants preferred

* Long-term project

* Initial focus: approximately 400 English pages

* Additional languages and pages later

* Flexible working hours possible

* Part-time  depending on experience and availability



We will initially start with a small number of pages to evaluate the quality of your work.



If the cooperation works well, there is enough work available for a long-term position.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your experience with WordPress

2. Your experience with Rank Math SEO

3. How you currently use ChatGPT for SEO or content optimisation

4. Examples of WordPress websites or SEO projects you have worked on

5. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary

6. How many hours per week you are available

7. Your internet connection and normal working hours

8. Whether you have experience with travel websites or local SEO



Please also answer this question:



**If you were given an existing 1,500-word WordPress travel page with a Rank Math score of 55/100, what would be the first five things you would check before changing the content?**



Applications that do not answer this question may not be considered.



### Please note



We are looking for a person who wants to understand the website and improve it over time — not someone who simply runs pages through ChatGPT and publishes the result.

title: CS Lead — New Brand Launch (Health & Wellness / Shopify)
description:
We're one of the fastest-scaling brands in the health and wellness supplements space, running branded subscription products on Shopify. Over the last few months we've grown immensely, and we're not slowing down.



We're now launching a second brand, and we're looking for an experienced CS professional based in the Philippines to help us build the customer support operation from the ground up. You will have direct access to the SOPs, workflows, and team behind our first brand. You are not starting from zero. You are taking a proven playbook and applying it somewhere new, with room to shape it as we grow.



This is a full-time role from day one. You will split your time between our two brands, spending part of your day running CS for the new store, and part of it embedded in our existing operation. That means joining management meetings, working alongside our CS manager, and learning how a scaled CS team actually runs. Most roles ask you to figure it out on your own. This one puts you inside a working machine while you build the next one.



But make no mistake. The new store needs someone who does not wait to be told what to do. You will need to communicate clearly, flag issues before they become problems, and bring your own ideas to the table. We want someone with a genuine sense of initiative and the confidence to act on it.



The Role



In the early stage, you will be working alongside two experienced CS agents from our first brand who are joining to help get things off the ground. That means you are not alone from day one, but you are the one setting the tone. Your job is to handle tickets, build the foundation alongside the team: the SOPs, the response frameworks, the escalation flows, the documentation. As the brand grows and the team grows with it, you grow into the lead role. The path is clear. The timeline depends on how fast we scale, and we scale fast.



You will have a direct line to the Co-Founder and access to our CS Manager and Operations Lead from brand one. Their experience is yours to learn from. We are not leaving you to figure it out alone.



What You Will Do



Handle customer inquiries across
 and other channels, maintaining our quality and tone standards

Work with the existing team to adapt proven SOPs and workflows for the new brand

Help build and document the CS infrastructure from the ground up: response templates, escalation processes, FAQs

Use Claude AI and ChatGPT as a core part of your daily workflow. Every response goes through AI

Flag patterns, issues, and improvement opportunities early, when they are easiest to fix

Grow into the lead role as the brand scales and the team around you grows

Participate in weekly team calls across both brands



Tools and Platforms



Commslayer (similar to Gorgias or Zendesk)

Shopify



Claude AI and ChatGPT (daily use, non-negotiable)

Parcel Panel (nice to have)

Google Sheets or Notion for documentation



What We Are Looking For



- Minimum 2 years in a lead or senior CS role, this is a hard requirement. Not a preference. Tell us in your application what that looked like: how many agents you worked with, what you owned, and what improved because of you

- Minimum 2 years of e-commerce customer support experience

- Fluent written English, clear, professional, and on-brand

- Genuinely comfortable with AI tools as part of your daily workflow

- A strong communicator who keeps people informed and flags things early

- Proactive and organised, someone who builds structure rather than waits for it

- Comfortable with an async, check-in style of work

- Some overlap with US timezone hours is a plus

- Honest with time tracking and ready to commit for the long term



Nice to Have



Experience setting up or building out a CS operation, not just working inside one

Direct Shopify CS experience

Background in supplements, health, or wellness

Familiarity with AI-assisted response workflows or prompt templates



What We Offer



A founding role on a new brand with real ownership from day one

A proven playbook behind you: SOPs, workflows, and a team that has already done this once

A clear path into a CS Lead role as the brand grows, and we grow fast

Direct line to the Co-Founder, our CS Manager, and our Operations Lead, short lines, real feedback

Weekly team calls across both brands, you are part of something bigger from the start

A role that scales with you. We promote from within and reward people who show up and build



How to Apply



Tell us about your CS experience and the most relevant thing you have built, owned, or improved in a previous role. We want to understand how you think, not just what you have done. Please start your application with the word: Mango. Applications that do not include it will not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you.



Cristian

title: Social Media Designer
description:
PILATES ADDICTION ROSWELL

Social Media Designer — Instagram & Brand Content

Studio: Pilates Addiction Roswell (DyLumyn LLC) · 1425 Market Blvd #1375A, Roswell, GA 30076

Reports to: Social Media Director

Status: Part-time · At-will

Handle: 

Pilates Addiction Roswell is a new reformer Pilates studio with a black-and-gold brand and a community built on real member and educator stories. We need someone to bring those stories to life on Instagram — starting immediately, not after a ramp-up.

What you’ll do

• Design Instagram feed posts, carousels, Stories, and Reels covers on brand (black and gold, approved type and logo usage).

• Build complete campaigns end to end — concept, visual system, copy direction, asset set, posting sequence — from a short brief.

• Keep a constant stream of new, meaningful content going out: member wins, educator stories, class formats, events, studio milestones. The feed never goes quiet and never looks recycled.

• Use provided content (photo and video), and digital stack content then edit and cut it into publishable assets.

• Build reusable templates so recurring graphics (schedules, promos, event announcements) turn around fast.

• Handle adjacent design work as it comes up: event banners, flyers, signage,
 and text graphics.

• Work to the direction and calendar set by the Social Media Director. All designs require approval by the Social Media Director in conjunction with management before publishing. Turn revisions quickly.

• Data entry: transfer the finalized monthly class schedule from the studio’s instructor scheduling app into Mindbody — educator, format, date, time, front desk — accurately and on deadline. Roughly 2 hours/week. Flag discrepancies rather than guessing.

What we’re looking for

• A portfolio of social-first design work. What you’ve made matters more than where you studied.

• Advanced skill in Adobe Creative Suite and/or Canva Pro/ Digital Stack (access can be provided)

• Real Instagram craft — you know what stops a scroll and how a grid reads as a whole.

• Ability to deliver a full campaign independently, fast, at a quality level that looks like a national brand.

• Strong short-form copy instincts.

• Accuracy and discipline with schedule data entry.

Preferred: fitness, wellness, or boutique studio experience · Mindbody familiarity · photo and short-form video editing · Pilates or group fitness background.



Expectations from day one

Campaigns running and content publishing within the first week — no lengthy onboarding curve. You’ll be handed direction and existing raw material, and we expect finished, on-brand work back quickly. You will have to adjust your hours to overlap with the social media director (please confirm compliance with Standard Eastern Time work schedule)

Terms

Work made for hire; all output is the property of DyLumyn LLC DBA Pilates Addiction Roswell. Studio, member, and educator content is confidential.

Compensation

$4-$6/ hr paid weekly via agreed upon method.

Hours

35 hours the first week; 15–20 hours per week thereafter, with adjustments to the schedule and hours at the sole discretion of the studio owner.

To apply

Send a résumé and portfolio or Instagram handles you’ve designed, plus one short note: pick any post 
 and tell us what you’d have done differently. A sample black-and-gold graphic is encouraged.

title: Paid Ads Specialist (WFH /Remote)
description:
Trident Digital | Singapore

Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Salary: SGD 1,500 monthly (with performance bonus)

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their field, and they measure us on one thing: leads that turn into booked calls and closed business.

This role owns that engine. You’ll lead our ads department from day one, running Meta campaigns end to end across our client accounts, with real budget responsibility and real say in strategy. You’ll work directly with the founder. We’re not hiring someone to press buttons in Ads Manager. We’re hiring someone who wants to own outcomes.



What the setup looks like

You’ll lead a small ads team with different specialist skill sets across media buying, copy and funnels. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast, which means the team under you grows as we do. Meta is the main channel, YouTube is a plus. Stack includes GoHighLevel. Client accounts and our processes are documented, so you’re not walking into a mess.



What you’ll do

• Own Meta campaigns end to end: strategy, structure, launch, optimisation and scaling

• Make the performance calls: what to turn off, what to scale, what to test next, and explain why

• Direct creative: give the copywriter and creative team briefs so clear they can execute without a second meeting

• Protect the funnel: catch landing page and tracking issues before they waste budget

• Keep clients in the loop: your analysis and recommendations go to clients through our ops team, so clients always know what’s happening and why

• Run the weekly ads huddle and keep every account’s status honest





How you’ll be measured

Steady lead costs across the accounts you manage, fast turnaround on launches and fixes, and accounts kept healthy. If you like being judged on results instead of activity, you’ll enjoy this.



You’ll do well here if you

• Feel personally responsible when a campaign underperforms, before anyone points it out

• Can look at an account and tell a clear story: what’s working, why, and what you’re testing next

• Think in full funnels: ad, landing page, offer, follow up, not just what happens inside Ads Manager

• Communicate clearly and proactively. The team should never have to chase you for an update



This is not for you if you

• Want a quiet execution role where someone else makes the decisions

• Have freelance ad accounts or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

• Report numbers without opinions. “CTR dropped 12%” is data. “CTR dropped because the hook fatigued, and here’s the next test” is the job

No hard feelings either way. Different roles suit different people.



Bonus points

• You’ve run lead generation for service businesses

• Bigger bonus: financial advisory, insurance or real estate

• Biggest bonus: Singapore market experience



What you get

• Lead the ads department from day one, working directly with the founder

• Real decision-making power: you shape strategy, not just execute someone else’s plan

• A team that invests in its people: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, overseas team trips

• As the agency scales, your scope and team scale with you





HOW TO APPLY

Please
 your application to 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Paid Ads Specialist – [Your Full Name]



Your
 should include:

• Cover Letter (years of experience running paid campaigns and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital)

• Updated CV / Resume

• Portfolio: your 3 best pieces of ad copy or scripts, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining the choices you made

• One campaign that didn’t go to plan: what went wrong and what you changed because of it. Everyone who’s run enough campaigns has one. We’re interested in how you learn.

• Expected Salary (in SGD)



Important: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor | Skincare/Beauty DTC | AI Video + UGC | 7-8 Figure Brand Experience
description:
WHO WE ARE

We're a performance-driven skincare brand scaling aggressively on Meta. We're not looking for pretty videos, we're looking for videos that convert cold traffic into customers.



Our creative strategy is rooted in deep audience psychology, direct-response principles, and relentless testing. We treat creative as our primary growth lever, not an afterthought.



THE ROLE

We need a video editor who understands that every frame, cut, and text overlay has one job: keep them watching and get them to click.



You'll be editing:

• UGC-style testimonial ads (scripted, authentic feel)

• AI-generated video content (faceless formats, b-roll heavy)

• Hook variation testing (multiple openings, same body)

• Static-to-video hybrids and motion graphics

• Long-form VSLs and short-form scroll-stoppers



This is not brand content. This is direct-response advertising where we measure success in CPAs, hook rates, and hold rates—not likes.



WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

• Editing 10-20+ ad variations per week across multiple concepts

• Cutting UGC footage into tight, scroll-stopping sequences

• Working with AI-generated visuals (Veo3, Sora2, HeyGen, etc.)

• Adding captions, text overlays, and motion elements for retention

• Creating hook variations for A/B testing

• Iterating quickly based on performance data





YOU'RE A FIT IF:

? You've edited for DTC brands doing $1M+/month in paid social spend

? You have a portfolio of ads with proven performance metrics (not just "pretty" work)

? You understand direct-response principles: hooks, open loops, pattern interrupts, pacing for retention

? You've worked with AI video tools (Veo3, Sora2, HeyGen, etc. or similar)

? You can turn a 2-minute UGC clip into a 45-second high-converting ad

? You know why the first 3 seconds matter more than everything else combined

? You've edited for Meta, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts

? You can work fast without sacrificing quality. This is a volume game

? You're obsessed with performance metrics, not just aesthetics



BONUS POINTS:

? Experience in skincare, beauty, or health/wellness DTC

? Familiar with brands like, Seranova, Alpha Infuse, Spartan, or similar

? Can handle light AI voiceover work or know tools like ElevenLabs

? You've edited winning ads that scaled past $100k+ spend



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF:

? Your portfolio is mostly brand content, music videos, or YouTube vlogs

? You've never worked on performance-measured campaigns

? You think "good editing" means cinematic transitions and color grading

? You can't deliver multiple variations quickly

? You need detailed frame-by-frame instructions for every edit



TOOLS WE USE (familiarity preferred):



Premiere Pro or Capcut (required)


 or similar for review/feedback

AI tools: Veo3, Sora2, HeyGen, ElevenLabs

Google Docs for briefs and scripts



HOW WE WORK



You'll receive detailed creative briefs with scripts, visual direction, and reference ads (when possible)

Turnaround expectations: 24-48 hours for standard edits, same-day for hook variations

Feedback is direct, specific, and performance-driven

We iterate fast: winning hooks get expanded, losing concepts get cut

Communication via Slack





COMPENSATION



- Competitive project-based or hourly rate (based on experience)

- Potential for ongoing retainer as we scale creative volume

- Performance bonuses tied to winning ads (ads that scale get rewarded)





TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:



• Portfolio link with specific examples of direct-response/performance ads you've edited (not brand content)

• Brief case study (2-3 sentences) on an ad you edited that performed well—what was the result? (CPM, CPA, spend scaled, etc.)

• AI video experience: List the AI tools you've used & include an example

• Your editing setup: Software, hardware, turnaround capacity

• Answer this question: "What's the #1 mistake you see in underperforming video ads?"



Important: Applications without a portfolio or that don't answer the screening question will not be reviewed.

We're looking for someone who geeks out on conversion rates as much as clean cuts. If that's you—we want to talk.

title: VIdeo Editor for Meta/Facebook Direct Response Ecommerce Ads, Short-form/VSLs
description:
Looking for an Ambitious Video Editor Who Wants to Become Top 1%



We’re looking for a passionate video editor who genuinely enjoys creating videos that make money for brands.



We run several 7-figure ecommerce brands in the US and primarily advertise through Meta/Facebook using fast-paced short-form video ads, AI-generated B-roll, AI characters, and UGC-style content.



Example ad: 



The editing itself is not overly complicated. What matters much more to us is that you learn quickly, enjoy editing, can work in a fast-paced environment, think creatively instead of only following instructions, constantly look for ways to make an ad better, and genuinely want to improve your skills.



We are willing to invest heavily in teaching and developing the right person, with the goal of helping you become a top-tier DTC video editor.



If your goal is to rapidly improve your skills, take on a lot of work, and build a long-term career, this could be a great opportunity.



If you're mainly looking for a relaxed side job with very little pressure or volume, this probably isn't the right fit.



You do NOT need AI experience, but it is ideal if you have some.



We will provide the tools, software, systems, and initial training you need.



Professional editing experience is also not the most important thing to us. If you have strong fundamentals, good taste, motivation, and the ability to learn quickly, we want to hear from you.



What you'll actually do:



We give you the script.



You generate content using our AI tools, find suitable B-roll, and put everything together into engaging 1–2 minute Meta ads.



You will also handle pacing, cuts, visuals, music, and creative touches that make the ad more engaging.



Captions are automatically generated and we can provide the software.



Scripts are provided by us.



Compensation:



We start with 1–2 paid test projects at approximately $10/hour, paid per completed video.



If things go well, we quickly increase the amount of work.



As your skill and reliability improve, we can increase your rate over time.



Our ideal outcome is to find someone we can work with for years, potentially full-time, who could eventually become a senior editor and even help train other editors.



Hiring process:



1. Send us examples of your previous work and a short introduction. Tell us why you started editing, your experience so far, what you enjoy about editing, and why this opportunity interests you.



2. We'll have a short call with the strongest applicants.



3. If you're a good fit, we'll immediately start with 1–2 paid test projects.



4. During the first two weeks, you'll ideally edit around 10–15 videos, usually around one minute long.



5. If the quality is strong, we'll continue increasing your workload, responsibility, and pay.



We're not looking for someone who simply wants to complete tasks.



We're looking for someone who wants to become exceptionally good at this.

title: Social Media & Performance Marketing (Independent Contractor)
description:
About Kids Chalet



At Kids Chalet (
), we believe that every child deserves a loving, safe and inspiring environment where they can grow, learn and thrive. Our bilingual daycare and preschool combines high-quality early childhood education with a warm, family-oriented environment.



Our first location opened in Emmen (Lucerne) in May 2026, and we are building Kids Chalet with the ambition to grow into a leading bilingual childcare provider in Switzerland.



As we grow, our digital presence plays an increasingly important role in connecting Kids Chalet with families who are looking for the right childcare solution for their children.



Your Role



We are looking for a Social Media & Performance Marketing Manager who can turn our social media presence into measurable business results.



You will be responsible for developing and executing paid and organic social media strategies across Instagram,
, TikTok and LinkedIn, with a particular focus on generating qualified leads, increasing tour enquiries and converting digital interest into new enrolments.



You will work closely with our Social Media Assistant, who is responsible for creating and preparing organic content. Your role is to take that content, identify what resonates with our target audience and turn it into effective campaigns that reach the right families at the right time.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands both social media and performance marketing and enjoys working with data, testing ideas and improving results.



What You Bring

• Proven experience in social media management, digital marketing, performance marketing or a comparable role.

• Strong practical knowledge of Instagram,
, TikTok and LinkedIn.

• Hands-on experience creating and managing paid social media campaigns, particularly through Meta Ads Manager.

• A strong understanding of lead generation, conversion funnels, retargeting and audience targeting.

• Experience analysing campaign performance and making decisions based on data.

• An understanding of how to turn social media attention into measurable commercial results.

• Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics and/or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of social media trends, short-form video and digital advertising formats.

• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines independently.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. German is highly advantageous.

• A creative, entrepreneurial and solution-oriented mindset.

• Strong attention to detail and an ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the wider Kids Chalet team.



Experience in childcare, education, family services, hospitality or another consumer-facing sector is an advantage, but not essential.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured primarily by business outcomes rather than follower numbers alone. Make sure to write "Kids Chalet - take off" in your
 header to be considered for the job.



Key objectives include:

• Increasing the number of qualified enquiries generated through digital channels.

• Increasing the number of families booking tours.

• Improving the conversion of digital leads into enrolments.

• Reducing the cost per qualified lead.

• Increasing the return on advertising spend.

• Identifying and scaling campaigns that consistently generate new families for Kids Chalet.

• Building a strong and recognisable Kids Chalet presence across relevant social media platforms.



What You Can Expect From Us

• A meaningful role in the growth of a young and ambitious Swiss childcare company.

• The opportunity to shape Kids Chalet's digital marketing strategy from an early stage.

• A collaborative and entrepreneurial working environment.

• Flexible working arrangements remote work.

• The opportunity to take ownership of campaigns and see the direct impact of your work.

• A warm and supportive team environment.

• Flexible working hours and company holidays over Christmas.

We are seeking a SEMrush Specialist to manage our SEMrush platform, analyse its data, and provide actionable recommendations to optimise our clients' digital strategies.





Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced SEMrush Specialist to oversee the management and analysis of SEMrush data, offering insights and recommendations to various internal teams. This role is critical for developing and refining SEO and digital marketing strategies, based on in-depth analysis of SEMrush data. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in using SEMrush and have a strong understanding of SEO, PPC, and competitive analysis.





Key Responsibilities:



Manage and monitor the SEMrush platform to track SEO performance, keyword rankings, and overall site health for our clients.

Analyse SEMrush data, providing detailed reports on SEO, PPC campaigns, competitor analysis, backlink profiles, and content performance.

Develop and recommend strategies for improving organic search rankings, increasing website traffic, and optimising digital marketing efforts based on SEMrush insights.

Collaborate with content, SEO, and marketing teams to align strategies with SEMrush data, ensuring all digital efforts are data-driven.

Conduct keyword research using SEMrush to identify high-potential keywords and provide recommendations for content optimisation.

Identify and track competitors' activities, providing insights on their strengths and weaknesses using SEMrush competitive analysis tools.

Stay up to date with SEMrush updates, new features, and industry trends to ensure we are maximising the platform's potential.

Generate regular reports on SEMrush performance metrics for different teams, including SEO health, keyword movements, and traffic changes.

Offer training and support to internal teams on SEMrush best practices and usage to ensure everyone is leveraging the platform effectively.

Work with teams to ensure technical SEO issues flagged by SEMrush are addressed and resolved.



Required Skills and Qualifications:



Proven experience in using SEMrush as a core tool for digital marketing analysis and strategy development.

Strong understanding of SEO, PPC, keyword research, and competitive analysis.

Ability to interpret SEMrush data and translate it into actionable insights and strategies.

Experience in creating reports and dashboards that effectively communicate SEMrush findings to various teams.

Familiarity with SEO best practices, on-page optimisation, and technical SEO.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise recommendations based on impact.

Strong communication skills to present data and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Familiarity with digital tools like HubSpot, Basecamp, and SharePoint or similar for managing workflows and collaboration.



Preferred Skills:



Experience in SEO strategy development, using SEMrush data as a foundation.

Knowledge of content marketing and its relationship to SEO performance.

Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other digital marketing tools.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a remote work environment.

Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Researcher — US Marketplace
description:
Join an established, long-term Amazon business. We have been operating for over 4 years and are building a stable remote team, not hiring for a short-term, high-turnover role. One of our current team members will reach 3 years with us this October.



We offer structured onboarding, ongoing support, performance reviews and genuine opportunities to increase your earnings as you grow in the role.



Salary: ₱30,000 per month

Bonuses: We have a monthly bonus scheme in place, available from day one. Full details can be discussed on a call.

Performance review: Salary increase review within the first 3 months, based on performance

Other benefits: 22 days paid leave, 13th-month pay and long-term progression opportunities

Hours: Full-time, 8 hours per day. You may choose your start time, provided your 8 hours are completed by 5:00 PM Philippine time each working day.

Location: Remote - Philippines-based applicants



We are an established US-focused Amazon online arbitrage business looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Amazon Product Researcher to join our remote team.



Your role will be to find profitable products from US online retailers and analyse them for resale on Amazon US.



This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who already understands US online arbitrage and can confidently assess leads using the relevant software and Amazon data.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Research profitable online-arbitrage products from US retailers every day

• Analyse potential products using Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

• Check sales rank, price history, offer count, estimated sales, competition, fees, ROI and profit margins

• Create and maintain accurate product-lead spreadsheets, including source links, buy cost, selling price, ROI, profit, BSR, seller count and relevant notes

• Identify and avoid restricted brands, gated products, hazmat items, IP-risk products, bundles and other unsuitable leads

• Look for discounts, cashback opportunities, retailer promotions and valid discount codes where relevant

• Stay up to date with Amazon policies, OA sourcing practices and retailer changes

• Consistently identify high-quality, buyable leads. As a general guide, strong researchers often submit around 5–10 suitable leads per day, but quality and purchase value matter more than raw lead volume

• Communicate clearly with the team and respond positively to feedback



PRODUCTS WE PREFER



We source across a range of categories, but our strongest areas generally include:



• Tools and home improvement

• Coffee and kitchen-related products

• Clothing and footwear

• Electronics and accessories

• Household and practical consumer products



We are generally not focused on beauty, and we do not usually prioritise toys and games. Experience sourcing in our preferred categories is a strong advantage.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



To be considered, you must have:



• At least 12 months of hands-on Amazon online-arbitrage product research experience for the US marketplace

• Fluent written and spoken English; this is essential for the role

• Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

• Experience finding genuine OA leads from a broad range of retailer sites that meet our minimum criteria

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work carefully and independently

• Confidence using Google Sheets or Excel

• A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection and professional work-from-home setup

• Willingness to use time-tracking software during working hours



Experience with cashback sites, retailer discount strategies and coupon finding is also highly valued.



PAY, BONUS AND GROWTH



Your starting base salary will be ₱30,000 per month.



We will carry out a performance and salary review within your first 3 months. Strong performance can lead to an increase in base salary.



In addition, we have a well-established monthly bonus scheme. It is already built, tested and available from your first day; it is not a promise for later. Full details of how it works can be discussed on a call.



We are looking for a dependable long-term team member. We provide clear feedback, fair performance expectations and opportunities to develop within the business.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a tailored application and CV. We receive a very high volume of applications, so generic copy-and-paste responses will not be considered.



We want to understand why your experience is suitable for this role, the categories you have sourced in, and how you approach evaluating an OA lead.



SHOW US YOUR WORK



This is the part of the application we care about most. Please provide a small sample of at least 5 leads, showing the variety of retailers and products you typically look at in a day. This can be:



OPTION A: Sample leads or a sample lead spreadsheet. Screenshots or a view-only Google Sheets link are welcome. Please remove or blur confidential information from previous employers.



OPTION B: If you cannot share previous work, find at least 5 current live leads and show your analysis for each: source link, buy cost, expected selling price, Amazon fees, ROI and a brief explanation of why you believe it is a worthwhile purchase.



Either option is acceptable. We would rather see a genuine sample of leads you have analysed than a long generic description of your process. Submitted demonstration leads are for assessment purposes and do not guarantee that we will purchase them.



Please also answer the following in your application:



1. How many years of Amazon online-arbitrage product research experience do you have, specifically for Amazon US?

2. Which product categories and US retailers do you have the most experience sourcing from? Please mention whether you have sourced in areas such as tools, home improvement, clothing, electronics, coffee, kitchen or household goods.

3. Which tools do you use for OA research and analysis? Keepa and SellerAmp SAS experience is required.

4. What daily lead volume and approval rate have you achieved in previous OA roles? Please briefly outline the checks you normally make before submitting a lead.

5. Are you currently working for another Amazon OA seller or sourcing agency? If so, please briefly explain whether there would be any conflict of interest.

6. Are you comfortable using time-tracking software, and when would you be available to start?



Include the word "Copper" in your
 subject line. Applications without this word in the subject line will be ignored.



Please do not submit a bulk or generic template application. We can quickly identify applications that have not been written specifically for this vacancy, and they will not be considered.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
We are looking for someone who combines technical AI skills with strong video editing and sound design.



The role has two parts: setting up an LTX video-generation system, either locally or on rented GPU servers, and using it alongside conventional editing to create engaging children’s YouTube videos.



We want someone who can turn photos, illustrations, narration and music into polished videos that feel alive, rather than basic slideshows.



You need to be comfortable with both the technical setup and the creative production. Experience using online AI generators alone is not sufficient.



1. Set up our LTX video-generation system



Review our existing hardware and requirements, then recommend whether we should run LTX locally or through rented GPU servers. Explain the likely costs, performance, limitations and ease of use before we agree on an approach.



Once agreed, you will install and configure LTX, the necessary dependencies and a suitable interface such as ComfyUI. We only need the chosen solution implemented, not both local and cloud systems.



Create a reusable image-to-video workflow that allows us to upload an image, enter a prompt, adjust the main settings and generate a clip.



Test the system with our supplied images, troubleshoot problems and demonstrate the actual generation times and output quality. We need realistic expectations, including the cost and time involved in unsuccessful generations and retries.



Cost control is important. For rented servers, explain all ongoing charges, configure appropriate idle or shutdown controls where supported, and clearly document how to stop the system and which charges may continue. No spending or recurring commitments should be activated without approval.



Provide the workflow files, setup documentation and a short recorded walkthrough so another team member can operate the system. Accounts and installations must remain under our control.



2. Create visually engaging videos



Use supplied scripts, narration, photos, illustrations, music and songs to create finished children’s story videos.



Combine thoughtful editing with selective AI-generated animation. You should know when animation adds value and when a well-edited still image is the better choice.



Use purposeful camera movements, pans, zooms, layered depth effects, reaction shots and well-timed cuts to support the storytelling. Maintain consistent character appearances and visual style, and reject generated footage with distracting distortions or unwanted changes.



We want a warm, cinematic and imaginative feel, with pacing that holds children’s attention without relying on constant noise, excessive effects or frantic cutting.



For song sequences, the visuals should follow the rhythm and emotional progression of the music.



3. Make the audio engaging and professional



Sound quality is just as important as the visuals.



Preserve the clarity and natural quality of the supplied narration and character voices. Balance dialogue, music, atmosphere and sound effects so speech remains easy to understand.



Use appropriate environmental sounds and well-timed effects to bring scenes to life, without overwhelming the narration. Avoid unnecessary voice processing, distortion, abrupt volume changes or repetitive sound effects.



We need someone who understands how sound supports storytelling, not simply someone who adds a music track underneath a video.



Skills and experience



You should have:



Hands-on experience installing and troubleshooting LTX, together with experience of ComfyUI or a comparable workflow interface.

The ability to assess local GPU hardware and rented GPU options, manage dependencies and resolve technical errors.

Strong editing skills in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent software, including audio mixing and sound design.

A portfolio demonstrating visual storytelling, particularly videos created from still images or illustrations.

Clear English communication, organised project files and the ability to work independently while responding well to feedback.



Experience with children’s content, illustrated stories, animation or music videos would be valuable.



Deliverables



For the setup, we expect a working, tested system, reusable workflows, clear operating instructions and a complete handover.



For ongoing editing, we expect finished videos in the agreed format, editable project files and organised supporting assets.



Use only authorised or appropriately licensed assets. Supplied voice recordings must not be used for voice cloning, model training or unrelated projects.



How to apply



Please include:



Two or three relevant video examples. At least one should demonstrate how you made still images or illustrations engaging. Explain exactly which parts you created, including the audio work.

Evidence of your LTX setup experience. Describe a system you personally installed, the hardware or hosting used, and a technical problem you solved. Screenshots or a short demonstration are welcome, with private information hidden.

Your proposed approach. Briefly explain what you would need to assess local versus rented-server options.

Your rates and availability. Quote the initial setup separately from your ongoing editing rate, and state your weekly availability.

An indicative production timeframe. Estimate how long an 8–10-minute narrated story video would take when the main images, narration and music are supplied. Explain your assumptions.



Please use “LTX Setup and Video Editor” as your application subject.



Paid trial



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid 45–60-second editing test using supplied images, narration and music.



We will assess visual storytelling, pacing, sound design and preservation of voice quality. Technical experience will be assessed separately through a walkthrough of previous work, with the actual installation treated as an agreed paid milestone.



We are looking for someone who can both build a reliable production system and use it to make excellent videos.

title: Ad Creative & Funnel Designer
description:
Must be reachable for live calls 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday. Remaining hours flexible.



About the Role:

Legal Calls is hiring a creative producer to build everything that surrounds our
 and Instagram

ad campaigns — the static image ads, the copy, the landing pages, and the funnels those ads point to.

To be clear about scope: you will not be running or managing the ad accounts. We handle media

buying, budgets, bidding, and day-to-day campaign monitoring in-house. Your job is to produce the assets

that make those campaigns work — and to produce a lot of them, quickly, at a high standard.

If you're a strong designer who also writes well, and you'd rather spend your day making things than sitting

in Ads Manager, this is the right fit.



What You'll Do:



1. Static Ad Creative:

-Design static image ads for
 and Instagram — feed, story, and reel-still formats, correctly sized and safe-zone aware

-Produce multiple distinct concepts per brief, not one design in five colorways

-Build out variation sets so the team has real options to test — different hooks, layouts, and visual angles

-Keep creative on-brand and appropriate in tone for a legal / professional audience



2. Copy

-Write the ad copy that goes with your designs: hooks, primary text, headlines, descriptions, CTAs

-Write landing page copy — headlines, subheads, body, bullets, form microcopy, CTA buttons

-Write follow-up
 and SMS sequence copy for leads who come through the funnel

-Deliver copy in variation sets so there's something to test



3. Landing Pages & Funnels

-Design and build landing pages that match the ads pointing at them

-Build multi-step funnels: opt-in → qualification → booked call, including thank-you and confirmation pages

-Wire up forms, CRM handoff, and automated follow-up so leads land where they should

-Make sure pages are fast, mobile-first, and clean on every screen size



4. Working With the Team

-Take a brief (offer, audience, angle) and come back with a full creative set without a lot of back-and-forth

-Turn campaign feedback into the next round of creative — when the team says an angle is working, you build more in that direction

-Keep assets organized and named so anyone can find and launch them



What This Role is Not

-You are not the media buyer. No budget management, bidding, audience setup, or daily campaign monitoring.

-You are not responsible for campaign performance metrics. You're responsible for the quality, volume, and speed of the creative.

-You will not need to log into Ads Manager to manage spend — though you do need to understand

the platform well enough to design for it.



What You Need to Have

1. Design

-2+ years designing static ad creative, ideally for paid social

-Strong command of layout, hierarchy, typography, and spacing — your work looks professionally made, not templated

-Fluent in Figma, Photoshop, Canva Pro, or equivalent

-You can work from a brand kit and stay consistent across a large set of assets



2. Meta Ads Knowledge (Design-Side)

-You know Meta ad specs and formats cold: aspect ratios, safe zones, placement differences, text-onimage realities

-You understand what makes a static ad stop the scroll, and what Meta's ad policies will and won't allow — especially in legal and other sensitive categories

-You've seen enough campaign feedback to know the difference between creative that tests well and creative that just looks nice



3.Copywriting

-Native-level written English — this is non-negotiable. Awkward phrasing or translated-sounding copy will not work for this audience

-You can write a hook that earns attention without sounding hyped, clickbaity, or spammy. Legal is a trust-first market

-You can write short (ad copy) and long (landing page) with equal comfort



4. Landing Pages & Funnel Building

-You've built landing pages and funnels yourself in tools like GoHighLevel, Unbounce, Webflow, Framer, ClickFunnels, Leadpages, or WordPress / Elementor

-You understand conversion basics: above-the-fold clarity, form friction, proof and trust signals, mobile layout, page speed

-You can connect forms to a CRM and set up automated follow-up



5. Working With Claude

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Empire Barbershop is AMBA’s #1 Barbershop of the Year for 2025. We’re a single location in Oakleigh becoming something considerably larger — a rebrand lands this quarter, a second site opens early next year, and the plan after that is not modest.



Our core value is Service First. The whole client experience is the product, not just the cut. Our marketing has to be worthy of that, which frankly it currently isn’t. That’s the job.



What you’ll own



 • Reactivation.
 and SMS campaigns across our Fresha database via Klaviyo. This is your first and biggest win — cheapest revenue in the business, currently untouched.

 • Lifecycle marketing. Segmentation, automated flows, win-backs, and a send calendar that runs without being chased.

 • Organic and social. Turning a shop full of talented barbers into a content engine. You won’t be shooting everything yourself — you’ll build the system that makes it repeatable.

 • Influencer and UGC. Local creators, real partnerships, measurable outcomes. Not gifting haircuts and hoping.

 • The relaunch and Christmas campaigns. Both land in your first quarter. No easing in.



How you’ll be measured



We run a weighted scorecard, reviewed quarterly:



 • Qualified leads — 40%

 • Marketing-sourced revenue — 30%

 • Execution and delivery — 20%

 • Brand — 10%



Underneath that: new clients per week, cost per acquired client, new-client rebooking rate, and reactivation rate. You’ll have a real budget and real autonomy to spend it.



Who we’re looking for

You’re not precious about channel purity — if a scrappy SMS blast outperforms a beautiful campaign, you ship the SMS blast.



If your instinct is to report on impressions and follower growth, this isn’t the role.



What’s in it



120k peso, performance bonus tied to the scorecard, and a genuine seat at the table as we scale. You’d also have access to School of Barbers, our sister education business, which gives you a second brand and audience to work with.

Send your CV and a case study on how you would build the brand

title: Instagram Content Creator + Copywriter (Personal Brand / Online Business) — Proven Growth Required
description:
ABOUT US



AGENCY678 is a UK based sales and operations consultancy. We help online agency and service business owners fix their offer and install a proper sales system so they stop leaking revenue they've already earned.



Our core offer is The Velocity System. It's for agency owners already doing consistent months who have stalled because their sales process is held together with good intentions, a messy CRM and a follow up that never happens. We fix the offer, install the system, and recover revenue already sitting in the business. We deliberately don't lead with paid ads.



I'm Zoe, the founder. Ex corporate & online closer, six plus years in sales before I built this. I'm growing my personal brand on 
 and we have aggressive targets for the rest of 2026. Instagram is the engine for that.



THE ROLE



You'll own the creation, copy and scheduling of my Instagram content, with a heavy focus on trial reels.



Day to day:



- Write copy: hooks, captions, story copy, carousel slides, DM scripts. This is a big part of the role, not an afterthought. You'll be given the strategy, the angles and the positioning, and you'll write from it

- Create and schedule trial reels (we run a high volume batch cadence, roughly 5 reels a day)

- Edit talking head video: trim, caption, text overlays, sync music, mute original audio where needed

- Hold the brand visual standards (approved fonts only, text placed in the empty space in frame rather than dead centre, music over muted original audio)

- Track what performs, flag the winners, and tell me what you think we should double down on

- Bring ideas. I don't want an order taker. I want someone who watches the account and says "this angle is working, let's push it"



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



Must haves:



- Strong copywriting. You can write hooks and captions that sound like a real person with a point of view, not like AI. This is the number one thing I'm hiring for alongside proven growth

- Proven experience growing Instagram accounts, with numbers you can show me

- Proven experience creating content that generates organic leads and enquiries, not just views

- Confident editing talking head video for reels

- You understand the online business, agency and coaching space. You know what an offer, a pipeline, a sales call and a close actually are, and you can write about them without sounding vague

- Proactive, organised, and you follow a brief exactly. If I ask for the first 5 for review before you schedule the rest, that's what I need

- Excellent written English



Nice to have but not essential:



Experience with trial reels specifically

Experience writing for a founder or personal brand in the B2B or sales space



What you do NOT need:



You don't need to be a Canva wizard. I'm very happy for content to be created natively in the Instagram app. That's how I work and it suits the style of the account



HOURS AND PAY



Part time, 10 to 20 hours per week

$10 to $20 USD per hour depending on experience and proven results

Long term role for the right person, with scope to increase hours

Some overlap with UK hours preferred, but I'm flexible



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without the below will not be read.



Please send me:



- Two or three Instagram accounts you have grown. Include the handle, how long you worked on it, follower count when you started and when you finished, and screenshots of the insights to back it up

- Proof of ROI. Show me enquiries, DMs, call bookings or sales that came from content you made. Screenshots or numbers are fine

- Three to five examples of reels you personally created and edited. Send links

- Two examples of copy you have written. Captions, hooks, or a carousel. It must be your own writing, not AI

Answer these three questions in your reply:

- What makes a hook stop someone scrolling? Give me one example of a hook you have written that performed and tell me why it worked

- What would you check first if a reel got high views but no enquiries?

- Tell me about a time you spotted something in the content data and changed the approach off the back of it



Start your application with the word VELOCITY so I know you've read the whole thing



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid test task (2 to 3 hours): I'll give you an angle plus some raw talking head footage. You'll write the hook and caption and create the finished reel to my brand standards.



I'm looking for someone who genuinely wants to build something with me, not just tick off tasks. If that's you, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Amazon UK Product Sourcer (Online Arbitrage) - Experienced UK OA Sourcers Only
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Product Sourcer to help us grow and scale our UK Amazon FBA business. The main focus of the role is sourcing profitable products in the UK marketplace, primarily via Online Arbitrage.



WE HAVE THE CAPITAL READY TO SPEND. WHAT WE NEED IS MORE HIGH-QUALITY LEADS. That is the whole job, and it is why we are only looking for proven UK OA sourcers this time. If you are new to sourcing or have only worked the US market, this role is not for you.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE SAME LEADS EVERYONE ELSE BUYS. Deal lists, 
 feeds and the top page of the scanning tools are seen by hundreds of sellers on the same day and the margin is gone within hours. We want a sourcer who can MANUFACTURE THEIR OWN DISCOUNT (stacking codes, clearance, discounts and anything else to make profitable products, price matches, multi-buy and bundle offers, newsletter and app-only promotions) and who can FIND LOW-KEY LEADS that never appear on a shared list: quiet retailers, deep category pages, seasonal clearance, brands with no third-party sellers yet. If you can take a shelf price that shows 5% ROI and turn it into a 25% buy, you are who we want.



The role includes an UNCAPPED BONUS based on the spend on leads you provide. The more we buy from your leads, the more you earn. Our top performing sourcers regularly earn an extra $400+ per month on top of salary, and there is no ceiling. FOR A PROVEN, ABSOLUTE TOP PERFORMER, THE BASE SALARY IS NEGOTIABLE. Show us your track record and we will talk.



The ideal candidate is self-motivated, hungry, and looking for a long-term position with space to grow. We ask that only candidates with real experience of Online Arbitrage product sourcing in the UK marketplace apply.



WHAT AN A-CLASS SOURCER LOOKS LIKE TO US:

- Consistently delivers leads we actually buy, not long lists of borderline ones

- Manufactures margin: knows every legitimate way to get a UK retailer's price down (code stacking, cashback sites, discounted gift cards, loyalty schemes, price matching, multi-buys, app and newsletter codes etc) and builds that into the lead before submitting it

- Finds low-key leads through methods the shared tools and deal lists do not surface: manual retailer digging, storefront and reverse sourcing, deep category and clearance pages, brands with no third-party sellers, seasonal and regional stock

- Uses a wide range of sourcing methods and keeps finding new ones (retailer clearance and promotions, brand and category scanning, Keepa Product Finder)

- Reads a Keepa chart properly: real sales velocity, the real sell price, Buy Box behaviour, etc

- Checks gating, IP risk, variations and VAT before submitting, so leads arrive clean

- Knows UK retailers and discount routes that most sourcing VAs do not



EXPERIENCE REQUESTED (please include details of your experience against each point in your application):

- 12+ months experience in OA sourcing for the UK market specifically

- Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, SellerAmp SAS and Keepa

- Experience in a variety of different sourcing methods for OA (and wholesale or Amazon-to-Amazon if applicable) - list every sourcing method you have used, step by step

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Understanding of UK VAT and UK FBA fees in profit calculations



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Product research and analysis in SAS and Keepa

- Finding your own leads from UK retailers and suppliers using your full range of methods

- Verifying, prioritising and re-checking leads passed to you by the team before they are bought

- Inputting leads into our leads database in the required format, with your reasoning

- Flagging replenishable winners



WHAT WE OFFER:

- $350 / month starting base salary + uncapped performance bonus paid on spend from your leads

- Flexible working hours (40 hours per week, work when suits you, with at least a one hour crossover with UK 9am-5pm for communication)

- Salary reviewed regularly and increased based on contribution and performance; base negotiable for a proven top performer

- Career development: we are expanding our team of VAs and will be promoting internally for managers and purchasers

- Long-term, stable role with a growing UK business



REQUIREMENTS:

- Full-time: 40 hours a week

- You will use timeproof software to demonstrate you are working effectively during contracted hours

- You will work for us and only us; you may not source for other e-commerce sellers at the same time

- Every lead you submit is checked. Padded or copied lead sheets end the trial.

- Include the words "BIG CHEESE" in your application subject. Applications without it are ignored. This is to make sure you have read the post.



TO APPLY:

Respond with the subject line above and include ALL of the following. Applications missing any of these are not read:



1. A brief description of why you are the best candidate and how you can help us grow.

2. Every sourcing method you use, step by step, in your own words. Which retailers, which discount and cashback routes, which Keepa filters, how you stack them. "I use Keepa and SAS" is not an answer.

3. How you manufacture discount. Give us a real example of a deal where the shelf price did not work and you built the margin yourself: which codes, cashback, gift card or loyalty discounts you stacked, in what order, and what the final buy price and ROI came to. Legitimate, publicly available discounts only.

4. 2-3 real UK product leads you have found in the last 7 days that did NOT come from a deal list, 
 feed or the top page of a scanning tool: retailer purchase link, Amazon link, buy price including delivery and any discount applied, sell price, ROI, net profit after VAT and fees, estimated monthly sales, SAS and Keepa screenshots, how you found it, and a short description of why it is a good lead. This is mandatory, not optional, and it carries the most weight in our decision. Leads we recognise from public lists count against you.

5. Your track record: for your last one or two UK clients, roughly how much did they spend per month on your leads, and what ROI did those leads return? Do you have your old lead sheet for us to see example leads?



If you have a CV, portfolio or anything else that demonstrates why we should hire you, include it. Shortlisted candidates get a short video call and a paid two-week trial working real leads.

We want someone who can grow brand accounts for a UK or US audience and push real traffic to a website, and who can also edit and produce short-form content themselves when the calendar needs it. You will not be editing all day (that is what our editor is for), but you must be able to cut a Reel, build a pin, and turn one piece of footage into ten posts without waiting on anyone.

2. Wishes Made Easy (

What hooks, formats, cadence and offers are working, and what we should adapt. Structure and pacing we learn from; claims and footage we never copy.

- AIP growth: help build the social and storefront side of our Amazon Influencer operation, source brand collaborations, and keep the pipeline of products and videos moving. Any AIP experience is a genuine advantage.

 basics, paid-social literacy



WHAT WE OFFER:

 and its social accounts, then find one UK competitor. In 5 bullet points: what the competitor does better on social, and what you would change for Havern in your first 30 days.

description:

Summary

Social Media Copywriter & Content Research Specialist (AI Creator Brand)



We’re looking for an elite social media copywriter and content strategist who understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch, engage, and buy. Social media experience is a Must



This is not a prompt engineering role. We’re not looking for someone who copies ChatGPT or Claude outputs. We’re looking for someone who can think creatively, develop original concepts, and use AI to accelerate execution—not replace strategic thinking.



You’ll be responsible for creating high-converting content for AI influencer-style brands across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.



What You’ll Do



* Research viral content daily across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

* Stay ahead of emerging trends before they become saturated.

* Reverse engineer high-performing creators and understand why their content works.

* Write compelling hooks that maximize retention in the first few seconds.

* Write engaging short-form video scripts.

* Create captions that drive engagement, shares, saves, and conversions.

* Develop storytelling frameworks that build trust and authority.

* Apply buyer psychology and consumer behavior to create content that influences purchasing decisions.

* Create educational, authority-building, entertainment, and sales-focused content.

* Reframe winning ideas into original content for our brands.

* Build repeatable content series instead of one-off posts.

* Collaborate with our creative team to ensure messaging aligns with visuals and brand voice.



Requirements



* Expert knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

* Exceptional written and spoken English.

* Deep understanding of:

    * Hook writing

    * Script writing

    * Storytelling

    * Attention economics

    * Calls-to-action that convert

title: Custom GPT & Claude Skills Builder — Image & Video
description:
Custom GPT & Claude Skills Builder — Image & Video



We’re looking for an experienced Custom GPT and Claude Skills builder specializing in AI image and video prompting.



Your primary responsibility will be to build advanced Custom GPTs and Claude Skills for AI image and video generation — not simply write prompts for us.



Hands-on prompt engineering experience with Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 is required. No exceptions. If you do not have this experience please do not apply 



What You’ll Build



* Custom GPTs for AI image prompting

* Custom GPTs for AI video prompting

* Claude Skills for image and video prompting

* Model-specific prompting systems for Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro

* Model-specific prompting systems for GPT Image 2

* Model-specific prompting systems for Seedance 2.0 and 2.5

* Reference-image analysis and recreation workflows

* Photorealistic image prompting systems

* Character and identity consistency workflows

* Image-to-image prompting systems

* Video shot and scene builders

* Multi-shot video prompting systems

* Prompt troubleshooting and optimization workflows

* Supporting knowledge bases, instructions and SOPs



Required Prompt Engineering Experience



You must have proven, hands-on prompt engineering experience with:



* Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro

* GPT Image 2

* Seedance 2.0

* Seedance 2.5



You should understand advanced image and video prompting, including:



* Photorealistic image generation

* Reference-image prompting and recreation

* Character and identity consistency

* Natural skin, hair and human realism

* Composition, framing and perspective

* Camera angles, lenses and lighting

* Image-to-image generation

* Camera movement and cinematography

* Character movement and action

* Shot construction

* Multi-shot sequences

* Scene-to-scene consistency

* Diagnosing failed generations and correcting prompts



You must understand that different generation models require different prompting methodologies. We are not looking for generic prompts repurposed across every model.



Custom GPT & Claude Skills Development



You must have experience building Custom GPTs and/or Claude Skills and understand how to turn expert prompting knowledge into a system other people can use.



This includes:



* System instructions and prompting architecture

* Knowledge files and supporting resources

* Model-specific prompting logic

* Structured user intake

* Reference-image analysis

* Prompt construction workflows

* Quality-control and self-checking logic

* Troubleshooting workflows

* Prompt revision and optimization

* Maintaining and improving the systems as models evolve



The finished GPTs and Skills should be capable of taking a user’s idea or reference image, understanding the desired output and generation model, and producing a high-quality prompt engineered specifically for that model.



For video, the systems must understand how to translate an idea or reference into properly structured shots, scenes, camera direction, movement, action and sequencing for Seedance.



Testing Is Part of the Role



You will be expected to test the Custom GPTs and Claude Skills against the actual generation models, review the resulting images and videos, identify failures, refine the underlying instructions and prompting logic, and retest.



We are looking for someone who can independently take these systems from initial build → testing → refinement → production-ready workflow.



To Apply



Please provide:



1. Examples of Custom GPTs and/or Claude Skills you’ve built

2. Examples of image or video prompting GPTs/Skills, if available

3. Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro prompts + resulting images

4. GPT Image 2 prompts + resulting images

5. Seedance 2.0/2.5 prompts + resulting videos

6. A short explanation of how you would structure an image/video prompting GPT

7. Your availability

8. Your hourly or project rate



Do not apply if your experience is limited to general ChatGPT prompting. We need someone with proven AI image and video prompt-engineering experience who can build that expertise directly into Custom GPTs and Claude Skills.

title: Video Editor – Turn Scripts into Sales Machines
description:
We're looking for a full-time Video Editor to create high-converting videos and animation-style content for our e-commerce funnels.



This role is for someone who's not just an editor, but a performance-minded storyteller, able to turn scripts into sales assets using the right mix of visuals, pacing, and emotional logic.



Your mission:

Deliver high-quality video content weekly by sourcing the right clips, following scripts, and bringing ideas to life through animation, transitions, and smart editing.



What you'll be doing:



- Edit performance-driven videos based on provided scripts

- Source visual clips from stock platforms, YouTube, UGC, TikTok, etc.

- Use VEO3 AI tool to generate supplemental content when needed

- Create dynamic animations, text callouts, and transitions to improve engagement

- Work with copywriters and funnel strategists to match message and visuals

- Send daily EOD updates with your progress

- Collaborate in a fast-paced team, take feedback, iterate, improve



Requirements:



- Proven experience editing performance-driven or direct response videos

- Ability to source visuals efficiently (stock, UGC, TikTok, etc.)

- Strong sense of direct response structure (Hook ? Problem ? Agitation ? Solution ? CTA)

- Familiarity with tools like VEO3 is a plus, but not a replacement for clip sourcing

- Full-time availability; we are not hiring part-time or agency editors

- Strong communication skills and daily accountability

- Deadline-driven, proactive, and detail-oriented



Do not apply if:



- You only edit short, flashy TikToks with no sales structure

- You expect all assets to be handed to you. You must source content

- You can't commit to full-time work or daily check-ins



Application Questions:



1. Can you share 2–3 links to sales-driven videos you've edited? (Preferably for health, wellness, or beauty products.)

2. What's your process for finding visual content (clips, b-roll, UGC) to match a script? Briefly describe the tools or sources you typically use.

3. Are you available full-time (5 days/week) and able to send daily EOD updates? Yes / No

4. Have you used any AI tools like VEO3 to help with clip creation or editing? If yes, tell us how you used it.

5. What's the most profitable video you've ever edited or helped produce? How much net profit or revenue did it help generate in 90 days? What was your specific contribution to that video? Paste hard evidence (funnel backend, performance dashboards, screenshots, or live links).



Thank you for your application!

title: Micro-influencer / Product Seeding Manager
description:
About the company:

SKIP is a festival / rave recovery supplement. For this seeding project our target audience is Australia: men and women 25–45 who go to electronic music festivals (techno, house, EDM, multi-day events). We want micro-creators who actually look and sound like that crowd: festival lifestyle, afterparty, travel, nightlife. Not generic wellness or gym accounts.



Your work would be:

- find and vet those creators

- personalized outreach for product seeding

- follow up until content is delivered

- check the video against a short brief

- keep outreach, shipments and delivered content, views of the content after 7 days, in a tracker



Offer: USD $4 per uploaded or delivered video from a creator. 



We only count a video as delivered when:

- the creator has uploaded it or sent us the file

- it follows the brief

- product is clearly visible

- quality is usable (light, audio, vertical)



We do not pay for outreach, replies or shipments that do not result in a delivered video.



If that works for you, reply with:

- how many creators you can realistically outreach per day

- how you would source Australian festival / electronic music creators

- when you could start

title: Video Editor / Social Media Creative (100% Remote)
description:
The Role in a Nutshell



We are looking for a CREATIVE and DEPENDABLE Video Editor to support two growing Singapore-based brands:

- A Singapore Real Estate Personal Brand

- BELLEBLUSHSG, a beauty salon specialising in beauty and self-care services



We are not looking for someone who simply cuts clips and adds subtitles. We want someone who understands what makes people stop scrolling—and can turn our raw footage and ideas into polished, engaging short-form content. We will provide the footage and general direction. Your role is to bring the content to life through strong pacing, captions, music, storytelling and a good visual eye.



If you can also contribute content ideas, plan our content and help manage our social media accounts, we are open to expanding the role and offering higher compensation.



What You’ll Be Doing

- Edit approximately 5–6 short-form videos per week

- Create content for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 and other relevant platforms

- Turn raw footage into engaging, easy-to-follow videos

- Add captions, music, transitions, graphics and suitable visual effects

- Create strong openings and maintain good pacing to keep viewers watching

- Adapt each video to the distinct style and audience of our real estate and beauty brands

- Follow the instructions and references provided while contributing your own creative input

- Organise project files and complete reasonable revisions

- Deliver work consistently within agreed deadlines



Expanded Role — Higher Pay Available

- Candidates who can take greater ownership may also assist with:

- Suggesting relevant and creative content ideas

- Identifying suitable social media trends for both brands

- Preparing and maintaining a content calendar

- Writing engaging captions and recommending hashtags

- Scheduling and publishing content

- Managing our social media accounts

- Reviewing content performance and recommending improvements

- Helping us develop a more consistent brand identity and content direction



The final responsibilities and compensation will be based on your experience and the level of ownership you can take.



Must-Haves

- Proficient in CapCut and Canva, or similar editing tools

- Able to create polished and engaging short-form videos

- Good sense of pacing, storytelling, music and visual presentation

- Familiar with current Instagram Reels and TikTok content styles

- Good written English, especially for on-screen captions

- Reliable, responsive and able to meet deadlines without constant supervision

- Comfortable working with both real estate and beauty-related content

- Open to receiving feedback and making reasonable revisions



Good to Have

- Previous experience editing content for real estate, beauty, lifestyle or personal brands

- Ability to generate content ideas instead of relying entirely on instructions

- Experience managing Instagram, 
 or
 accounts

- Basic understanding of hooks, audience retention and social media analytics

- Experience writing captions or preparing content calendars

- A good eye for clean, modern and premium-looking content



Why Work With Us?

- 100% Remote: Work from wherever you are

- Flexible Working Hours: Manage your own schedule as long as deadlines and quality standards are met

- Creative Freedom: Good ideas are welcomed, and you will have room to influence our content

- Two Different Industries: Build your portfolio across Singapore’s real estate and beauty sectors

- Opportunity to Grow: Strong performers can take on content strategy and social media management responsibilities for higher compensation

- Long-Term Opportunity: We hope to find someone dependable who can grow together with both brands



If interested, submit your application here: 
. Only Google form submissions will be reviewed. Direct Whatsapp/emails will be ignored. In the Google form, for the question regarding Tampines, the answer is “West”
