title: Social Media Strategist
description:

This is a full account management role. That means you are not just posting content and calling it a day. You are thinking about the accounts you handle, making decisions on content, and taking responsibility for how they grow.

- Run assigned accounts day to day

- Choose and plan content in a way that gives it the best chance of doing well

- Give feedback on content and suggest improvements where you can

- Send regular updates on how accounts are performing

- Someone who actually understands Social Media: how it works, what performs, and why

- Experience managing Instagram accounts is a bonus but not a dealbreaker if you can show you know your stuff

title: Amazon FBA Sourcing Assistant — Supplier Outreach & Product Research (Full-time, Long-term)
description:
Hello,



We're GTDISTRIBUTION, an Amazon FBA seller operating across 5 European marketplaces (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Netherlands). We're growing fast and looking for a second Virtual Assistant to join our sourcing team.



What you'll actually do



1. Supplier outreach — 60% of your time

Find wholesalers and distributors in Europe and the US, contact them by
, follow up, and qualify their offers. The goal is building a portfolio of recurring products we can reorder every month — not one-off deals.



2. Product research — 40%

Identify profitable products using clear criteria we'll teach you: minimum ROI, monthly sales volume, price history analysis. You'll work from a documented process — no guessing.



What this isn't



This isn't a data-entry job. You'll be talking to suppliers, negotiating terms, and making judgment calls. If you want a role where you just fill spreadsheets, this isn't it.



Where this can go



This isn't a fixed role. Our first VA started with product research only — she now runs supplier relationships and will personally train you.



If you perform, within 12 months you could be managing your own sourcing portfolio, leading supplier negotiations directly, or training VAs for our coaching clients (we run an Amazon coaching business alongside this one).



We're looking for someone who wants to grow into a role, not just fill one.



Be honest with yourself before applying



We check the work. Our criteria are strict. If you send us a product that doesn't meet them, we'll tell you why — and we expect you to adjust.



If you're looking for a comfortable job where nobody looks at what you do, this isn't it. If you want to be pushed and get better at what you do, we'd love to talk.



What we offer

Full-time, fully remote, flexible hours

32,000 PHP/month to start — reviewed after 3 months based on results. We pay more for people who take on more.

Complete training, with our current VA onboarding you personally

A documented process, not "figure it out yourself"

Long-term position with a company that's growing

Who we're looking for

Solid written English — you'll be
ing suppliers daily

Comfortable with Google Sheets and numbers

Detail-oriented — our criteria are strict and we verify the work

Self-starter who tries things and asks questions when stuck, rather than staying blocked

Amazon or wholesale sourcing experience is a plus, not a requirement

How to apply



Send us:



1. Your relevant experience — 2-3 sentences, not a full CV



2. Your availability to start



3. Answer this: You find a product with 45% ROI, but it only sells 8 units per month on Amazon. Would you add it to our sourcing sheet? Explain your reasoning in 2-3 sentences.



4. Answer this: Tell us about a time you were stuck on something at work. What did you actually do?



⚠️ Applications missing answers to questions 3 and 4 will not be reviewed.



Looking forward to hearing from you.



Thibault

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Product Manager - SaaS
description:
gigCMO is a dynamic growth consultancy providing strategic marketing leadership and expertise to start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs, propelling them toward profitable revenue growth. Nestled in the heart of the City of London, United Kingdom, we specialise in supporting B2B clients in expanding their reach domestically and internationally. Our dedicated team, operating under the banner of Magnacca International, is strategically based in the Philippines. We chose this location for its pool of talent, strong social skills, enthusiasm, and unwavering loyalty.



We are seeking a dedicated and dynamic Product Manager to lead and enhance our Digital Church Platform®. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the product development lifecycle, managing development resources effectively, and ensuring rigorous final testing processes before releasing software updates. You will also play a critical role in translating the strategic vision held by the founder into actionable roadmaps and product deliverables.



Key Responsibilities:



- Manage the Product Development (PD) pipeline, ensuring alignment with organisational goals.

- Prioritise and allocate development resources efficiently to align with strategic priorities.

- Conduct comprehensive final testing and quality assurance to guarantee smooth, error-free software updates before public release.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver product enhancements that meet user needs and drive platform adoption.

- Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders regarding project timelines, milestones, and release schedules.

- Translate strategic vision and high-level ideas from leadership into actionable product roadmaps, user stories, and specifications. 

- Facilitate clear and consistent communication between non-technical stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring all parties are aligned.

- Set up and manage internal systems (e.g. Basecamp and HubSpot) to track backlog, sprints, and milestones.

- Gather feedback from churches and users to shape future features and improvements. 

- Monitor product performance or user feedback loops to inform decisions and prioritisation. 

- Monitor incoming requests via helpdesk and chat channels, triage issues, and ensure timely resolution either directly or by coordinating with the development team.



Qualifications:



- Proven experience in Product Management, ideally within digital platforms or SaaS environments.

- Strong organisational skills with an ability to manage multiple development priorities simultaneously.

- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in software testing and quality assurance.

- Demonstrable capability in managing software product lifecycles effectively.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to engage stakeholders at various levels.

- Previous experience in digital community platforms or faith-based digital services is advantageous but not essential.

- Experience writing product requirements, specs, and user stories to support development.

- Understanding of user needs in faith-based or nonprofit contexts, particularly around compliance, admin, or community tools, is highly desirable. 

- A mindset geared toward scalability, continuous improvement, and hands-on problem solving in an early-stage SaaS environment.
